title.en: CMS shift: roster, clock-in and handover
title.ms: Syif CMS: roster, daftar masuk dan serah tugas

purpose.en: Every CMS shift has 1 Head Control and 1 Monitor Officer; the Head Control hands the desk over in writing to the next.
purpose.ms: Setiap syif CMS mempunyai 1 Ketua Kawalan dan 1 Pegawai Pemantau; Ketua Kawalan menyerahkan meja secara bertulis kepada yang seterusnya.

starter.en: Arms Control plans the roster

does.en: Plans the roster (Plan next week) and sets the CMS settings within approved limits.
does.ms: Merancang roster (Rancang minggu depan) dan menetapkan tetapan CMS dalam had yang diluluskan.

does.en: Clocks in to their own seat with their own Prima account.
does.ms: Daftar masuk ke tempat duduk sendiri dengan akaun Prima sendiri.

does.en: Writes the handover in the last hour of the shift; Prima adds what is still open.
does.ms: Menulis serah tugas dalam jam terakhir syif; Prima menambah apa yang masih terbuka.

does.en: Clocked in, takes the handover from 30 minutes before the shift; “not agreed” is allowed with a reason and raised for Arms Control.
does.ms: Selepas daftar masuk, mengambil serah tugas mulai 30 minit sebelum syif; “tidak bersetuju” dibenarkan dengan sebab dan dibangkitkan kepada Kawalan Senjata.

does.en: See each person’s month: seats, hours, late in, left early, no clock-out, missed.
does.ms: Melihat bulan setiap orang: tempat duduk, jam, lewat masuk, keluar awal, tiada daftar keluar, terlepas.

rules.en: At most 12 hours in a row and 6 days in a row; rest between stretches is a CMS setting (1 to 24 hours, 8 to start). Nobody on a seat during approved leave.
rules.ms: Paling lama 12 jam berturut-turut dan 6 hari berturut-turut; rehat antara giliran ialah tetapan CMS (1 hingga 24 jam, bermula 8). Tiada sesiapa di tempat duduk semasa cuti yang diluluskan.

rules.en: Head Control cannot clock out until the next Head Control has taken the handover; leaving more than 15 minutes early needs a reason.
rules.ms: Ketua Kawalan tidak boleh daftar keluar sehingga Ketua Kawalan seterusnya mengambil serah tugas; keluar lebih 15 minit awal perlu sebab.

rules.en: Nobody takes a handover from themselves. Someone with no linked account can be rostered but cannot clock in.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa mengambil serah tugas daripada diri sendiri. Orang tanpa akaun terpaut boleh dirosterkan tetapi tidak boleh daftar masuk.

statusNote.en: Until the CMS app runs on the in-house server, the handover is done on Prima’s CMS board.
statusNote.ms: Sehingga aplikasi CMS berjalan di pelayan dalaman, serah tugas dibuat di papan CMS Prima.

sops.words: cms roster shift syif head control ketua kawalan monitor officer handover serah tugas clock in daftar masuk seat

title.en: CMS: emergencies, alarms and missed calls
title.ms: CMS: kecemasan, penggera dan panggilan terlepas

purpose.en: CMS acknowledges every emergency and alarm, has a second person agree each false alarm, and calls back missed company calls. CMS monitors and escalates; the company decides.
purpose.ms: CMS mengakui setiap kecemasan dan penggera, orang kedua bersetuju bagi setiap penggera palsu, dan membuat panggilan balik bagi panggilan syarikat yang terlepas. CMS memantau dan mengeskalasi; syarikat memutuskan.

starter.en: CMS operators on shift

does.en: Acknowledges the emergency or alarm in time, checks the camera and calls the guard, then closes it.
does.ms: Mengakui kecemasan atau penggera dalam masa, menyemak kamera dan menelefon pengawal, kemudian menutupnya.

does.en: Reviews every false alarm: “Agree, false” or “It was real” (which opens the incident for the company).
does.ms: Menyemak setiap penggera palsu: “Setuju, palsu” atau “Ia benar” (yang membuka insiden untuk syarikat).

label.en: CMS › False alarms for Head Control to review
label.ms: CMS › Penggera palsu untuk semakan Ketua Kawalan

does.en: Calls back each missed company call forwarded to CMS and marks it Called back.
does.ms: Membuat panggilan balik bagi setiap panggilan syarikat yang terlepas dan dipindahkan ke CMS, dan menanda Telah dihubungi.

does.en: Watches attendance alerts to the PIC and may call the guard; the company does the rest.
does.ms: Memantau amaran kehadiran kepada PIC dan boleh menelefon pengawal; syarikat melakukan selebihnya.

rules.en: A call not answered at the company extension forwards to CMS after 20 seconds (proposed).
rules.ms: Panggilan yang tidak dijawab di sambungan syarikat dipindahkan ke CMS selepas 20 saat (cadangan).

rules.en: Arms alerts are on the Arms control board.
rules.ms: Amaran senjata berada di papan Kawalan senjata.

statusNote.en: CCTV, alarm, door and vehicle feeds are not connected yet and show as Unknown.
statusNote.ms: Suapan CCTV, penggera, pintu dan kenderaan belum disambung dan dipaparkan sebagai Tidak diketahui.

sops.words: cms alarm penggera emergency kecemasan false alarm penggera palsu acknowledge akui call back panggilan balik ip phone

title.en: CMS message to a site device

purpose.en: CMS sends an instruction, alert or urgent alert to a site’s shared device; the guard takes it and sends photo or video proof; CMS closes it.
purpose.ms: CMS menghantar arahan, amaran atau amaran segera ke peranti bersama tapak; pengawal menerimanya dan menghantar bukti gambar atau video; CMS menutupnya.

starter.en: The CMS desk for that company

does.en: Sends the message, on its own or following an alarm or a camera or sensor detection (never proof by itself), and says what proof it needs.
does.ms: Menghantar mesej, sendiri atau susulan penggera atau pengesanan kamera atau sensor (tidak sekali-kali bukti dengan sendirinya), dan menyatakan bukti yang diperlukan.

does.en: Takes the message on the site device with staff number and PIN, then sends a photo or a clip up to 30 seconds.
does.ms: Menerima mesej di peranti tapak dengan nombor staf dan PIN, kemudian menghantar gambar atau klip sehingga 30 saat.

does.en: A late message shows on CMS “Now” for the operator to phone the guard or the site officer.
does.ms: Mesej yang lewat dipaparkan di CMS “Sekarang” untuk operator menelefon pengawal atau pegawai tapak.

does.en: Reviews the proof and closes: Real (opens the company’s case, P1 for urgent, P2 otherwise), Nothing found, Done (instructions) or Withdrawn (with a reason).
does.ms: Menyemak bukti dan menutup: Benar (membuka kes syarikat, P1 bagi segera, P2 selainnya), Tiada apa-apa, Selesai (arahan) atau Ditarik balik (dengan sebab).

rules.en: Taken within 60 seconds (urgent), 3 minutes (alert) or 15 minutes (instruction); proof within 5, 15 or 60 minutes after taking.
rules.ms: Diterima dalam 60 saat (segera), 3 minit (amaran) atau 15 minit (arahan); bukti dalam 5, 15 atau 60 minit selepas diterima.

rules.en: Proof gets the server’s time, the site geofence check and a fingerprint. “Nothing found” closes the alarm as false, so Head Control still reviews it.
rules.ms: Bukti menggunakan masa pelayan, semakan geofence tapak dan cap jari digital. “Tiada apa-apa” menutup penggera sebagai palsu, jadi Ketua Kawalan masih menyemaknya.

statusNote.en: Every time limit in rule CMS-DISPATCH is a proposal; the bodycam link is a mock until a brand is chosen.
statusNote.ms: Setiap had masa dalam peraturan CMS-DISPATCH ialah cadangan; pautan kamera badan masih olok-olok sehingga jenama dipilih.

sops.words: cms message mesej dispatch site device peranti tapak instruction arahan alert amaran urgent segera proof bukti video

title.en: Post log, visitors and vehicles on the site device
title.ms: Log pos, pelawat dan kenderaan di peranti tapak

purpose.en: The guard keeps the post log (occurrence book) and the gate record of visitors and vehicles on the site’s shared device, even with no signal.
purpose.ms: Pengawal menyimpan log pos (buku kejadian) dan rekod pintu pagar pelawat dan kenderaan di peranti bersama tapak, walaupun tanpa liputan.

label.en: Site device › Visitor or vehicle in
label.ms: Peranti tapak › Pelawat atau kenderaan masuk

starter.en: The guard on duty at the post

does.en: Writes each post log line, signed with staff number and PIN. Lines are never edited; a correction is a new line.
does.ms: Menulis setiap baris log pos, ditandatangani dengan nombor staf dan PIN. Baris tidak diubah; pembetulan ialah baris baharu.

label.en: Site device › Write in post log
label.ms: Peranti tapak › Tulis dalam log pos

does.en: Records each visitor (IC or licence photo, face check, host and purpose, stamped photo) or vehicle (plate checked against the site list), and signs them out.
does.ms: Merekod setiap pelawat (gambar IC atau lesen, semakan muka, tuan rumah dan tujuan, gambar bercop) atau kenderaan (nombor plat disemak dengan senarai tapak), dan mendaftar keluar mereka.

label.en: Site device › Visitor or vehicle in
label.ms: Peranti tapak › Pelawat atau kenderaan masuk

does.en: A plate on watch raises an alarm to CMS; offline, the device tells the guard to phone CMS and not let it in.
does.ms: Nombor plat dalam pemerhatian mencetuskan penggera ke CMS; jika luar talian, peranti mengarahkan pengawal menelefon CMS dan tidak membenarkannya masuk.

does.en: The company sees the duty log in the site drawer; CMS sees it under Site devices.
does.ms: Syarikat melihat log tugas dalam laci tapak; CMS melihatnya di bawah Peranti tapak.

rules.en: Prima never opens or closes a gate; it records and warns.
rules.ms: Prima tidak sekali-kali membuka atau menutup pagar; ia merekod dan memberi amaran.

rules.en: The full ID and card picture are sealed for the company’s in-house server; screens show only the last 4 characters. Visitor records are kept 7 years.
rules.ms: ID penuh dan gambar kad dimeterai untuk pelayan dalaman syarikat; skrin hanya memaparkan 4 aksara terakhir. Rekod pelawat disimpan 7 tahun.

rules.en: Where a site gives only a written book, the guard photographs the pages (up to 10 per upload).
rules.ms: Jika tapak hanya menyediakan buku bertulis, pengawal mengambil gambar halaman (sehingga 10 setiap muat naik).

statusNote.en: The in-house server is not built: until its key is set the device warns that the full ID cannot be kept and refuses book-page uploads. The IC and plate readers are typed or photo for now.
statusNote.ms: Pelayan dalaman belum dibina: sehingga kuncinya ditetapkan, peranti memberi amaran bahawa ID penuh tidak dapat disimpan dan menolak muat naik halaman buku. Pembaca IC dan nombor plat buat masa ini secara taip atau gambar.

sops.words: post log log pos occurrence book buku kejadian visitor pelawat vehicle kenderaan plate plat gate pagar ic

title.en: CMS site readiness

purpose.en: Each site’s devices and preparations are recorded, then Arms Control checks them before the site is ready to connect to CMS.
purpose.ms: Peranti dan persediaan setiap tapak direkod, kemudian Kawalan Senjata menyemaknya sebelum tapak sedia untuk disambung ke CMS.

starter.en: Company manager, admin executive or site supervisor (own sites)
starter.ms: Pengurus syarikat, eksekutif admin atau penyelia tapak (tapak sendiri)

does.en: Records each device (kind, brand and model as the client chose, owner, vendor contact, the vendor’s answer on sharing events).
does.ms: Merekod setiap peranti (jenis, jenama dan model pilihan pelanggan, pemilik, hubungan vendor, jawapan vendor tentang perkongsian peristiwa).

does.en: Answers each preparation yes, no or not known: site survey, client’s written agreement, CCTV signs, internet, backup power, time sync, admin login holder.
does.ms: Menjawab setiap persediaan ya, tidak atau belum diketahui: tinjauan tapak, persetujuan bertulis pelanggan, papan tanda CCTV, internet, kuasa sandaran, penyegerakan masa, pemegang log masuk admin.

who.en: Arms Control (with a grant) or the CEO

does.en: Passes or returns with what to fix, always with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau memulangkan dengan perkara yang perlu dibaiki, sentiasa dengan sebab.

rules.en: Prima never picks, recommends or limits a brand. A vendor that says “cannot link” makes the site Needs fixing; ask for an API or a gateway.
rules.ms: Prima tidak sekali-kali memilih, mencadangkan atau menghadkan jenama. Vendor yang menyatakan “tidak boleh dipautkan” menjadikan tapak Perlu dibaiki; minta API atau gerbang.

rules.en: Not known never counts as done. Text that looks like a password, PIN or code is refused.
rules.ms: Belum diketahui tidak sekali-kali dikira selesai. Teks yang kelihatan seperti kata laluan, PIN atau kod ditolak.

rules.en: Nobody who recorded any part may check it; any later change voids the check.
rules.ms: Sesiapa yang merekod mana-mana bahagian tidak boleh menyemaknya; sebarang perubahan kemudian membatalkan semakan.

statusNote.en: “Ready to connect” is never a connection: device links come later, so Connected stays 0.
statusNote.ms: “Sedia untuk disambung” bukan sambungan: pautan peranti akan datang kemudian, jadi Disambung kekal 0.

sops.words: cms readiness kesediaan cctv device peranti brand jenama alarm penggera vendor site tapak connect sambung

title.en: CMS commissioning for a contract

purpose.en: Before CMS takes on a contract’s signed service, operators test every call-out contact and service, and Arms Control accepts it.
purpose.ms: Sebelum CMS mengambil perkhidmatan yang ditandatangani dalam kontrak, operator menguji setiap kenalan panggilan dan perkhidmatan, dan Kawalan Senjata menerimanya.

starter.en: The company records the signed CMS scope on the contract
starter.ms: Syarikat merekod skop CMS yang ditandatangani pada kontrak

does.en: Records the signed CMS service scope on the contract.
does.ms: Merekod skop perkhidmatan CMS yang ditandatangani pada kontrak.

does.en: Verifies each call-out contact by a test call (Mark verified) and records a test of each signed service at each site.
does.ms: Mengesahkan setiap kenalan panggilan melalui panggilan ujian (Tanda disahkan) dan merekod ujian bagi setiap perkhidmatan yang ditandatangani di setiap tapak.

does.en: Accepts for CMS once every contact is verified and the sites are linked.
does.ms: Menerima untuk CMS setelah setiap kenalan disahkan dan tapak dipautkan.

does.en: Records the client’s acceptance on the contract.
does.ms: Merekod penerimaan pelanggan pada kontrak.

rules.en: Attendance and patrol run in the JA app, so the operator attests them; CCTV and alarm tests are checked against Prima’s records.
rules.ms: Kehadiran dan rondaan berjalan dalam aplikasi JA, jadi operator mengesahkannya; ujian CCTV dan penggera disemak berbanding rekod Prima.

sops.words: cms commissioning pentauliahan contract kontrak call-out test call panggilan ujian accept terima

title.en: Guards on their own phones

purpose.en: A guard signs in on their own enrolled phone with PIN and face, with live patrol location, a heartbeat to CMS and an SOS button. Built, switched off.
purpose.ms: Pengawal log masuk di telefon sendiri yang didaftarkan dengan PIN dan muka, dengan lokasi rondaan langsung, isyarat hayat ke CMS dan butang SOS. Telah dibina, ditutup.

label.en: Guards › person › PIN and Prima access › Enrol phone
label.ms: Pengawal › orang › PIN dan akses Prima › Daftar telefon

starter.en: The company office or HR (the people who set PINs)
starter.ms: Pejabat syarikat atau HR (yang menetapkan PIN)

does.en: Sets the PIN and presses Enrol phone: a one-time code valid 24 hours and a link.
does.ms: Menetapkan PIN dan tekan Daftar telefon: kod sekali guna sah 24 jam dan pautan.

label.en: Guards › person › PIN and Prima access
label.ms: Pengawal › orang › PIN dan akses Prima

does.en: The guard opens the link, types the staff number, then the PIN and one face photo; HR approves the face.
does.ms: Pengawal membuka pautan, menaip nombor staf, kemudian PIN dan satu gambar muka; HR meluluskan muka.

does.en: Signs in with the phone, PIN and face. On duty the phone sends a heartbeat every 60 seconds; CMS sees it live, late or offline.
does.ms: Log masuk dengan telefon, PIN dan muka. Semasa bertugas telefon menghantar isyarat hayat setiap 60 saat; CMS melihatnya aktif, lewat atau luar talian.

rules.en: Never the PIN alone; five wrong tries lock the phone for 30 minutes. One active phone per guard.
rules.ms: Tidak sekali-kali PIN sahaja; lima cubaan salah mengunci telefon selama 30 minit. Satu telefon aktif bagi setiap pengawal.

rules.en: Location only on duty (30 minutes either side of the shift). SOS needs only the enrolled phone.
rules.ms: Lokasi hanya semasa bertugas (30 minit sebelum dan selepas syif). SOS hanya memerlukan telefon yang didaftarkan.

statusNote.en: Off until the owner turns GUARD_PHONE on; guards stay on the JA app for now. Most numbers are proposals.
statusNote.ms: Ditutup sehingga pemilik menghidupkan GUARD_PHONE; pengawal kekal menggunakan aplikasi JA buat masa ini. Kebanyakan angka masih cadangan.

sops.words: guard phone telefon pengawal enrol daftar pin face muka sos heartbeat location lokasi

title.en: A guard's uniform from the Goodwill store

purpose.en: The OM asks the store for one guard’s uniform; the store issues it; the officer and the guard sign on the OM’s phone.
purpose.ms: OM memohon uniform seorang pengawal daripada stor; stor mengeluarkannya; peronda dan pengawal menandatangan di telefon OM.

starter.en: Operations Manager (OM) or Regional OM covering the guard’s company
starter.ms: Pengurus Operasi (OM) atau OM Wilayah yang menjaga syarikat pengawal

does.en: Types the guard’s staff number, picks the uniform and size, 1 to 3 pieces, and the reason.
does.ms: Taip nombor staf pengawal, pilih uniform dan saiz, 1 hingga 3 helai, dan sebabnya.

does.en: Counts the pieces the guard had in the last 12 months plus open requests: up to 3 free; every piece after that only with the guard’s paid receipt.
does.ms: Mengira helai yang pengawal terima dalam 12 bulan lepas termasuk permohonan terbuka: hingga 3 percuma; selepas itu hanya dengan resit bayaran pengawal.

does.en: Issues it to the OM, naming the patrolling officer of the guard’s company, or refuses with a reason the OM can see.
does.ms: Mengeluarkannya kepada OM dengan menamakan peronda syarikat pengawal, atau menolak dengan sebab yang OM boleh lihat.

does.en: Under “Items to pass on” the OM confirms receiving it, then the officer and the guard sign on the OM’s phone (or the OM attaches the signed slip and a photo).
does.ms: Di bawah “Barang untuk diserahkan” OM sahkan terima, kemudian peronda dan pengawal tandatangan di telefon OM (atau OM lampirkan slip bertandatangan dan gambar).

does.en: Bills the guard’s company only after the guard has acknowledged the item.
does.ms: Membil syarikat pengawal hanya selepas pengawal mengakui terima barang.

rules.en: One open request per guard per item.
rules.ms: Satu permohonan terbuka bagi setiap pengawal bagi setiap barang.

rules.en: Pieces after the 3rd in 12 months are paid by the guard with a receipt; never taken from pay.
rules.ms: Helai selepas yang ke-3 dalam 12 bulan dibayar oleh pengawal dengan resit; tidak sekali-kali dipotong gaji.

rules.en: A piece within 6 months of the last one needs a reason and is marked “within 6 months”.
rules.ms: Helai dalam tempoh 6 bulan dari yang terakhir perlu sebab dan ditanda “dalam 6 bulan”.

rules.en: The OM may cancel while the request is open. The OGM sees every request but does not decide.
rules.ms: OM boleh batalkan semasa permohonan masih terbuka. OGM melihat semua permohonan tetapi tidak memutuskan.

sops.words: uniform pakaian seragam baju seluar order pesan request mohon goodwill store stor allowance elaun

title.en: Site supplies request (Permohonan Pesanan Barang)

purpose.en: Supplies, cleaning stock and guards’ uniforms for a site (KBK, PKK Nepal, PKK Local): asked by the OM, confirmed by the OGM, issued or bought by the store.
purpose.ms: Bekalan, stok pembersihan dan uniform pengawal untuk tapak (KBK, PKK Nepal, PKK Tempatan): dipohon OM, disahkan OGM, dikeluarkan atau dibeli oleh stor.

starter.en: OM or Regional OM covering the site
starter.ms: OM atau OM Wilayah yang menjaga tapak

does.en: Enters the lines: store item, size, quantity and purpose (and the guard’s staff number for a personal piece). Prima builds the summary per item and size.
does.ms: Masukkan baris: barang stor, saiz, kuantiti dan tujuan (dan nombor staf pengawal untuk barang peribadi). Prima menyusun ringkasan bagi setiap barang dan saiz.

does.en: First check: complete and matches the site roster, or returned with a reason.
does.ms: Semakan awal: lengkap dan sepadan dengan roster tapak, atau dipulangkan dengan sebab.

who.en: OGM (or the deputy the OGM names)

does.en: Confirms, changes quantities with a reason, or rejects.
does.ms: Mengesahkan, menukar kuantiti dengan sebab, atau menolak.

does.en: The storekeeper records what the store can give now; the Procurement executive decides per line: issue from stock or buy (one purchase per category).
does.ms: Penjaga stor merekod apa yang stor boleh beri sekarang; eksekutif Perolehan memutuskan setiap baris: keluarkan dari stok atau beli (satu pembelian bagi setiap kategori).

does.en: Stock prepared, checked by a second person (PIC), ready to send; then issued with a DO in two copies.
does.ms: Stok disediakan, disemak oleh orang kedua (PIC), sedia untuk dihantar; kemudian dikeluarkan dengan DO dua salinan.

does.en: Counts what arrived (photo; short or damaged needs a note), then hands each piece to the guard, who signs on the OM’s phone.
does.ms: Mengira barang yang tiba (gambar; kurang atau rosak perlu catatan), kemudian menyerahkan setiap helai kepada pengawal yang menandatangan di telefon OM.

rules.en: Nobody confirms their own request.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa mengesahkan permohonan sendiri.

rules.en: One open request per site per item (per guard for a personal piece).
rules.ms: Satu permohonan terbuka bagi setiap tapak bagi setiap barang (bagi setiap pengawal untuk barang peribadi).

rules.en: In-stock lines are due ready within 7 working days of approval.
rules.ms: Baris yang ada stok perlu siap dalam 7 hari bekerja selepas kelulusan.

rules.en: Nothing is issued while a major stock count is open, unless the OGM lets an urgent one through.
rules.ms: Tiada barang dikeluarkan semasa kiraan stok besar dibuka, kecuali OGM membenarkan yang segera.

rules.en: During the changeover the paper form, email and SharePoint upload are still sent as well.
rules.ms: Dalam tempoh peralihan, borang kertas, e-mel dan muat naik SharePoint masih dihantar juga.

statusNote.en: Effective 18 Nov 2026. Emails at each step wait for the Outlook connection.
statusNote.ms: Berkuat kuasa 18 Nov 2026. E-mel pada setiap langkah menunggu sambungan Outlook.

source.decided: Fauzan, 13 Nov 2026 (Part T) and 14 Nov 2026 (Part U)
