title.en: Store item to a person, and its return
title.ms: Barang stor kepada seseorang, dan pemulangannya

purpose.en: The store hands a uniform or piece of equipment to a guard or officer; the person confirms it on their own screen; when it comes back the store records its condition.
purpose.ms: Stor menyerahkan uniform atau peralatan kepada pengawal atau peronda; orang itu mengesahkannya di skrin sendiri; apabila dipulangkan, stor merekod keadaannya.

starter.en: Storekeeper or Procurement executive

does.en: Under “Issue to a person” picks the person, the item and the quantity. A Goodwill item goes store → OM → patrolling officer → guard, so the store also names the OM and the officer.
does.ms: Di bawah “Issue to a person” pilih orang, barang dan kuantiti. Barang Goodwill bergerak stor → OM → peronda → pengawal, jadi stor juga menamakan OM dan peronda.

does.en: Each confirms receiving it, signing on screen or with a signed slip and photo. The guard sees it under “Items issued to me”.
does.ms: Setiap seorang mengesahkan terima, menandatangan di skrin atau dengan slip bertandatangan dan gambar. Pengawal melihatnya di bawah “Items issued to me”.

does.en: Follows up anything not confirmed or disputed, and items to collect from people who have left.
does.ms: Menyusul apa-apa yang belum disahkan atau dipertikaikan, dan barang yang perlu dikutip daripada orang yang telah berhenti.

does.en: When the item comes back, presses Return on the issued line and records it as good, worn, damaged or lost, with what happened.
does.ms: Apabila barang dipulangkan, tekan Return pada baris yang dikeluarkan dan rekod sebagai baik, lusuh, rosak atau hilang, dengan apa yang berlaku.

does.en: Confirms or refuses each lost or damaged item, with a note and the cause. Refused means the item stays on the person until it is returned.
does.ms: Mengesahkan atau menolak setiap barang hilang atau rosak, dengan catatan dan punca. Jika ditolak, barang kekal atas nama orang itu sehingga dipulangkan.

who.en: Store (someone other than the person who recorded the return)

does.en: Disposes of a returned worn or damaged piece from the guard’s uniform record: reason, “marks removed” ticked and a photo for a marked piece.
does.ms: Melupuskan helai lusuh atau rosak yang dipulangkan dari rekod uniform pengawal: sebab, tanda “marks removed” dan gambar bagi helai bertanda.

rules.en: Goodwill’s store issues to guards of every company it serves, never to central staff.
rules.ms: Stor Goodwill mengeluarkan barang kepada pengawal setiap syarikat yang dilayaninya, bukan kepada staf pusat.

rules.en: Only the person who got the item confirms it, in their own sign-in.
rules.ms: Hanya orang yang menerima barang boleh mengesahkannya, melalui log masuk sendiri.

rules.en: Uniforms and equipment are not charged to the guard; only a loss or damage the manager finds was negligence or misuse becomes a damage charge, reviewed by HR.
rules.ms: Uniform dan peralatan tidak dicaj kepada pengawal; hanya kehilangan atau kerosakan yang diputuskan pengurus sebagai kecuaian atau salah guna menjadi caj kerosakan, disemak oleh HR.

source.decided: Fauzan, 27 Oct and 2 Nov 2026 (W27); T11 and T12 on 13 Nov 2026

sops.words: issue keluar serah handover return pulang pulangkan lost hilang damaged rosak slip signature tandatangan

title.en: Store stock count and variances

purpose.en: Every store is counted once a month, and fully at the end of June and December with all movement frozen; each difference is explained or adjusted. Also the Monday opening balance and the monthly report.
purpose.ms: Setiap stor dikira sebulan sekali, dan kiraan penuh pada akhir Jun dan Disember dengan semua pergerakan dibekukan; setiap perbezaan dijelaskan atau dilaraskan. Termasuk baki pembukaan hari Isnin dan laporan bulanan.

starter.en: Storekeeper (at a private store, the admin executive)
starter.ms: Penjaga stor (di stor swasta, eksekutif admin)

does.en: Each Monday confirms last week’s closing balance as this week’s opening balance. After that, a movement dated in a closed week is refused.
does.ms: Setiap Isnin mengesahkan baki penutup minggu lepas sebagai baki pembukaan minggu ini. Selepas itu, pergerakan bertarikh dalam minggu yang ditutup ditolak.

does.en: Starts the monthly count, or the major count (2 to 5 PM, all stock in and out stopped), prints the count sheet and enters each physical figure. A difference needs a reason from the list.
does.ms: Memulakan kiraan bulanan, atau kiraan besar (2 hingga 5 petang, semua stok keluar masuk dihentikan), mencetak borang kiraan dan memasukkan angka fizikal. Perbezaan perlu sebab daripada senarai.

does.en: Signs the finish with staff number and PIN.
does.ms: Menandatangan penamat dengan nombor staf dan PIN.

does.en: Decides each variance: explained (the missing movement was recorded) or adjusted (one line on the stock card; Finance is told the write-off value).
does.ms: Memutuskan setiap varians: dijelaskan (pergerakan yang tertinggal telah direkod) atau dilaraskan (satu baris pada kad stok; Kewangan dimaklumkan nilai hapus kira).

who.en: OGM (company manager at a private store)

does.en: Approves an adjustment above RM500, and may let one urgent move through during a major count, with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan pelarasan melebihi RM500, dan boleh membenarkan satu pergerakan segera semasa kiraan besar, dengan sebab.

does.en: Builds the monthly report (PDF), adds comments and submits it; the OGM reviews it, and returning it needs a reason. A submitted report is frozen.
does.ms: Menyediakan laporan bulanan (PDF), menambah ulasan dan menghantarnya; OGM menyemak, dan memulangkannya perlu sebab. Laporan yang dihantar dibekukan.

rules.en: The counter and the witness never decide the variance.
rules.ms: Pengira dan saksi tidak boleh memutuskan varians.

rules.en: The same item short in 3 counts in a row is flagged to the OGM.
rules.ms: Barang yang sama kurang dalam 3 kiraan berturut-turut ditanda kepada OGM.

rules.en: Inventory, count and disposal records are kept at least 7 years; nothing is deleted.
rules.ms: Rekod inventori, kiraan dan pelupusan disimpan sekurang-kurangnya 7 tahun; tiada yang dipadam.

sops.words: stock count kiraan stok stock take varians variance freeze beku witness saksi opening balance baki pembukaan monthly report laporan bulanan

title.en: Min/Max and reorder

purpose.en: The least and most the store and each site should hold, so nothing runs out and nothing piles up. Prima suggests what to reorder; people decide.
purpose.ms: Paras paling sedikit dan paling banyak yang stor dan setiap tapak patut simpan, supaya tiada yang habis dan tiada yang berlebihan. Prima mencadangkan pesanan semula; manusia yang memutuskan.

starter.en: Procurement executive (store), OM (site cleaning supplies)

does.en: Sets each store item’s Min (reorder level) and Max with how it was set.
does.ms: Menetapkan Min (paras pesanan semula) dan Max setiap barang stor dengan cara ia ditetapkan.

does.en: Proposes a site’s Min and Max for a cleaning supply, from real usage.
does.ms: Mencadangkan Min dan Max tapak bagi bekalan pembersihan, berdasarkan penggunaan sebenar.

does.en: Approves the site Min/Max, or refuses with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan Min/Max tapak, atau menolak dengan sebab.

does.en: Sets the buffer for course uniform sets (CSG/TNG) with a reason; an item below its buffer shows red and one at zero is a critical stock-out.
does.ms: Menetapkan simpanan bagi set uniform kursus (CSG/TNG) dengan sebab; barang di bawah paras simpanan ditunjuk merah dan yang habis ialah kehabisan stok kritikal.

does.en: Reads the reorder suggestion (weekly usage over 8 weeks × lead time plus a week, capped at Max) and raises a purchase when needed.
does.ms: Membaca cadangan pesanan (penggunaan mingguan 8 minggu × tempoh penghantaran tambah seminggu, dihadkan pada Max) dan membuka pembelian jika perlu.

rules.en: Until set, Min and Max show “not set”; Prima never fills a default number.
rules.ms: Selagi belum ditetapkan, Min dan Max ditunjuk “belum ditetapkan”; Prima tidak mengisi nombor lalai.

rules.en: The reorder suggestion is never automatic.
rules.ms: Cadangan pesanan semula tidak sekali-kali automatik.

rules.en: A buffer not reviewed in 90 days is listed.
rules.ms: Paras simpanan yang tidak disemak dalam 90 hari disenaraikan.

sops.words: min max minimum maximum reorder pesan semula buffer simpanan stock out habis

title.en: Disposal of goods (Permohonan Pelupusan)

purpose.en: One case for store items and site items that are damaged, worn, unsafe or no longer needed: reviewed, approved where needed, disposed of with evidence, and closed within 10 working days.
purpose.ms: Satu kes bagi barang stor dan barang tapak yang rosak, lusuh, tidak selamat atau tidak diperlukan lagi: disemak, diluluskan jika perlu, dilupuskan dengan bukti, dan ditutup dalam 10 hari bekerja.

label.en: Ask to dispose of site items

starter.en: Storekeeper (store items) or the OM covering the site (site items)
starter.ms: Penjaga stor (barang stor) atau OM yang menjaga tapak (barang tapak)

does.en: Permohonan: item, quantity, where it is, condition now and the reason; a photo for a damaged or unsafe item. Store lines leave usable stock at once.
does.ms: Permohonan: barang, kuantiti, lokasi, keadaan sekarang dan sebab; gambar bagi barang rosak atau tidak selamat. Baris stor keluar daripada stok boleh guna serta-merta.

does.en: Semakan and Penilaian: checks quantity, condition and ownership; picks per line reuse, repair, transfer, recycle, dispose or return to the client; records the cause.
does.ms: Semakan dan Penilaian: menyemak kuantiti, keadaan dan pemilikan; memilih setiap baris guna semula, baiki, pindah, kitar semula, lupus atau pulang kepada klien; merekod punca.

does.en: Kelulusan: needed at RM1,000 or more, for any sensitive item (radios, devices) and any sale or auction. Under that the reviewer decides.
does.ms: Kelulusan: perlu bagi RM1,000 ke atas, sebarang barang sensitif (radio, peranti) dan sebarang jualan atau lelongan. Di bawahnya penyemak memutuskan.

does.en: Kaedah: method and destination per line (waste, recycle, third party, sale, destroy, back to supplier, e-waste, scheduled waste).
does.ms: Kaedah: cara dan destinasi setiap baris (sisa biasa, kitar semula, pihak ketiga, jualan, musnah, pulang kepada pembekal, e-sisa, buangan terjadual).

who.en: Storekeeper or the OM who asked
who.ms: Penjaga stor atau OM yang memohon

does.en: Pelaksanaan and Bukti: before and after photos, “marks removed” for marked items, the wipe reference for electronics, a witness for destroy, third party and sale; then the receipt or certificate.
does.ms: Pelaksanaan dan Bukti: gambar sebelum dan selepas, “marks removed” bagi barang bertanda, rujukan pemadaman data bagi elektronik, saksi bagi musnah, pihak ketiga dan jualan; kemudian resit atau sijil.

does.en: Selesai: closes the case once every piece of evidence is in; Finance is told the write-off value. Sale money is recorded by Finance, never by the store.
does.ms: Selesai: menutup kes apabila semua bukti lengkap; Kewangan dimaklumkan nilai hapus kira. Wang jualan direkod oleh Kewangan, bukan oleh stor.

rules.en: The requester never reviews or approves the case.
rules.ms: Pemohon tidak sekali-kali menyemak atau meluluskan kes.

rules.en: Target: 10 working days from request to Selesai.
rules.ms: Sasaran: 10 hari bekerja dari permohonan hingga Selesai.

rules.en: No disposal request while a major stock count is open.
rules.ms: Tiada permohonan pelupusan semasa kiraan stok besar dibuka.

rules.en: IT devices are disposed of only through IT’s disposal record (data wipe).
rules.ms: Peranti IT dilupuskan hanya melalui rekod pelupusan IT (pemadaman data).

statusNote.en: The OM’s request form is on Ask for equipment; the review, approval and evidence steps are on Procurement › Store.
statusNote.ms: Borang permohonan OM ada di Mohon peralatan; langkah semakan, kelulusan dan bukti ada di Perolehan › Stor.

sops.words: disposal pelupusan lupus buang dispose scrap write off hapus kira rosak lusuh

title.en: Damage or loss charge (kecuaian)

purpose.en: When the manager finds a company item was damaged or lost through negligence or misuse, the actual cost may go on the person’s next pay, after HR’s review.
purpose.ms: Apabila pengurus mendapati barang syarikat rosak atau hilang kerana kecuaian atau salah guna, kos sebenar boleh dicaj pada gaji berikutnya, selepas semakan HR.

starter.en: The manager who decides the variance, loss or disposal case
starter.ms: Pengurus yang memutuskan kes varians, kehilangan atau pelupusan

does.en: Records the cause: normal wear, accident, negligence, misuse or unknown, with a photo. The reporter never sets it.
does.ms: Merekod punca: lusuh biasa, kemalangan, kecuaian, salah guna atau tidak diketahui, dengan gambar. Pelapor tidak boleh menetapkannya.

does.en: Enters the store price when the item has none; the charge waits until then.
does.ms: Memasukkan harga stor jika barang tiada harga; caj menunggu sehingga itu.

who.en: HR (PWVSB HR, the CoS or the DCoS)

does.en: Reviews every charge before that month’s pay run: keep, reduce, spread or cancel, with a reason. Never the person who decided the charge.
does.ms: Menyemak setiap caj sebelum gaji bulan itu: kekal, kurangkan, ansur atau batal, dengan sebab. Bukan orang yang memutuskan caj.

does.en: Sees the charge before pay day under “Kerosakan / kehilangan barang syarikat”.
does.ms: Melihat caj sebelum hari gaji di bawah “Kerosakan / kehilangan barang syarikat”.

rules.en: Only negligence or misuse is charged; the charge is the store price, never guessed.
rules.ms: Hanya kecuaian atau salah guna dicaj; caj ialah harga stor, tidak sekali-kali diteka.

rules.en: Employment Act 1955 s.24 is shown on every charge: written agreement or the Labour Director General’s permission; all deductions within 50% of wages.
rules.ms: Akta Kerja 1955 s.24 ditunjuk pada setiap caj: persetujuan bertulis atau kebenaran Ketua Pengarah Tenaga Kerja; semua potongan dalam 50% gaji.

rules.en: Extra uniform pieces after the 3 free ones are paid by receipt, never from pay.
rules.ms: Helai uniform tambahan selepas 3 percuma dibayar dengan resit, bukan dari gaji.

rules.en: A guard’s charge is marked for keying into JA while guard pay is in JA.
rules.ms: Caj pengawal ditanda untuk dimasukkan ke JA selagi gaji pengawal dalam JA.

statusNote.en: HR’s review list sits in Procurement › Store (Kawalan Inventori).
statusNote.ms: Senarai semakan HR berada di Perolehan › Stor (Kawalan Inventori).

sops.words: damage charge caj kerosakan kehilangan negligence kecuaian misuse salah guna deduction potongan gaji hr

title.en: Warranty claim for a faulty item

purpose.en: A store item or IT device still under warranty stops working: report it with a photo; the store (or IT) checks the warranty, sends it to the supplier and records the outcome.
purpose.ms: Barang stor atau peranti IT yang masih dalam waranti rosak: laporkan dengan gambar; stor (atau IT) menyemak waranti, menghantar kepada pembekal dan merekod keputusan.

starter.en: The person holding the item, or the store
starter.ms: Orang yang memegang barang, atau stor

does.en: Chooses the faulty item, says what is wrong and when, and attaches a photo.
does.ms: Memilih barang yang rosak, menerangkan masalah dan tarikh, dan melampirkan gambar.

does.en: Checks the warranty: supplier and end date from the register or the warranty card.
does.ms: Menyemak waranti: pembekal dan tarikh tamat daripada daftar atau kad waranti.

does.en: Sends it to the supplier and records the date and the supplier’s reference.
does.ms: Menghantar kepada pembekal dan merekod tarikh serta rujukan pembekal.

does.en: Records the outcome (repaired, replaced with the new serial, or refused with the supplier’s reason).
does.ms: Merekod keputusan (dibaiki, diganti dengan nombor siri baharu, atau ditolak dengan sebab pembekal).

rules.en: A photo of the fault is required.
rules.ms: Gambar kerosakan wajib.

rules.en: Prima sends nothing to the supplier; the store sends it and records what happened.
rules.ms: Prima tidak menghantar apa-apa kepada pembekal; stor yang menghantar dan merekod apa yang berlaku.

sops.words: warranty waranti fault rosak supplier pembekal repair baiki replace ganti claim tuntutan

title.en: Register items and print labels

purpose.en: Every uniform, device and stock item gets one label for life (QR and barcode of the same ID): add the item type, register the units, print the labels and scan them back.
purpose.ms: Setiap uniform, peranti dan barang stok mendapat satu label seumur hayat (QR dan kod bar ID yang sama): tambah jenis barang, daftar unit, cetak label dan imbas semula.

starter.en: Store, company manager or admin executive of the owning company
starter.ms: Stor, pengurus syarikat atau eksekutif admin syarikat pemilik

does.en: Adds the item type (what it is, size, unit, tracked one by one or in bulk), or imports the old item list from Excel, CSV or PDF.
does.ms: Menambah jenis barang (apa, saiz, unit, dijejak satu-satu atau pukal), atau mengimport senarai barang lama daripada Excel, CSV atau PDF.

does.en: Registers the units in stock; each unit gets its own ID.
does.ms: Mendaftar unit dalam stok; setiap unit mendapat ID sendiri.

does.en: Prints the labels and scans each new label back to prove it is on the right item.
does.ms: Mencetak label dan mengimbas setiap label baharu untuk membuktikan ia pada barang yang betul.

does.en: Chooses barcode, QR or RFID for the company, with a reason.
does.ms: Memilih kod bar, QR atau RFID bagi syarikat, dengan sebab.

rules.en: The label carries only the ID: no names, prices or owner. A reprint keeps the ID and needs a reason.
rules.ms: Label hanya membawa ID: tiada nama, harga atau pemilik. Cetak semula mengekalkan ID dan perlu sebab.

rules.en: Firearms, ammunition and controlled items are not in this register; they stay in Arms Control.
rules.ms: Senjata api, peluru dan barang kawalan tiada dalam daftar ini; ia kekal di Kawalan Senjata.

rules.en: A supplier’s barcode is never a unit ID.
rules.ms: Kod bar pembekal tidak sekali-kali menjadi ID unit.

statusNote.en: SQL Account is not connected: Finance works from export files.
statusNote.ms: SQL Account belum disambung: Kewangan menggunakan fail eksport.

sops.words: item register daftar barang label qr barcode kod bar rfid sku item type jenis import

title.en: Hand a registered item to a person or site
title.ms: Serah barang berdaftar kepada orang atau tapak

purpose.en: Scan the item, hand it to a person or place it at a site; the person confirms it in their own sign-in. Taking it back, laundry and repair follow the same item.
purpose.ms: Imbas barang, serahkan kepada orang atau letak di tapak; orang itu mengesahkannya melalui log masuk sendiri. Ambil balik, dobi dan pembaikan mengikut barang yang sama.

starter.en: Store, supervisor, patrolling officer, OM or Regional OM at their sites
starter.ms: Stor, penyelia, peronda, OM atau OM Wilayah di tapak masing-masing

does.en: Scans the label and chooses Hand to a person, or Place at a site.
does.ms: Mengimbas label dan memilih Hand to a person, atau Place at a site.

does.en: Confirms or disputes it under My items.
does.ms: Mengesahkan atau mempertikaikannya di bawah My items.

does.en: Takes it back into the store, sends it to the laundry or for repair, records a site check (moves nothing) or reports it missing.
does.ms: Mengambil balik ke stor, menghantar ke dobi atau untuk dibaiki, merekod semakan tapak (tiada pergerakan) atau melaporkannya hilang.

rules.en: Only the person the item was handed to confirms it.
rules.ms: Hanya orang yang menerima barang boleh mengesahkannya.

rules.en: A uniform counts in the guard’s allowance: 3 free pieces in 12 months, more only with the guard’s paid receipt.
rules.ms: Uniform dikira dalam elaun pengawal: 3 helai percuma dalam 12 bulan, lebih hanya dengan resit bayaran pengawal.

rules.en: A scan never gives access: another company’s label shows “not found”.
rules.ms: Imbasan tidak memberi akses: label syarikat lain ditunjuk “tidak dijumpai”.

statusNote.en: The guard’s confirmation on the shared post device with a face check waits for the face engine; meanwhile the person confirms in their own sign-in.
statusNote.ms: Pengesahan pengawal pada peranti pos dengan semakan muka menunggu enjin muka; buat masa ini orang itu mengesahkan melalui log masuk sendiri.

sops.words: handover serah issue hand over confirm sahkan my items barang saya laundry dobi repair baiki return

title.en: Send and receive items between companies or sites
title.ms: Hantar dan terima barang antara syarikat atau tapak

purpose.en: A sale (for example Goodwill to a security company), transfer, rental, loan or supplier return: pick, send, and the receiving side scans each unit in.
purpose.ms: Jualan (contohnya Goodwill kepada syarikat keselamatan), pindahan, sewaan, pinjaman atau pulangan kepada pembekal: pilih, hantar, dan pihak penerima mengimbas setiap unit.

starter.en: The sending store or company

does.en: Creates the movement, scans the units onto it and dispatches it (in transit).
does.ms: Membuka pergerakan, mengimbas unit ke dalamnya dan menghantarnya (dalam perjalanan).

who.en: Receiving store, site supervisor or the area OM (never the sender)
who.ms: Stor penerima, penyelia tapak atau OM kawasan (bukan penghantar)

does.en: Scans each unit that arrived (or pastes an RFID reader’s list); marks damaged, missing or wrong items. Unscanned units stay waiting.
does.ms: Mengimbas setiap unit yang tiba (atau menampal senarai pembaca RFID); menanda barang rosak, hilang atau salah. Unit yang tidak diimbas kekal menunggu.

who.en: Seller and buyer Finance, buyer’s manager
who.ms: Kewangan penjual dan pembeli, pengurus pembeli

does.en: For a sale, the four papers: receipt, seller’s invoice, buyer’s payment slip, and the buyer’s letter acknowledging only items received in good order.
does.ms: Bagi jualan, empat kertas: resit, invois penjual, slip bayaran pembeli, dan surat pembeli yang mengakui hanya barang yang diterima dalam keadaan baik.

does.en: Records when ownership passes, after the last paper. Seller and buyer both follow the item afterwards.
does.ms: Merekod bila pemilikan berpindah, selepas kertas terakhir. Penjual dan pembeli sama-sama mengikuti barang selepas itu.

rules.en: The sender can never receive; there is never a false full receipt.
rules.ms: Penghantar tidak boleh menerima; tiada penerimaan penuh palsu.

rules.en: Rental and loan keep the owner and the due-back date; a supplier return points at the original sale.
rules.ms: Sewaan dan pinjaman mengekalkan pemilik dan tarikh pulang; pulangan pembekal merujuk jualan asal.

rules.en: Amounts are never entered or invented here.
rules.ms: Amaun tidak dimasukkan atau direka di sini.

sops.words: send hantar receive terima transfer pindah sale jualan rental sewa loan pinjam delivery penghantaran ownership pemilikan rfid

title.en: Count registered items at a store or site
title.ms: Kira barang berdaftar di stor atau tapak

purpose.en: Scan every label at a place; what is not found is recounted, then a manager who did not count reviews it and only then are cases opened.
purpose.ms: Imbas setiap label di sesuatu tempat; yang tidak dijumpai dikira semula, kemudian pengurus yang tidak mengira menyemak dan barulah kes dibuka.

starter.en: Store, OM or site staff, IT for IT devices
starter.ms: Stor, OM atau staf tapak, IT bagi peranti IT

does.en: Starts the count (a snapshot is taken) and scans each label, or pastes an RFID reader’s list.
does.ms: Memulakan kiraan (gambaran stok diambil) dan mengimbas setiap label, atau menampal senarai pembaca RFID.

does.en: Closes the count and recounts the units not found and the extras.
does.ms: Menutup kiraan dan mengira semula unit yang tidak dijumpai dan yang berlebihan.

does.en: Reviews with what was checked; a case opens for each difference.
does.ms: Menyemak dengan apa yang diperiksa; kes dibuka bagi setiap perbezaan.

rules.en: Not found yet is not lost; nothing is adjusted by a count.
rules.ms: Belum dijumpai bukan bermaksud hilang; kiraan tidak melaraskan apa-apa.

rules.en: Items moved after the start are listed separately.
rules.ms: Barang yang bergerak selepas kiraan bermula disenaraikan berasingan.

rules.en: Store stock (not register units) is counted in the store count on Procurement › Store.
rules.ms: Stok stor (bukan unit berdaftar) dikira dalam kiraan stor di Perolehan › Stor.

sops.words: count kiraan stock take scan imbas recount kira semula rfid

title.en: Missing, damaged or to dispose of (register case)
title.ms: Hilang, rosak atau untuk dilupus (kes daftar)

purpose.en: A registered item reported missing, found damaged at receipt, or asked to be disposed of becomes a case that a manager who did not open it decides.
purpose.ms: Barang berdaftar yang dilaporkan hilang, didapati rosak semasa diterima, atau dipohon untuk dilupuskan menjadi kes yang diputuskan oleh pengurus yang tidak membukanya.

starter.en: The holder, the store or site staff

does.en: Scans the item and presses Report missing, or (store) Ask to dispose of it.
does.ms: Mengimbas barang dan menekan Report missing, atau (stor) Ask to dispose of it.

who.en: Manager who did not open the case

does.en: Decides the case with a reason; a write-off goes to Finance to decide.
does.ms: Memutuskan kes dengan sebab; hapus kira diserahkan kepada Kewangan untuk diputuskan.

does.en: Registers a replacement with a new ID, linked both ways, when needed.
does.ms: Mendaftar gantian dengan ID baharu, dipautkan dua hala, jika perlu.

rules.en: The person who opened the case never decides it.
rules.ms: Orang yang membuka kes tidak boleh memutuskannya.

rules.en: An IT device is disposed of only through IT’s disposal record.
rules.ms: Peranti IT dilupuskan hanya melalui rekod pelupusan IT.

sops.words: missing hilang lost damaged rosak case kes dispose lupus replacement gantian

title.en: After-sale care and service

purpose.en: Even after a sale the seller looks after each unit’s service and life; the owning company sees the same list and asks for service.
purpose.ms: Walaupun selepas jualan, penjual menjaga servis dan hayat setiap unit; syarikat pemilik melihat senarai yang sama dan memohon servis.

starter.en: The owning company (service request) or the seller (service check)
starter.ms: Syarikat pemilik (permohonan servis) atau penjual (semakan servis)

does.en: Sets the service interval and expected life per item type, with the source. None is assumed.
does.ms: Menetapkan selang servis dan jangka hayat bagi setiap jenis barang, dengan sumbernya. Tiada yang diandaikan.

does.en: Asks for service on a unit.
does.ms: Memohon servis bagi sesuatu unit.

does.en: Records the service check; a damaged result opens a case for the holder.
does.ms: Merekod semakan servis; keputusan rosak membuka kes bagi pemegang.

rules.en: A service never moves the item or changes the owner.
rules.ms: Servis tidak menggerakkan barang atau menukar pemilik.

sops.words: service servis care penjagaan maintenance penyelenggaraan life hayat

title.en: Site fittings: plan, monthly check, contract-end take back
title.ms: Kelengkapan tapak: pelan, semakan bulanan, ambil balik akhir kontrak

purpose.en: Chairs, tables, fans, the guard post, CCTV and the contract’s guard equipment at each site: planned, checked every month and taken back when the contract ends.
purpose.ms: Kerusi, meja, kipas, pondok pengawal, CCTV dan peralatan pengawal kontrak di setiap tapak: dirancang, disemak setiap bulan dan diambil balik apabila kontrak tamat.

starter.en: OM or Regional OM covering the site
starter.ms: OM atau OM Wilayah yang menjaga tapak

does.en: Adds the site’s fittings (or loads them from the old list; “Add KPM guard equipment” for a KPM contract), naming the responsible person where needed.
does.ms: Menambah kelengkapan tapak (atau memuatkannya daripada senarai lama; “Add KPM guard equipment” bagi kontrak KPM), menamakan orang bertanggungjawab jika perlu.

does.en: Records the monthly check: how many are in place and broken, with a photo. A check is due after 31 days.
does.ms: Merekod semakan bulanan: berapa yang ada dan rosak, dengan gambar. Semakan perlu dibuat selepas 31 hari.

does.en: Approves giving an item to the client at contract end, with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan pemberian barang kepada klien pada akhir kontrak, dengan sebab.

does.en: At contract end records what was taken back and what was handed over, with a photo.
does.ms: Pada akhir kontrak merekod apa yang diambil balik dan apa yang diserahkan, dengan gambar.

rules.en: Everything is taken back at contract end, except what the contract hands over and what the COO or CEO decides to give.
rules.ms: Semua diambil balik pada akhir kontrak, kecuali yang diserahkan oleh kontrak dan yang diputuskan untuk diberi oleh COO atau CEO.

rules.en: Procurement and Inventory see every site, guard uniforms included; the company manager only views.
rules.ms: Perolehan dan Inventori melihat semua tapak, termasuk uniform pengawal; pengurus syarikat hanya melihat.

sops.words: fittings kelengkapan site kit tapak chair kerusi fan kipas cctv guard post pondok contract end tamat kontrak take back ambil balik

title.en: Request a company vehicle

purpose.en: Staff ask for a vehicle for a trip; the Transport head approves and picks the vehicle; each use is logged out and in with the mileage.
purpose.ms: Staf memohon kenderaan untuk perjalanan; ketua Pengangkutan meluluskan dan memilih kenderaan; setiap penggunaan direkod keluar dan masuk dengan bacaan jarak.

starter.en: Any office staff member (not guards or patrolling officers)
starter.ms: Mana-mana staf pejabat (bukan pengawal atau peronda)

does.en: Gives the purpose and the from and to times, and may ask for a particular vehicle.
does.ms: Memberi tujuan dan masa dari dan hingga, dan boleh meminta kenderaan tertentu.

does.en: Approves with the vehicle, or rejects, with a note.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan kenderaan, atau menolak, dengan catatan.

does.en: Files the driver’s consent before a monitored vehicle is driven.
does.ms: Memfailkan persetujuan pemandu sebelum kenderaan yang dipantau dipandu.

does.en: Logs the vehicle out (driver and km) and back in (km and note).
does.ms: Merekod kenderaan keluar (pemandu dan km) dan masuk semula (km dan catatan).

rules.en: Guards and patrolling officers do not request vehicles here.
rules.ms: Pengawal dan peronda tidak memohon kenderaan di sini.

rules.en: Trackers, dashcams and driver health are not connected yet, so they show Unknown.
rules.ms: Penjejak, kamera papan pemuka dan kesihatan pemandu belum disambung, jadi ia ditunjuk Tidak diketahui.

sops.words: vehicle kenderaan car kereta van transport pengangkutan book tempah trip perjalanan driver pemandu

title.en: Vehicle renewals, servicing and fuel

purpose.en: Road tax, insurance, PUSPAKOM, permits and servicing are reminded and recorded with receipts; every fill-up is recorded and flagged fill-ups are checked by someone else.
purpose.ms: Cukai jalan, insurans, PUSPAKOM, permit dan servis diingatkan dan direkod dengan resit; setiap pengisian minyak direkod dan yang ditanda disemak oleh orang lain.

starter.en: Transport head; the driver for fill-ups
starter.ms: Ketua Pengangkutan; pemandu bagi pengisian minyak

does.en: Sees what is due or overdue and records each renewal or service with its receipt and the next due date or km.
does.ms: Melihat apa yang perlu atau lewat dan merekod setiap pembaharuan atau servis dengan resit serta tarikh atau km seterusnya.

does.en: Records each fill-up of the vehicle out with them: litres, amount and how it was paid.
does.ms: Merekod setiap pengisian minyak kenderaan yang dibawa: liter, amaun dan cara bayaran.

does.en: Reviews each flagged fill-up: explained, recover from the driver, or refer for investigation, with a reason.
does.ms: Menyemak setiap pengisian yang ditanda: dijelaskan, tuntut balik daripada pemandu, atau rujuk untuk siasatan, dengan sebab.

does.en: Sets the rent of each rented vehicle with a reason; the monthly bill is a draft for Finance.
does.ms: Menetapkan sewa setiap kenderaan sewaan dengan sebab; bil bulanan ialah draf untuk Kewangan.

rules.en: Only the last 4 digits of a fuel or subsidy card are kept.
rules.ms: Hanya 4 digit terakhir kad minyak atau subsidi disimpan.

rules.en: The COO and the OGM monitor fuel use.
rules.ms: COO dan OGM memantau penggunaan minyak.

sops.words: road tax cukai jalan insurance insurans puspakom service servis fuel minyak petrol diesel card kad rental sewa

title.en: Office repair (Penyelenggaraan pejabat)

purpose.en: An office staff member reports damage at an office; the maintenance unit checks, gets quotes, does the work after approval, and the person who asked confirms it.
purpose.ms: Staf pejabat melaporkan kerosakan di pejabat; unit penyelenggaraan menyemak, mendapatkan sebut harga, melaksanakan kerja selepas kelulusan, dan orang yang melapor mengesahkannya.

starter.en: Any office staff member

does.en: Reports the damage: type, example (sets the level), area, details and photos. The level can be raised, never lowered.
does.ms: Melaporkan kerosakan: jenis, contoh (menetapkan tahap), kawasan, butiran dan gambar. Tahap boleh dinaikkan, tidak boleh diturunkan.

does.en: Checks it, visits the site and records 3 quotes (one quote is enough up to RM5,000), then picks one with a reason.
does.ms: Menyemak, melawat tapak dan merekod 3 sebut harga (satu sebut harga memadai hingga RM5,000), kemudian memilih satu dengan sebab.

who.en: Asset Director, Vice Chairman, CEO above RM50,000
who.ms: Pengarah Aset, Naib Pengerusi, CEO melebihi RM50,000

does.en: The Asset Director approves the job with a reason; the Vice Chairman consents; the CEO also above RM50,000.
does.ms: Pengarah Aset meluluskan kerja dengan sebab; Naib Pengerusi memberi persetujuan; CEO juga melebihi RM50,000.

does.en: Starts the work only after the final approval, then records it done with photos.
does.ms: Memulakan kerja hanya selepas kelulusan akhir, kemudian merekod siap dengan gambar.

does.en: Confirms it is fixed, or says it is not (reminders on day 3 and 5; the Asset Director may stand in after day 5 with a reason).
does.ms: Mengesahkan ia telah baik, atau menyatakan belum (peringatan hari ke-3 dan ke-5; Pengarah Aset boleh mengganti selepas hari ke-5 dengan sebab).

does.en: Pays in its own payments screen, never above the approved amount, and links the payment.
does.ms: Membayar melalui skrin bayaran sendiri, tidak melebihi amaun yang diluluskan, dan memautkan bayaran.

rules.en: No work before the final approval. Nobody approves, checks or confirms their own work.
rules.ms: Tiada kerja sebelum kelulusan akhir. Tiada sesiapa meluluskan, menyemak atau mengesahkan kerja sendiri.

rules.en: Targets are alerts, never a block.
rules.ms: Sasaran ialah amaran, bukan sekatan.

rules.en: IT devices go to IT as help requests.
rules.ms: Peranti IT dihantar kepada IT sebagai tiket bantuan.

statusNote.en: In force 18 Nov 2026. Email notices wait for the Outlook connection (in-app only). The report form is on Claims and requests, which not every office menu has yet.
statusNote.ms: Berkuat kuasa 18 Nov 2026. Notis e-mel menunggu sambungan Outlook (dalam aplikasi sahaja). Borang laporan ada di Tuntutan dan permohonan, yang belum ada dalam semua menu pejabat.

sops.words: office repair pembaikan pejabat damage kerosakan maintenance penyelenggaraan aircond lampu paip plumbing

title.en: Office inventory update and office asset disposal
title.ms: Kemas kini inventori pejabat dan pelupusan aset pejabat

purpose.en: Each office keeps its furniture and equipment list current; an office item no longer fit is inspected and disposed of with approval.
purpose.ms: Setiap pejabat mengemas kini senarai perabot dan peralatannya; barang pejabat yang tidak sesuai lagi diperiksa dan dilupuskan dengan kelulusan.

starter.en: Office head and named admin executives
starter.ms: Ketua pejabat dan eksekutif admin yang dinamakan

who.en: Office head or named admin executive
who.ms: Ketua pejabat atau eksekutif admin yang dinamakan

does.en: Sends the inventory update: item, place, serial, condition, holder, with documents.
does.ms: Menghantar kemas kini inventori: barang, lokasi, nombor siri, keadaan, pemegang, dengan dokumen.

does.en: The unit checks it, the Asset Director confirms it, the unit files it.
does.ms: Unit menyemak, Pengarah Aset mengesahkan, unit memfailkannya.

who.en: Anyone in the office, then the maintenance unit
who.ms: Sesiapa di pejabat, kemudian unit penyelenggaraan

does.en: Asks to dispose of an item; the unit inspects it (not fit, reuse, repair or fit) and reports.
does.ms: Memohon pelupusan barang; unit memeriksanya (tidak sesuai, guna semula, baiki atau sesuai) dan melaporkan.

who.en: Asset Director (Vice Chairman consents where needed)
who.ms: Pengarah Aset (Naib Pengerusi memberi persetujuan jika perlu)

does.en: Approves the disposal; the Vice Chairman consents at RM10,000 book value, any sale, or a gift or transfer outside the group. Finance records sale money.
does.ms: Meluluskan pelupusan; Naib Pengerusi memberi persetujuan bagi nilai buku RM10,000, sebarang jualan, atau pemberian atau pindahan ke luar kumpulan. Kewangan merekod wang jualan.

rules.en: Every approval and every changed setting needs a reason.
rules.ms: Setiap kelulusan dan setiap perubahan tetapan perlu sebab.

rules.en: IT devices are disposed of through IT’s data-wipe process.
rules.ms: Peranti IT dilupuskan melalui proses pemadaman data IT.

sops.words: office inventory inventori pejabat furniture perabot disposal pelupusan asset aset

title.en: Asset Management: ask to buy, and dispose of a fixed asset
title.ms: Pengurusan Aset: mohon beli, dan lupus aset tetap

purpose.en: Furniture, fittings and renovations: the team asks to buy, the Finance Director or COO decides, the bought item becomes an asset; at the end of its life it is disposed of with approval.
purpose.ms: Perabot, kelengkapan dan pengubahsuaian: pasukan memohon beli, Pengarah Kewangan atau COO memutuskan, barang yang dibeli menjadi aset; di akhir hayatnya ia dilupuskan dengan kelulusan.

starter.en: Asset Management team

does.en: Asks to buy: what, why, where, whose books, category, quantity and estimated cost.
does.ms: Memohon beli: apa, kenapa, di mana, buku syarikat mana, kategori, kuantiti dan anggaran kos.

who.en: Finance Director (up to RM10,000) or COO

does.en: Approves or refuses with a reason, never the person who asked.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan sebab, bukan orang yang memohon.

does.en: Records it received: tag, actual cost (not above the approved amount) and date. It becomes an asset in the register.
does.ms: Merekod diterima: tag, kos sebenar (tidak melebihi amaun diluluskan) dan tarikh. Ia menjadi aset dalam daftar.

who.en: Asset Management team; Finance Director or COO
who.ms: Pasukan Pengurusan Aset; Pengarah Kewangan atau COO

does.en: Asks to dispose; the Finance Director approves a book value up to RM10,000, the COO above; the disposal is recorded and Finance posts it with the journal number.
does.ms: Memohon pelupusan; Pengarah Kewangan meluluskan nilai buku hingga RM10,000, COO melebihi itu; pelupusan direkod dan Kewangan mengepos dengan nombor jurnal.

label.ms: Pengurusan Aset › Susut nilai dan pelupusan

rules.en: Computers and electronic items are not on this register.
rules.ms: Komputer dan barang elektronik tiada dalam daftar ini.

rules.en: A written-off asset that can still be used is kept in use or refurbished and reviewed every 12 months.
rules.ms: Aset yang telah dihapus kira tetapi masih boleh digunakan terus digunakan atau dibaik pulih dan disemak setiap 12 bulan.

sops.words: asset aset buy beli furniture perabot fittings disposal pelupusan depreciation susut nilai fixed asset

title.en: Contractor job: BQ, quotes, award and variation
title.ms: Kerja kontraktor: BQ, sebut harga, anugerah dan variasi

purpose.en: Every Asset Management job sent to a contractor: job details, a bill of quantities, quotes compared line by line, an approved award, and any price change only by a variation order.
purpose.ms: Setiap kerja Pengurusan Aset yang dihantar kepada kontraktor: butiran kerja, senarai kuantiti (BQ), sebut harga dibanding baris demi baris, anugerah yang diluluskan, dan sebarang perubahan harga hanya melalui arahan perubahan (VO).

starter.en: Maintenance executive or manager (Asset Management)

does.en: Fills the job details and site measurements, drafts the BQ from a job template, prices lines only from past awards or a stated source, and submits.
does.ms: Mengisi butiran kerja dan ukuran tapak, mendraf BQ daripada templat, meletakkan harga hanya daripada anugerah lepas atau sumber yang dinyatakan, dan menghantar.

does.en: Approves the BQ with a reason; the route is set: one quote, three quotes or open tender.
does.ms: Meluluskan BQ dengan sebab; laluan ditetapkan: satu sebut harga, tiga sebut harga atau tender terbuka.

does.en: Records each contractor’s quote line by line and asks to award; not the lowest complete quote needs a reason.
does.ms: Merekod sebut harga setiap kontraktor baris demi baris dan memohon anugerah; bukan sebut harga lengkap terendah perlu sebab.

does.en: Approves the award; the contractor and agreed price are set on the work order.
does.ms: Meluluskan anugerah; kontraktor dan harga yang dipersetujui ditetapkan pada arahan kerja.

who.en: Team, Asset Director, then CEO and Chairman
who.ms: Pasukan, Pengarah Aset, kemudian CEO dan Pengerusi

does.en: A variation order is raised with a reason, approved, then consented by the CEO and the Chairman.
does.ms: Arahan perubahan dibuka dengan sebab, diluluskan, kemudian dipersetujui oleh CEO dan Pengerusi.

rules.en: Nobody who wrote the job details or BQ approves it; when that is the Asset Director, the COO decides.
rules.ms: Sesiapa yang menulis butiran kerja atau BQ tidak boleh meluluskannya; jika itu Pengarah Aset, COO memutuskan.

rules.en: No rate is ever invented; a line with no known price stays empty.
rules.ms: Tiada kadar direka; baris tanpa harga yang diketahui dibiarkan kosong.

statusNote.en: Built. The route limits (one quote under RM5,000, three quotes to RM50,000, tender above) are proposals waiting for Fauzan’s decision.
statusNote.ms: Telah dibina. Had laluan (satu sebut harga bawah RM5,000, tiga sebut harga hingga RM50,000, tender melebihi itu) masih cadangan menunggu keputusan Fauzan.

sops.words: bq bill of quantities senarai kuantiti quote sebut harga contractor kontraktor award anugerah variation vo tender

title.en: Rental home: letting to move-out (Rumah sewa)
title.ms: Rumah sewa: dari iklan hingga keluar

purpose.en: Asset Management lets the owner companies’ homes: advert and enquiries, application and deposit, agreement and stamping, monthly rent, arrears, move-out and repairs.
purpose.ms: Pengurusan Aset menyewakan rumah syarikat pemilik: iklan dan pertanyaan, permohonan dan deposit, perjanjian dan setem, sewa bulanan, tunggakan, keluar dan pembaikan.

starter.en: Rental admin executive (Asset Management)

does.en: Proposes the rent and terms, adverts on each platform and answers enquiries within 2 office hours.
does.ms: Mencadangkan sewa dan terma, mengiklankan di setiap platform dan membalas pertanyaan dalam 2 jam pejabat.

who.en: Asset Director, then Chairman or Vice Chairman
who.ms: Pengarah Aset, kemudian Pengerusi atau Naib Pengerusi

does.en: The Asset Director approves the terms and the new tenant; the Chairman or Vice Chairman consents to the tenant.
does.ms: Pengarah Aset meluluskan terma dan penyewa baharu; Pengerusi atau Naib Pengerusi memberi persetujuan bagi penyewa.

does.en: Confirms the deposit in full from the bank; only then the agreement opens and keys are handed over through the handover gate.
does.ms: Mengesahkan deposit penuh daripada bank; barulah perjanjian dibuka dan kunci diserahkan melalui pintu serahan.

does.en: Each month Finance raises the invoice in SQL Account and records its number; payment is confirmed from the bank; arrears go to the Asset Director.
does.ms: Setiap bulan Kewangan mengeluarkan invois dalam SQL Account dan merekod nombornya; bayaran disahkan daripada bank; tunggakan dirujuk kepada Pengarah Aset.

does.en: Move-out: keys back, inspection, deposit statement within 24 hours, Finance refund in 2-3 working days.
does.ms: Keluar: kunci dipulangkan, pemeriksaan, penyata deposit dalam 24 jam, bayaran balik Kewangan dalam 2-3 hari bekerja.

rules.en: Prima never moves money, numbers an invoice or logs in to e-Duti Setem or LHDN.
rules.ms: Prima tidak memindahkan wang, menomborkan invois atau log masuk ke e-Duti Setem atau LHDN.

rules.en: No cash for homes; no lock change, removal of things or cutting utilities without the lawful step.
rules.ms: Tiada tunai bagi rumah; tiada tukar kunci, alih barang atau potong utiliti tanpa langkah yang sah.

rules.en: Repairs above RM5,000 need the Vice Chairman’s consent, above RM50,000 the CEO’s.
rules.ms: Pembaikan melebihi RM5,000 perlu persetujuan Naib Pengerusi, melebihi RM50,000 persetujuan CEO.

sops.words: rental home rumah sewa tenant penyewa deposit agreement perjanjian setem stamp duty rent sewa arrears tunggakan move out keluar

title.en: Staff house stay for a work trip
title.ms: Penginapan rumah pekerja untuk urusan kerja

purpose.en: Government Operations or an HQ department asks for a company house for staff on a trip; the price is shown before sending; the Asset team checks.
purpose.ms: Operasi Kerajaan atau jabatan HQ memohon rumah syarikat bagi staf yang bertugas luar; harga ditunjuk sebelum dihantar; pasukan Aset menyemak.

label.en: Mohon rumah pekerja / Staff house stay

starter.en: Government Operations or an HQ department

does.en: Gives the house or town, dates, occupants from the staff list, who takes the keys and the purpose.
does.ms: Memberi rumah atau bandar, tarikh, penghuni daripada senarai staf, penerima kunci dan tujuan.

does.en: Checks the request and the house calendar; nobody confirms their own request.
does.ms: Menyemak permohonan dan kalendar rumah; tiada sesiapa mengesahkan permohonan sendiri.

does.en: A work stay is billed to the department; a private stay is confirmed once Finance sees the transfer.
does.ms: Penginapan kerja dibil kepada jabatan; penginapan peribadi disahkan apabila Kewangan melihat pemindahan.

rules.en: RM300 a person a night (a dated setting).
rules.ms: RM300 seorang semalam (tetapan bertarikh).

rules.en: Damage is deducted from the named staff member’s pay only after they acknowledge it in Prima with the written consent wording.
rules.ms: Kerosakan dipotong daripada gaji staf yang dinamakan hanya selepas dia mengakuinya dalam Prima dengan ayat persetujuan bertulis.

sops.words: staff house rumah pekerja stay penginapan homestay trip outstation

title.en: Homestay and Airbnb booking

purpose.en: One calendar per house for direct, Airbnb and staff stays: hold, deposit, full payment, keys, check-out and inspection.
purpose.ms: Satu kalendar bagi setiap rumah untuk tempahan terus, Airbnb dan staf: tahan, deposit, bayaran penuh, kunci, daftar keluar dan pemeriksaan.

starter.en: Asset Management team

does.en: Direct: keys the form while talking to the customer (PDPA consent ticked); held 3 working days for the deposit. Airbnb: enters the reservation and answers within 20 hours.
does.ms: Terus: mengisi borang semasa bercakap dengan pelanggan (persetujuan PDPA ditanda); ditahan 3 hari bekerja untuk deposit. Airbnb: memasukkan tempahan dan menjawab dalam 20 jam.

does.en: Alone confirms each payment in the bank and issues the receipt number; matches each Airbnb payout.
does.ms: Sahaja yang mengesahkan setiap bayaran dalam bank dan mengeluarkan nombor resit; memadankan setiap bayaran Airbnb.

does.en: Hands keys only when all conditions hold; at check-out counts keys, inspects with photos and marks the house for cleaning.
does.ms: Menyerahkan kunci hanya apabila semua syarat dipenuhi; semasa keluar mengira kunci, memeriksa dengan gambar dan menanda rumah untuk dibersihkan.

rules.en: Overlapping nights are refused whatever the channel.
rules.ms: Malam yang bertindih ditolak walau apa pun salurannya.

rules.en: Full payment 3 days before check-in; Airbnb damage is claimed through Airbnb only.
rules.ms: Bayaran penuh 3 hari sebelum daftar masuk; tuntutan kerosakan Airbnb hanya melalui Airbnb.

rules.en: No WhatsApp sending, Airbnb login or calendar link from Prima.
rules.ms: Tiada penghantaran WhatsApp, log masuk Airbnb atau pautan kalendar dari Prima.

sops.words: homestay airbnb booking tempahan guest tetamu deposit keys kunci check in check out

title.en: WhatsApp rent reminders

purpose.en: Tenants who agreed get a WhatsApp reminder before and after rent is due; the team sees each reminder on the unit.
purpose.ms: Penyewa yang bersetuju menerima peringatan WhatsApp sebelum dan selepas sewa perlu dibayar; pasukan melihat setiap peringatan pada unit.

starter.en: Asset Management rental team

does.en: Records how each tenant agreed to reminders (signed form or WhatsApp reply), or stops them.
does.ms: Merekod cara setiap penyewa bersetuju menerima peringatan (borang bertandatangan atau balasan WhatsApp), atau menghentikannya.

does.en: When switched on, sends a reminder 3 days before, on the due date, 7 days late and every 10 days while unpaid, 9 am to 6 pm, once a day per tenant.
does.ms: Apabila dihidupkan, menghantar peringatan 3 hari sebelum, pada tarikh, 7 hari lewat dan setiap 10 hari selagi belum bayar, 9 pagi hingga 6 petang, sekali sehari bagi setiap penyewa.

rules.en: A tenant who replies STOP or BERHENTI is never messaged again.
rules.ms: Penyewa yang membalas STOP atau BERHENTI tidak akan dihubungi lagi.

rules.en: After 90 days late the team’s letter takes over, with the Asset Director’s approval.
rules.ms: Selepas 90 hari lewat, surat pasukan mengambil alih, dengan kelulusan Pengarah Aset.

statusNote.en: Built but not connected: no WhatsApp Business number, templates or token. The reminder days are proposals for the Asset Director.
statusNote.ms: Telah dibina tetapi belum disambung: tiada nombor WhatsApp Business, templat atau token. Hari peringatan masih cadangan untuk Pengarah Aset.

sops.words: whatsapp reminder peringatan rent sewa tenant penyewa

title.en: Office staff leave

purpose.en: An office staff member asks for annual, sick, maternity, paternity or other leave; HR decides with a comment and the Vice Chairman consents.
purpose.ms: Staf pejabat memohon cuti tahunan, sakit, bersalin, isteri bersalin atau cuti lain; HR memutuskan dengan komen dan Naib Pengerusi memberi persetujuan.

starter.en: The staff member, their line manager, or HR
starter.ms: Staf itu sendiri, pengurus barisnya, atau HR

does.en: Picks the kind of leave, the dates and the reason; for sick leave also the illness, the clinic, the MC serial number and a photo of the MC. Working days are counted for you: weekends and your state’s public holidays do not count.
does.ms: Pilih jenis cuti, tarikh dan sebab; untuk cuti sakit juga penyakit, klinik, nombor siri MC dan gambar MC. Hari bekerja dikira automatik: hujung minggu dan cuti umum negeri anda tidak dikira.

does.en: Approves or refuses with a comment.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan komen.

label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Cuti dan cuti umum

does.en: Consents or refuses, with a comment. During the pilot the CEO may stand in, but never on a request he approved for HR.
does.ms: Memberi persetujuan atau menolak, dengan komen. Semasa perintis CEO boleh menggantikan, tetapi tidak bagi permohonan yang dia sendiri luluskan bagi pihak HR.

label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Cuti dan cuti umum

does.en: Sees the answer. If refused, reads the reason and presses “Correct and send again” to make a new request; the refused one stays on record.
does.ms: Melihat jawapan. Jika ditolak, baca sebabnya dan tekan “Correct and send again” untuk membuat permohonan baharu; yang ditolak kekal dalam rekod.

rules.en: Every approval needs a comment, and nobody approves their own.
rules.ms: Setiap kelulusan perlu komen, dan tiada sesiapa meluluskan permohonannya sendiri.

rules.en: A request nobody answers within 12 hours moves up a level.
rules.ms: Permohonan yang tidak dijawab dalam 12 jam naik ke peringkat seterusnya.

rules.en: Refused at once: annual or unpaid leave asked after the day, more than 60 days, or a missing or already used MC.
rules.ms: Ditolak serta-merta: cuti tahunan atau tanpa gaji yang dipohon selepas hari itu, lebih 60 hari, atau MC yang tiada atau sudah digunakan.

rules.en: Sick leave and hospitalisation are separate: 14, 18 or 22 sick days a year by years of service, plus 60 hospitalisation days.
rules.ms: Cuti sakit dan cuti hospital adalah berasingan: 14, 18 atau 22 hari cuti sakit setahun mengikut tempoh perkhidmatan, ditambah 60 hari cuti hospital.

rules.en: Maternity is 98 consecutive days; paternity is 7 consecutive days for a married man with 12 months of service. HR may give more than the Act, never less, and never to themselves.
rules.ms: Cuti bersalin 98 hari berturut-turut; cuti isteri bersalin 7 hari berturut-turut bagi lelaki berkahwin dengan 12 bulan perkhidmatan. HR boleh memberi lebih daripada Akta, tidak kurang, dan tidak kepada diri sendiri.

rules.en: Unused annual leave lapses on 31 December (no carry-forward); staff see a reminder in November and December.
rules.ms: Cuti tahunan yang tidak digunakan luput pada 31 Disember (tiada bawa ke hadapan); staf melihat peringatan pada November dan Disember.

rules.en: The CEO can switch the Vice Chairman’s step off on Home, with a reason; HR’s approval is then final.
rules.ms: CEO boleh mematikan langkah Naib Pengerusi di Laman Utama, dengan sebab; kelulusan HR kemudian menjadi muktamad.

sops.words: leave cuti annual tahunan sick sakit mc hospital maternity bersalin paternity apply mohon vice chairman naib pengerusi

title.en: A guard’s no-show: alert, follow-up and discipline
title.ms: Pengawal tidak hadir: amaran, tindakan susulan dan disiplin

purpose.en: When a guard misses clock-in or fails a check, the company acts quickly; repeated absence can lead to a recorded disciplinary step.
purpose.ms: Apabila pengawal tidak daftar masuk atau gagal semakan, syarikat bertindak segera; ketidakhadiran berulang boleh membawa kepada langkah disiplin yang direkodkan.

starter.en: Prima, when a guard misses clock-in or fails a check
starter.ms: Prima, apabila pengawal tidak daftar masuk atau gagal semakan

does.en: Alerts the company PIC every 5 minutes until someone acts (“Alerting the PIC now”). CMS sees the same alert and may call the guard.
does.ms: Memberi amaran kepada PIC syarikat setiap 5 minit sehingga seseorang bertindak (“Alerting the PIC now”). CMS melihat amaran yang sama dan boleh menelefon pengawal.

does.en: Acts: contacts the guard, sends a replacement to the post, or excuses it with a reason.
does.ms: Bertindak: menghubungi pengawal, menghantar pengganti ke pos, atau memaafkan dengan sebab.

does.en: May step in for the company when the PIC has not acted within 15 minutes.
does.ms: Boleh mengambil alih bagi syarikat jika PIC tidak bertindak dalam 15 minit.

does.en: Records a disciplinary step for repeated absence. Prima suggests the handbook step but never issues it.
does.ms: Merekod langkah disiplin bagi ketidakhadiran berulang. Prima mencadangkan langkah buku panduan tetapi tidak sekali-kali mengeluarkannya.

does.en: May appeal a warning, suspension, downgrade or dismissal within 14 days.
does.ms: Boleh merayu amaran, penggantungan, penurunan pangkat atau pemecatan dalam 14 hari.

rules.en: Discipline is never automatic: a person decides and records it.
rules.ms: Disiplin tidak sekali-kali automatik: seseorang memutuskan dan merekodkannya.

rules.en: A late arrival or early leave the company excused, with its reason and proof, counts in full for pay.
rules.ms: Lewat tiba atau balik awal yang dimaafkan syarikat, dengan sebab dan bukti, dikira penuh untuk gaji.

statusNote.en: Guard attendance still comes from the JA Group app for about a year (from Nov 2026); the JA app sends it to Prima.
statusNote.ms: Kehadiran pengawal masih datang daripada aplikasi JA Group selama kira-kira setahun (dari Nov 2026); aplikasi JA menghantarnya ke Prima.

source.decided: W2; Fauzan, 4 Nov 2026 (JA for about a year)

sops.words: no show tidak hadir absent alert amaran pic replacement pengganti discipline disiplin warning amaran attendance kehadiran

title.en: Time slip: a few hours out of the office
title.ms: Slip masa: keluar pejabat beberapa jam

purpose.en: Staff ask to leave the office for up to 4 hours on their own matters and work the hours back within 30 days.
purpose.ms: Staf memohon keluar pejabat sehingga 4 jam atas urusan sendiri dan menggantikan jam itu dalam 30 hari.

starter.en: Any office staff member

does.en: Asks for a slip: the date, time out and time back, inside office hours (08:30 to 17:30), at most 4 hours, up to 30 days ahead and never for a past day.
does.ms: Memohon slip: tarikh, masa keluar dan masa balik, dalam waktu pejabat (08:30 hingga 17:30), paling lama 4 jam, sehingga 30 hari lebih awal dan tidak untuk hari yang telah lepas.

who.en: Company head or department head (HR when there is no head above the person)
who.ms: Ketua syarikat atau ketua jabatan (HR jika tiada ketua di atas orang itu)

does.en: Approves with a comment or refuses with a reason, under “Waiting for you to approve”.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan komen atau menolak dengan sebab, di bawah “Waiting for you to approve”.

does.en: Is told of every approval and marks it seen.
does.ms: Dimaklumkan setiap kelulusan dan menandanya sebagai dilihat.

does.en: Works the hours back within 30 days, after 17:30, on a clock closed by signing out.
does.ms: Menggantikan jam itu dalam 30 hari, selepas 17:30, pada jam kerja yang ditutup dengan log keluar.

does.en: After 30 days, hours not worked back are taken from annual leave in half days (4 hours each); with no annual leave left the rest is unpaid leave for HR to see.
does.ms: Selepas 30 hari, jam yang belum diganti diambil daripada cuti tahunan dalam setengah hari (4 jam setiap satu); jika cuti tahunan habis, bakinya menjadi cuti tanpa gaji untuk dilihat HR.

rules.en: Every approval needs a comment, and nobody approves their own.
rules.ms: Setiap kelulusan perlu komen, dan tiada sesiapa meluluskan permohonannya sendiri.

rules.en: HR’s own slips go to the HR Director.
rules.ms: Slip HR sendiri pergi kepada Pengarah HR.

rules.en: HR may change the approver setting to “HR approves” and back, always with a reason.
rules.ms: HR boleh menukar tetapan pelulus kepada “HR approves” dan sebaliknya, sentiasa dengan sebab.

rules.en: A clock Prima closed, or one where the door shows you left before signing out, does not count as make-up time.
rules.ms: Jam kerja yang ditutup oleh Prima, atau yang pintu menunjukkan anda keluar sebelum log keluar, tidak dikira sebagai masa ganti.

rules.en: You may cancel a slip still waiting, or an approved slip before its day.
rules.ms: Anda boleh membatalkan slip yang masih menunggu, atau slip yang diluluskan sebelum harinya.

statusNote.en: Not yet: the Staff clock board still shows the time away as a long break, and payroll does not read unpaid leave from slips yet.
statusNote.ms: Belum lagi: papan Jam kerja staf masih menunjukkan masa keluar sebagai rehat panjang, dan gaji belum membaca cuti tanpa gaji daripada slip.

does.ms: Pada hari di rumah menghantar pelan, daftar masuk pada waktu yang ditetapkan dan menghantar laporan akhir hari.

does.en: Reviews the home days.
does.ms: Menyemak hari-hari bekerja di rumah.

label.ms: Jam kerja staf › Bekerja dari rumah

rules.en: Only HR answers applications; the company manager does not.
rules.ms: Hanya HR menjawab permohonan; pengurus syarikat tidak.

rules.en: When HR stops it, any open or approved arrangement ends, with HR’s reason.
rules.ms: Apabila HR menghentikannya, sebarang susunan terbuka atau diluluskan tamat, dengan sebab HR.

rules.en: Every approval needs a comment, and nobody approves their own.
rules.ms: Setiap kelulusan perlu komen, dan tiada sesiapa meluluskan permohonannya sendiri.

label.en: Clock › Ask for flexible hours or days
label.ms: Jam kerja › Mohon waktu atau hari kerja fleksibel

does.en: Answers in writing with a comment; a refusal gives the grounds.

label.en: Clock › Ask for flexible hours or days
label.ms: Jam kerja › Mohon waktu atau hari kerja fleksibel

rules.ms: HR menjawab dalam 60 hari; jawapan lewat menjadi merah di Laman Utama HR.

rules.en: Nobody answers their own request.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa menjawab permohonannya sendiri.

title.en: Office staff overtime

purpose.en: Once HR switches it on for a person, staff claim overtime already worked; their head approves and payroll pays it.
purpose.ms: Setelah HR menghidupkannya bagi seseorang, staf menuntut kerja lebih masa yang telah dibuat; ketua meluluskan dan gaji membayarnya.

starter.en: A staff member HR has ticked for overtime
starter.ms: Staf yang ditanda HR untuk kerja lebih masa

does.en: Turns overtime on, sets the rates and ticks who may claim, each change with a reason.
does.ms: Menghidupkan kerja lebih masa, menetapkan kadar dan menanda siapa boleh menuntut, setiap perubahan dengan sebab.

does.en: Claims hours already worked: the date, hours, kind of day and reason.
does.ms: Menuntut jam yang telah dikerjakan: tarikh, jam, jenis hari dan sebab.

who.en: The head who approves their time slips
who.ms: Ketua yang meluluskan slip masa mereka

does.en: Approves or refuses with a comment.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan komen.

does.en: The staff payroll run pays approved hours only while overtime is on for that person.
does.ms: Larian gaji staf membayar jam yang diluluskan hanya selagi kerja lebih masa dihidupkan bagi orang itu.

rules.en: Rates are never below the Act: 1.5 times on a normal day, 2 times on a rest day, 3 times on a public holiday.
rules.ms: Kadar tidak sekali-kali di bawah Akta: 1.5 kali pada hari biasa, 2 kali pada hari rehat, 3 kali pada cuti umum.

rules.en: Pay is basic / 26 / 8 × hours × rate.
rules.ms: Bayaran ialah gaji pokok / 26 / 8 × jam × kadar.

rules.en: Staff above the Act’s RM4,000 wage limit are marked; HR decides for them.
rules.ms: Staf melebihi had gaji RM4,000 dalam Akta ditanda; HR memutuskan bagi mereka.

rules.en: Every approval needs a comment, and nobody approves their own.
rules.ms: Setiap kelulusan perlu komen, dan tiada sesiapa meluluskan permohonannya sendiri.

statusNote.en: Built and installed, but off until HR switches it on and sets the rates (most staff earn above RM4,000).
statusNote.ms: Sudah dibina dan dipasang, tetapi dimatikan sehingga HR menghidupkannya dan menetapkan kadar (kebanyakan staf bergaji melebihi RM4,000).

source.decided: Fauzan, 2 Nov 2026; Fitri package A9, 11 Nov 2026

purpose.ms: Staf mendaftar wajah sekali; HR meluluskan gambar; selepas itu setiap log masuk meminta semakan wajah ringkas.

starter.en: Any office staff member, on their own phone
starter.ms: Mana-mana staf pejabat, di telefon sendiri

does.en: Registers their face once on My clock, on their own phone.
does.ms: Mendaftar wajah sekali di Jam kerja saya, di telefon sendiri.

who.ms: Pentadbir HR, Ketua Staf atau Timbalan

does.en: Looks at the photo and approves or refuses it with a comment.
does.ms: Melihat gambar dan meluluskan atau menolaknya dengan komen.

label.en: Staff clock › Faces waiting for HR
label.ms: Jam kerja staf › Wajah menunggu HR

does.en: At each sign-in presses “Check my face”; until then the clock shows “Face check not done”.
does.ms: Pada setiap log masuk tekan “Check my face”; sebelum itu jam menunjukkan “Face check not done”.

does.en: Spot-checks the face-check photos kept on each clock record.
does.ms: Menyemak rambang gambar semakan wajah yang disimpan pada setiap rekod jam kerja.

label.ms: Jam kerja staf › Jam hari ini

rules.en: Nobody approves their own face.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa meluluskan wajahnya sendiri.

rules.en: The server compares the face; a score sent by the phone is ignored.
rules.ms: Pelayan membandingkan wajah; skor yang dihantar telefon diabaikan.

rules.en: Without an approved face, clocking is by a time-stamped photo only.
rules.ms: Tanpa wajah yang diluluskan, daftar masuk hanya dengan gambar bercop masa.

rules.en: Guards clock in by face on the site device instead.
rules.ms: Pengawal pula daftar masuk dengan wajah di peranti tapak.

statusNote.en: Face and location need the person’s signed PDPA consent, collected on paper by the PDPA officer. Prima’s consent gate is a switch, still off until the PDPA officer or the CoS turns it on.
statusNote.ms: Wajah dan lokasi memerlukan persetujuan PDPA bertandatangan orang itu, dikumpul atas kertas oleh pegawai PDPA. Pintu persetujuan Prima ialah suis, masih dimatikan sehingga pegawai PDPA atau Ketua Staf menghidupkannya.

title.en: A new office staff member joins

purpose.en: HR keys the new staff member once; IT, Finance and the other desks get their part; HR files the statutory forms and confirms probation.
purpose.ms: HR memasukkan staf baharu sekali; IT, Kewangan dan meja lain menerima bahagian masing-masing; HR menghantar borang berkanun dan mengesahkan percubaan.

starter.en: HR, after the vacancy is approved and signed
starter.ms: HR, selepas jawatan kosong diluluskan dan ditandatangani

does.en: Starts from the approved vacancy and the offer letter, and keys the staff form once: staff number, name, job, branch, employment type, start and probation dates, full IC, salary account and basic pay.
does.ms: Bermula daripada jawatan kosong yang diluluskan dan surat tawaran, dan mengisi borang staf sekali: nombor staf, nama, jawatan, cawangan, jenis pekerjaan, tarikh mula dan tamat percubaan, IC penuh, akaun gaji dan gaji pokok.

does.en: HR opens the HR/IT joining request; IT prepares the Microsoft account, the device and Prima access.
does.ms: HR membuka permohonan masuk HR/IT; IT menyediakan akaun Microsoft, peranti dan akses Prima.

who.en: Finance, Chief of Staff, company office

does.en: Get their hand-overs: Finance adds the person to staff payroll, the Chief of Staff checks group medical cover, the company office is told.
does.ms: Menerima serah tugas masing-masing: Kewangan menambah orang itu ke gaji staf, Ketua Staf menyemak perlindungan perubatan berkumpulan, pejabat syarikat dimaklumkan.

does.en: Files CP22 and the SOCSO and EIS registration within 30 days, and EPF from the first month (by the 15th of the next month), then records each with its reference (“Filed today”).
does.ms: Menghantar CP22 dan pendaftaran PERKESO dan SIP dalam 30 hari, dan KWSP dari bulan pertama (sebelum 15 hari bulan berikutnya), kemudian merekod setiap satu dengan rujukannya (“Filed today”).

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: Confirms or extends probation with a comment when it is due (reminded 14 days before).
does.ms: Mengesahkan atau melanjutkan tempoh percubaan dengan komen apabila tiba masanya (diingatkan 14 hari lebih awal).

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

rules.en: The full IC and salary account sit behind the HR wall; other screens show only the last digits.
rules.ms: IC penuh dan akaun gaji disimpan di sebalik dinding HR; skrin lain hanya menunjukkan digit terakhir.

rules.en: Never ask anyone for a password or an MFA code.
rules.ms: Jangan sekali-kali meminta kata laluan atau kod MFA daripada sesiapa.

rules.en: Prima drafts and reminds; HR files with LHDN, KWSP and PERKESO and records the reference. Prima never files.
rules.ms: Prima menyediakan draf dan mengingatkan; HR menghantar kepada LHDN, KWSP dan PERKESO dan merekod rujukan. Prima tidak menghantar.

rules.en: HR never confirms their own probation.
rules.ms: HR tidak mengesahkan tempoh percubaannya sendiri.

title.en: An office staff member leaves

purpose.en: HR records the last day, checks the leaving guide and final pay, access closes, IT collects devices and HR files CP22A.
purpose.ms: HR merekod hari terakhir, menyemak panduan berhenti dan gaji akhir, akses ditutup, IT mengutip peranti dan HR menghantar CP22A.

starter.en: HR

does.en: Records on the staff form how they are leaving (resigned, ended by the company, contract ended, retired), the notice date, the last working day and the reason.
does.ms: Merekod di borang staf cara berhenti (letak jawatan, ditamatkan syarikat, tamat kontrak, bersara), tarikh notis, hari bekerja terakhir dan sebab.

does.en: Opens the leaving guide: the notice under the Act (4, 6 or 8 weeks), the termination benefit, the handbook’s resignation procedure and Prima’s working of the final pay for HR to check.
does.ms: Membuka panduan berhenti: notis di bawah Akta (4, 6 atau 8 minggu), faedah penamatan, prosedur letak jawatan dalam buku panduan dan kiraan gaji akhir Prima untuk disemak HR.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining and leaving › Leaving guide
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Staf masuk dan keluar › Panduan berhenti

does.en: Access closes from the day after the last day, or now with “Close access” and a reason.
does.ms: Akses ditutup mulai hari selepas hari terakhir, atau sekarang dengan “Close access” dan sebab.

does.en: The HR/IT leaving request asks IT to remove access and collect devices; the store lists items to collect.
does.ms: Permohonan berhenti HR/IT meminta IT membuang akses dan mengutip peranti; stor menyenaraikan barang untuk dikutip.

does.en: Files CP22A with LHDN (at least 30 days before the last day) and records the reference; the EA figures are drafted from paid payroll.
does.ms: Menghantar CP22A kepada LHDN (sekurang-kurangnya 30 hari sebelum hari terakhir) dan merekod rujukan; angka EA disediakan daripada gaji yang telah dibayar.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

rules.en: A termination recorded around maternity leave shows to HR in red (Employment Act s.41A).
rules.ms: Penamatan yang direkod sekitar cuti bersalin ditunjukkan kepada HR dalam warna merah (Akta Kerja s.41A).

rules.en: Retrenchment: a fair method, consultation, Form PK to JTK at least 30 days before, CP22A, and keeping the records.
rules.ms: Pemberhentian (retrenchment): kaedah adil, perundingan, Borang PK kepada JTK sekurang-kurangnya 30 hari lebih awal, CP22A, dan menyimpan rekod.

rules.en: Personnel records are kept 7 years after the last day.
rules.ms: Rekod kakitangan disimpan 7 tahun selepas hari terakhir.

rules.en: Staff at or near 60 are listed for HR with their leaving guide.
rules.ms: Staf yang berumur atau hampir 60 tahun disenaraikan untuk HR bersama panduan berhenti.

title.en: Vacancy, job post and applicants
title.ms: Jawatan kosong, iklan jawatan dan pemohon

purpose.en: A post is raised, the CEO approves, the company head signs; then the job post is written, approved and posted, and HR keeps the applicants.
purpose.ms: Jawatan dibuka, CEO meluluskan, ketua syarikat menandatangani; kemudian iklan jawatan ditulis, diluluskan dan disiarkan, dan HR menyimpan senarai pemohon.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving

starter.en: HR, or the company manager for their own company
starter.ms: HR, atau pengurus syarikat bagi syarikatnya sendiri

does.en: Raises the vacancy: company, title, department, headcount, reason and pay range; whether it is for office staff, a guard or a patrolling officer (with the state).
does.ms: Membuka jawatan kosong: syarikat, jawatan, jabatan, bilangan, sebab dan julat gaji; sama ada untuk staf pejabat, pengawal atau peronda (dengan negeri).

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: Approves or refuses with a comment, never a vacancy he raised.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan komen, tidak sekali-kali jawatan yang dia sendiri buka.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: Signs the approval on Company today. For a PWVSB central post the CEO’s approval is also the signature.
does.ms: Menandatangani kelulusan di Syarikat hari ini. Bagi jawatan pusat PWVSB, kelulusan CEO juga menjadi tandatangan.

does.en: Writes the job post; “Draft for me” makes a Malay and English draft from the job facts.
does.ms: Menulis iklan jawatan; “Draft for me” menyediakan draf Bahasa Melayu dan Inggeris daripada fakta jawatan.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

who.en: HR Director (office posts) or the OM covering the state (guard and officer posts)
who.ms: Pengarah HR (jawatan pejabat) atau OM negeri itu (jawatan pengawal dan peronda)

does.en: Approves or sends back with a comment; never the person who wrote the wording. The Regional OM approves as backup when the OM is away.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau memulangkan dengan komen; tidak sekali-kali orang yang menulis teks itu. OM Wilayah meluluskan sebagai ganti apabila OM tiada.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: Posts it by hand and records the link, then keeps the applicant list: new, shortlisted, interview, offered, hired, or not taken. Hiring then uses the joining steps.
does.ms: Menyiarkannya secara manual dan merekod pautan, kemudian menyimpan senarai pemohon: baharu, disenarai pendek, temu duga, ditawarkan, diambil, atau tidak diambil. Pengambilan kemudian mengikut langkah masuk kerja.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

rules.en: Every step needs a comment.
rules.ms: Setiap langkah perlu komen.

rules.en: An IC number, or a phone number that is not the official one in “How to apply”, blocks the post.
rules.ms: Nombor IC, atau nombor telefon yang bukan nombor rasmi dalam “How to apply”, menghalang iklan itu.

rules.en: Applicants are seen only by HR, the HR Director and the CEO. No IC number, CV or photo is kept.
rules.ms: Pemohon hanya dilihat oleh HR, Pengarah HR dan CEO. Tiada nombor IC, CV atau gambar disimpan.

rules.en: Any edit sends the post back to draft and clears the approval.
rules.ms: Sebarang suntingan mengembalikan iklan kepada draf dan membatalkan kelulusan.

statusNote.en: Social media and JobStreet are not connected: HR posts by hand and records the link.
statusNote.ms: Media sosial dan JobStreet belum disambung: HR menyiarkan secara manual dan merekod pautan.

source.decided: Fauzan, 2 and 5 Nov 2026; C2, 11 Nov 2026 (CEO signs central posts)

title.en: Promotion, transfer or secondment

purpose.en: HR prepares a staff movement; the right people approve; it takes effect only on its date, when HR or the CEO applies it.
purpose.ms: HR menyediakan pergerakan staf; pihak yang betul meluluskan; ia berkuat kuasa hanya pada tarikhnya, apabila HR atau CEO melaksanakannya.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

starter.en: HR only

does.en: Prepares the movement with a comment. Only one waiting movement per person.
does.ms: Menyediakan pergerakan dengan komen. Hanya satu pergerakan menunggu bagi setiap orang.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: Promotion: the HR Director, then the CEO, then the Vice Chairman consents. Transfer: the receiving company head accepts (on Company today), then the HR Director. Secondment: the host company head, then the HR Director, then the CEO consents.
does.ms: Kenaikan pangkat: Pengarah HR, kemudian CEO, kemudian Naib Pengerusi memberi persetujuan. Pertukaran: ketua syarikat penerima menerima (di Syarikat hari ini), kemudian Pengarah HR. Pinjaman: ketua syarikat tuan rumah, kemudian Pengarah HR, kemudian CEO memberi persetujuan.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: On or after the effective date presses “Apply movements due today”.
does.ms: Pada atau selepas tarikh berkuat kuasa tekan “Apply movements due today”.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: After a transfer, authorises the login handover with a reason (never the preparer, the applier or the person moved).
does.ms: Selepas pertukaran, membenarkan serahan log masuk dengan sebab (bukan penyedia, pelaksana atau orang yang dipindahkan).

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

does.en: Moves the login through the account process, then confirms in Prima under “Login handovers after a transfer”.
does.ms: Memindahkan log masuk melalui proses akaun, kemudian mengesahkan dalam Prima di bawah “Login handovers after a transfer”.

rules.en: Nobody approves their own preparation, a movement of themselves, or two steps of the same movement. Every step needs a comment.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa meluluskan persediaannya sendiri, pergerakan dirinya, atau dua langkah bagi pergerakan yang sama. Setiap langkah perlu komen.

rules.en: A transfer is a fresh employment by law; the record keeps when the person joined the group.
rules.ms: Pertukaran ialah pekerjaan baharu dari segi undang-undang; rekod mengekalkan tarikh orang itu menyertai kumpulan.

rules.en: Nothing changes on any record until the effective date.
rules.ms: Tiada apa berubah pada mana-mana rekod sehingga tarikh berkuat kuasa.

rules.en: A movement is not applied while a payroll month from its effective month is already submitted; HR returns and recalculates that month first.
rules.ms: Pergerakan tidak dilaksanakan selagi bulan gaji bagi bulan berkuat kuasanya sudah dihantar; HR memulangkan dan mengira semula bulan itu dahulu.

purpose.en: Every group company’s record of the same person is linked, so HR and leaders can see where someone worked before and any “do not hire again” mark.
purpose.ms: Rekod setiap syarikat kumpulan bagi orang yang sama dipautkan, supaya HR dan pemimpin boleh melihat di mana seseorang pernah bekerja dan sebarang tanda “jangan ambil semula”.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

starter.en: HR; the Regional OM, OGM, Operations Director, COO and other group leaders by typing the IC or passport
