does.ms: Memautkan rekod melalui IC atau pasport setiap kali nombor disimpan. HR (staf tempatan) atau FWM (pekerja asing) memautkan pasport baharu atau IC lama secara manual, dengan sebab.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

who.en: Regional OM, OGM, Operations Director, COO
who.ms: OM Wilayah, OGM, Pengarah Operasi, COO

does.en: Types the IC or passport to see that one person’s summary: each group company, job, dates and the rehire mark.
does.ms: Menaip IC atau pasport untuk melihat ringkasan orang itu sahaja: setiap syarikat kumpulan, jawatan, tarikh dan tanda pengambilan semula.

does.en: Marks “Can be hired again” or “Check with HR before hiring”, with a reason.
does.ms: Menanda “Can be hired again” atau “Check with HR before hiring”, dengan sebab.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

who.en: HR Director, COO, OGM, Operations Director or CEO
who.ms: Pengarah HR, COO, OGM, Pengarah Operasi atau CEO

does.en: Only they mark “Do not hire again”, or lift it, with a longer reason.
does.ms: Hanya mereka menanda “Do not hire again”, atau menariknya balik, dengan sebab yang lebih panjang.

label.en: HR monitor › Joining, leaving and moving
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Masuk, keluar dan pertukaran

rules.en: Prima suggests a look but never decides and never blocks a hire.
rules.ms: Prima mencadangkan semakan tetapi tidak sekali-kali memutuskan atau menghalang pengambilan.

rules.en: A person marked “Do not hire again” shows a red notice wherever their history is seen.
rules.ms: Orang yang ditanda “Do not hire again” menunjukkan notis merah di mana-mana sejarahnya dilihat.

rules.en: Each person outside HR has 30 lookups a day; every lookup is audited.
rules.ms: Setiap orang di luar HR mempunyai 30 semakan sehari; setiap semakan diaudit.

rules.en: CSG and TNG belong to the person and can be carried to the new record; the KDN guard card and eSIMS vetting never carry over.
rules.ms: CSG dan TNG milik orang itu dan boleh dibawa ke rekod baharu; kad pengawal KDN dan tapisan eSIMS tidak dibawa.

statusNote.en: Linking works only once the server’s secret key is set; until then the screens say linking is off.
statusNote.ms: Pautan hanya berfungsi setelah kunci rahsia pelayan ditetapkan; sebelum itu skrin menyatakan pautan dimatikan.

sops.words: history sejarah rehire ambil semula do not hire jangan ambil blacklist ic passport pasport lookup semak

title.en: Staff HR case: misconduct, harassment, grievance
title.ms: Kes HR staf: salah laku, gangguan, rungutan

purpose.en: HR records each step of a case in the staff member’s HR file, with the right to be heard; only the HR Director or the CEO records the outcome.
purpose.ms: HR merekod setiap langkah kes dalam fail HR staf, dengan hak untuk didengar; hanya Pengarah HR atau CEO merekod keputusan.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

starter.en: HR

does.en: Opens the case: misconduct, sexual harassment, grievance or performance, from the written complaint or the supervisor’s report.
does.ms: Membuka kes: salah laku, gangguan seksual, rungutan atau prestasi, daripada aduan bertulis atau laporan penyelia.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Sends a show-cause letter, giving at least 7 days to reply in writing.
does.ms: Menghantar surat tunjuk sebab, memberi sekurang-kurangnya 7 hari untuk menjawab secara bertulis.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Sets up the domestic inquiry after the show-cause letter. The panel leaves out the staff member, the complainant and whoever opened the case.
does.ms: Menyediakan siasatan dalaman selepas surat tunjuk sebab. Panel tidak termasuk staf itu, pengadu dan pembuka kes.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Records the outcome.
does.ms: Merekod keputusan.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: May appeal in writing within 14 days.
does.ms: Boleh merayu secara bertulis dalam 14 hari.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

rules.en: Dismissal, downgrade or suspension without wages (at most 14 days) only after an inquiry has found the charge proven.
rules.ms: Pemecatan, penurunan pangkat atau penggantungan tanpa gaji (paling lama 14 hari) hanya selepas siasatan mendapati pertuduhan terbukti.

rules.en: A suspension before the inquiry lasts at most 14 days, on at least half pay.
rules.ms: Penggantungan sebelum siasatan paling lama 14 hari, dengan sekurang-kurangnya separuh gaji.

rules.en: Sexual harassment cases are confidential (HR, the HR Director and the CEO only); HR sets up an inquiry, or refuses one with written reasons, within 30 days.
rules.ms: Kes gangguan seksual adalah sulit (HR, Pengarah HR dan CEO sahaja); HR mengadakan siasatan, atau menolaknya dengan sebab bertulis, dalam 30 hari.

rules.en: HR never handles a case they are part of. The app never decides.
rules.ms: HR tidak mengendalikan kes yang melibatkan dirinya. Aplikasi tidak sekali-kali memutuskan.

rules.en: Company managers read their own company’s non-confidential cases but cannot act on them.
rules.ms: Pengurus syarikat boleh membaca kes tidak sulit syarikat sendiri tetapi tidak boleh bertindak.

sops.words: case kes discipline disiplin misconduct salah laku harassment gangguan seksual grievance rungutan show cause tunjuk sebab inquiry siasatan

title.en: Appeal against a warning or outcome

purpose.en: Office staff and guards may appeal a warning or an outcome within 14 days; the HR Director or the CEO decides with written reasons.
purpose.ms: Staf pejabat dan pengawal boleh merayu amaran atau keputusan dalam 14 hari; Pengarah HR atau CEO memutuskan dengan sebab bertulis.

starter.en: The staff member or guard (or HR or the company from their letter)
starter.ms: Staf atau pengawal (atau HR atau syarikat daripada surat mereka)

does.en: Appeals on their own sign-in, or the company or HR records it from the guard’s letter.
does.ms: Merayu melalui log masuk sendiri, atau syarikat atau HR merekodnya daripada surat pengawal.

does.en: Records the staff member’s written appeal on the case, with the language it was written in.
does.ms: Merekod rayuan bertulis staf pada kes itu, bersama bahasa yang digunakan.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Decides with written reasons: upheld, varied to a lighter step, or overturned.
does.ms: Memutuskan dengan sebab bertulis: dikekalkan, diubah kepada langkah lebih ringan, atau dibatalkan.

rules.en: Within 14 days: a verbal, written or final warning, or another outcome (and for guards also suspension, downgrade or dismissal).
rules.ms: Dalam 14 hari: amaran lisan, bertulis atau terakhir, atau keputusan lain (dan bagi pengawal juga penggantungan, penurunan pangkat atau pemecatan).

rules.en: Never decided by the person who made or recorded the decision, the person who recorded the appeal, the staff member or the complainant.
rules.ms: Tidak sekali-kali diputuskan oleh orang yang membuat atau merekod keputusan, orang yang merekod rayuan, staf itu atau pengadu.

rules.en: A show-cause letter and the inquiry are how a guard is heard, so they are not appealed.
rules.ms: Surat tunjuk sebab dan siasatan ialah cara pengawal didengar, jadi ia tidak dirayu.

rules.en: An appeal within the window reopens a closed case; a case cannot close while an appeal waits.
rules.ms: Rayuan dalam tempoh itu membuka semula kes yang ditutup; kes tidak boleh ditutup semasa rayuan menunggu.

sops.words: appeal rayuan warning amaran discipline disiplin dismissal pemecatan guard pengawal

title.en: Screening a guard, officer, staff member or director
title.ms: Tapisan pengawal, pegawai, staf atau pengarah

purpose.en: One screening case per person, each check with its evidence; the HR Director decides, and screening is repeated on time.
purpose.ms: Satu kes tapisan bagi setiap orang, setiap semakan dengan buktinya; Pengarah HR memutuskan, dan tapisan diulang tepat pada masanya.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

starter.en: HR

does.en: Opens a case from the staff number, or picks the company and enters the name and last four ID digits for a director or shareholder. Prima fills in what HR already holds (KDN card, eSIMS vetting, the ID on file).
does.ms: Membuka kes daripada nombor staf, atau memilih syarikat dan memasukkan nama dan empat digit akhir ID bagi pengarah atau pemegang saham. Prima mengisi apa yang HR sudah ada (kad KDN, tapisan eSIMS, ID dalam fail).

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Records each check: “clear” with the authority’s reference or where the evidence is filed; a concern or “not needed” with a reason.
does.ms: Merekod setiap semakan: “clear” dengan rujukan pihak berkuasa atau tempat bukti disimpan; kebimbangan atau “not needed” dengan sebab.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Decides with a reason, never on a case they opened: cleared only when every check is done; “cleared to start, KDN vetting pending” only for a guard or officer whose eSIMS vetting is submitted.
does.ms: Memutuskan dengan sebab, tidak bagi kes yang dibukanya: lulus hanya apabila semua semakan selesai; “cleared to start, KDN vetting pending” hanya bagi pengawal atau pegawai yang tapisan eSIMS sudah dihantar.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Starts the repeat screening with one tap when it shows as due (60 days ahead).
does.ms: Memulakan tapisan ulangan dengan satu tekan apabila ia ditunjukkan sebagai perlu (60 hari lebih awal).

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

rules.en: Checks: guards and officers (application, interview, consent, identity, KDN vetting, police, references, medical); office staff (application, interview, consent, identity, references, qualifications); directors and shareholders (consent, identity, police, bankruptcy, SSM search).
rules.ms: Semakan: pengawal dan pegawai (permohonan, temu duga, persetujuan, identiti, tapisan KDN, polis, rujukan, perubatan); staf pejabat (permohonan, temu duga, persetujuan, identiti, rujukan, kelayakan); pengarah dan pemegang saham (persetujuan, identiti, polis, kebankrapan, carian SSM).

rules.en: Repeat every 36 months for staff and guards, every 12 months for directors and shareholders.
rules.ms: Ulang setiap 36 bulan bagi staf dan pengawal, setiap 12 bulan bagi pengarah dan pemegang saham.

rules.en: A concern on file needs written conditions to clear.
rules.ms: Kebimbangan dalam fail memerlukan syarat bertulis untuk diluluskan.

rules.en: Only HR, the HR Director and the CEO work with screening; ACT reads only; companies, officers and staff never see it.
rules.ms: Hanya HR, Pengarah HR dan CEO bekerja dengan tapisan; ACT membaca sahaja; syarikat, pegawai dan staf tidak melihatnya.

sops.words: screening tapisan vetting kdn esims police polis background check semakan latar belakang director pengarah

title.en: Handbook, code of conduct and policies: read and sign
title.ms: Buku panduan, kod etika dan polisi: baca dan tandatangan

purpose.en: HR publishes a policy in English and Malay (and staff mother tongues); everyone it is for reads and acknowledges it.
purpose.ms: HR menerbitkan polisi dalam Bahasa Inggeris dan Melayu (dan bahasa ibunda staf); semua yang berkenaan membaca dan mengakuinya.

label.en: HR monitor › Appraisals, training and policies
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Penilaian, latihan dan polisi

starter.en: HR

does.en: Publishes the handbook, code of conduct or policy for its audience (office, guards and officers, or everyone), with the English text and the Malay copy, and other mother-tongue copies with who translated them.
does.ms: Menerbitkan buku panduan, kod etika atau polisi untuk sasarannya (pejabat, pengawal dan pegawai, atau semua), dengan teks Inggeris dan salinan Melayu, dan salinan bahasa ibunda lain bersama nama penterjemah.

label.en: HR monitor › Appraisals, training and policies
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Penilaian, latihan dan polisi

does.en: Open the text and acknowledge “I have read and understood it”.
does.ms: Membuka teks dan mengaku “I have read and understood it”.

does.en: Acknowledge on their own sign-in, in a language of their choice.
does.ms: Mengaku melalui log masuk sendiri, dalam bahasa pilihan mereka.

who.en: Officer, OM, company manager or HR
who.ms: Pegawai, OM, pengurus syarikat atau HR

does.en: For guards without the app, records a briefing: who attended and understood, the briefing sheet or reference and the language (at most 80 people at a time).
does.ms: Bagi pengawal tanpa aplikasi, merekod taklimat: siapa hadir dan faham, helaian atau rujukan taklimat dan bahasa (paling ramai 80 orang sekali).

does.en: Sees who has not acknowledged, and which mother tongues still lack a copy.
does.ms: Melihat siapa belum mengaku, dan bahasa ibunda mana masih tiada salinan.

label.en: HR monitor › Appraisals, training and policies
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Penilaian, latihan dan polisi

rules.en: Publishing without the Malay copy is refused. Prima never machine-translates a policy.
rules.ms: Penerbitan tanpa salinan Melayu ditolak. Prima tidak sekali-kali menterjemah polisi secara mesin.

rules.en: A material change asks everyone again; a small correction keeps the acknowledgements.
rules.ms: Perubahan penting meminta semua mengaku semula; pembetulan kecil mengekalkan pengakuan.

rules.en: Only HR publishes, translates or sets a staff language.
rules.ms: Hanya HR menerbitkan, menterjemah atau menetapkan bahasa staf.

sops.words: handbook buku panduan code of conduct kod etika policy polisi acknowledge akui briefing taklimat language bahasa

title.en: Yearly appraisal

purpose.en: HR opens a yearly appraisal and names the appraiser; the appraiser rates; the staff member reads and may comment; HR closes it.
purpose.ms: HR membuka penilaian tahunan dan menamakan penilai; penilai memberi markah; staf membaca dan boleh memberi komen; HR menutupnya.

label.en: HR monitor › Appraisals, training and policies
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Penilaian, latihan dan polisi

starter.en: HR

does.en: Opens one appraisal per staff member per year and names the appraiser.
does.ms: Membuka satu penilaian bagi setiap staf setahun dan menamakan penilai.

label.en: HR monitor › Appraisals, training and policies
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Penilaian, latihan dan polisi

does.en: Rates 1 to 5 with a comment.
does.ms: Memberi markah 1 hingga 5 dengan komen.

does.en: Sees it only after it is rated, reads it and may comment.
does.ms: Melihatnya hanya selepas dinilai, membacanya dan boleh memberi komen.

does.en: Closes it with a comment once the staff member has read it, or after 14 days.
does.ms: Menutupnya dengan komen setelah staf membacanya, atau selepas 14 hari.

label.en: HR monitor › Appraisals, training and policies
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Penilaian, latihan dan polisi

rules.en: The staff member never appraises themselves, and HR never opens their own.
rules.ms: Staf tidak menilai dirinya sendiri, dan HR tidak membuka penilaiannya sendiri.

rules.en: The appraisal is separate from the work KPIs.
rules.ms: Penilaian ini berasingan daripada KPI kerja.

sops.words: appraisal penilaian review prestasi performance rating markah

title.en: Office safety: coordinator, risk assessment, DOSH report
title.ms: Keselamatan pejabat: penyelaras, penilaian risiko, laporan JKKP

purpose.en: Each employer has an OSH coordinator, assesses office risks, and reports accidents to DOSH within 7 days.
purpose.ms: Setiap majikan ada penyelaras OSH, menilai risiko pejabat, dan melaporkan kemalangan kepada JKKP dalam 7 hari.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

starter.en: HR, the employer’s OSH coordinator, or the company manager
starter.ms: HR, penyelaras OSH majikan, atau pengurus syarikat

does.en: Names each employer’s OSH coordinator (an employer with 5 or more staff and no coordinator is flagged).
does.ms: Menamakan penyelaras OSH setiap majikan (majikan dengan 5 staf atau lebih tanpa penyelaras ditanda).

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Records each office or floor’s risk assessment (HIRARC) with the hazards; high risks need a note of the controls. A review is due after 12 months.
does.ms: Merekod penilaian risiko (HIRARC) setiap pejabat atau tingkat dengan bahayanya; risiko tinggi perlu nota kawalan. Semakan semula perlu selepas 12 bulan.

who.en: HR, the coordinator or the company manager

does.en: Records an accident, dangerous occurrence, poisoning or disease, saying if it was a death or serious injury.
does.ms: Merekod kemalangan, kejadian berbahaya, keracunan atau penyakit, menyatakan jika ia kematian atau kecederaan parah.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

does.en: Sends JKKP 6 (JKKP 7 for a disease) to DOSH within 7 days, then records the DOSH reference in Prima.
does.ms: Menghantar JKKP 6 (JKKP 7 bagi penyakit) kepada JKKP dalam 7 hari, kemudian merekod rujukan JKKP dalam Prima.

label.en: HR monitor › Cases, safety and legal
label.ms: Pemantauan HR › Kes, keselamatan dan perundangan

rules.en: A death or serious injury is flagged so DOSH is told at once.
rules.ms: Kematian atau kecederaan parah ditanda supaya JKKP dimaklumkan serta-merta.

rules.en: The yearly JKKP 8 summary is due by 31 January.
rules.ms: Ringkasan tahunan JKKP 8 perlu sebelum 31 Januari.

rules.en: Prima never files with DOSH; it reminds and keeps the reference.
rules.ms: Prima tidak menghantar kepada JKKP; ia mengingatkan dan menyimpan rujukan.

rules.en: Naming a new coordinator ends the old one the same day.
rules.ms: Menamakan penyelaras baharu menamatkan yang lama pada hari yang sama.

sops.words: osh safety keselamatan dosh jkkp accident kemalangan hirarc risk risiko coordinator penyelaras

title.en: SOCSO (PERKESO) claim for an injured worker
title.ms: Tuntutan PERKESO bagi pekerja yang cedera

purpose.en: When a worker is hurt at work, the claim is started in Prima, HR submits Form 34 in ASSIST, records each step, and plans the return to work.
purpose.ms: Apabila pekerja cedera semasa bekerja, tuntutan dimulakan dalam Prima, HR menghantar Borang 34 dalam ASSIST, merekod setiap langkah, dan merancang kembali bekerja.

starter.en: The OM or HR (HR for office staff)
starter.ms: OM atau HR (HR bagi staf pejabat)

does.en: Tells the OM straight away and gets treatment first, at any panel clinic or government hospital.
does.ms: Memaklumkan OM serta-merta dan mendapatkan rawatan dahulu, di mana-mana klinik panel atau hospital kerajaan.

does.en: Starts the claim, with when it happened and when the company was told (or from the person’s profile, SOCSO tab).
does.ms: Memulakan tuntutan, dengan bila ia berlaku dan bila syarikat dimaklumkan (atau dari profil orang itu, tab SOCSO).

does.en: Submits Form 34 in PERKESO ASSIST within 48 hours of being told and records the reference in Prima.
does.ms: Menghantar Borang 34 dalam PERKESO ASSIST dalam 48 jam selepas dimaklumkan dan merekod rujukan dalam Prima.

does.en: Adds the papers on the checklist, marks them complete, then under PERKESO review, and records PERKESO’s decision.
does.ms: Menambah dokumen dalam senarai semak, menandanya lengkap, kemudian dalam semakan PERKESO, dan merekod keputusan PERKESO.

does.en: Rejected: appeals to the Appellate Board within 90 days, or closes. Approved: records the amount paid and closes.
does.ms: Ditolak: merayu kepada Lembaga Rayuan dalam 90 hari, atau menutup. Diluluskan: merekod jumlah dibayar dan menutup.

does.en: Return to work: the plan, work restrictions that stop the roster placing the person on unsuitable posts, appointments and weekly check-ins.
does.ms: Kembali bekerja: pelan, sekatan kerja yang menghalang jadual tugas meletakkan orang itu di pos yang tidak sesuai, temu janji dan semakan mingguan.

label.en: SOCSO claims › the claim › Return to work
label.ms: Tuntutan PERKESO › tuntutan itu › Kembali bekerja

rules.en: MC days are paid on basic pay only: 3 days or fewer are company sick leave; 4 days or more on an accepted claim are paid by PERKESO, not the company.
rules.ms: Hari MC dibayar atas gaji pokok sahaja: 3 hari atau kurang ialah cuti sakit syarikat; 4 hari atau lebih bagi tuntutan yang diterima dibayar oleh PERKESO, bukan syarikat.

rules.en: Medical papers are seen by HR only.
rules.ms: Dokumen perubatan hanya dilihat oleh HR.

rules.en: Permanent disablement: claim within 12 months of the last MC day.
rules.ms: Hilang upaya kekal: tuntut dalam 12 bulan dari hari MC terakhir.

rules.en: PERKESO has no link to Prima: HR works in ASSIST and records the reference here.
rules.ms: PERKESO tiada pautan dengan Prima: HR bekerja dalam ASSIST dan merekod rujukan di sini.

sops.words: socso perkeso injury kecederaan accident kemalangan form 34 borang 34 assist mc return to work kembali bekerja

title.en: Staff claim: medical, optical, check-up, travel
title.ms: Tuntutan staf: perubatan, optik, pemeriksaan, perjalanan

purpose.en: Staff keep receipts in their wallet and claim; the company head verifies, HR checks, the COO approves and Finance pays.
purpose.ms: Staf menyimpan resit dalam dompet dan membuat tuntutan; ketua syarikat mengesahkan, HR menyemak, COO meluluskan dan Kewangan membayar.

starter.en: Office and management staff (not guards or officers)
starter.ms: Staf pejabat dan pengurusan (bukan pengawal atau pegawai)

does.en: Keeps each receipt in My receipts (camera or upload). The phone reads the date, total, shop and kind; you check or correct the figures.
does.ms: Menyimpan setiap resit dalam My receipts (kamera atau muat naik). Telefon membaca tarikh, jumlah, kedai dan jenis; anda menyemak atau membetulkan angka.

does.en: Asks the Chief of Staff to approve the trip before going.
does.ms: Meminta Ketua Staf meluluskan perjalanan sebelum pergi.

does.en: Presses “Claim now” on a receipt, or “New claim”, and sends it.
does.ms: Menekan “Claim now” pada resit, atau “New claim”, dan menghantarnya.

who.en: Company head (the line manager for PWVSB central staff)
who.ms: Ketua syarikat (pengurus barisan bagi staf pusat PWVSB)

does.en: Verifies with a comment; a rejection, with a reason, ends the claim.
does.ms: Mengesahkan dengan komen; penolakan, dengan sebab, menamatkan tuntutan.

does.en: Checks the claim against the policy limits.
does.ms: Menyemak tuntutan berbanding had polisi.

does.en: Approves a trip that was not approved before it was made, or one more than 10% off the system km.
does.ms: Meluluskan perjalanan yang tidak diluluskan sebelum dibuat, atau yang berbeza lebih 10% daripada km sistem.

does.en: Approves, only after the company head has verified.
does.ms: Meluluskan, hanya selepas ketua syarikat mengesahkan.

does.en: Pays and records the payment with its reference.
does.ms: Membayar dan merekod bayaran dengan rujukannya.

rules.en: Medical with dental up to RM1,000 a year, optical RM500 every 2 years, the yearly check-up separately, and travel at the published rate per km. Valet parking cannot be claimed.
rules.ms: Perubatan termasuk pergigian hingga RM1,000 setahun, optik RM500 setiap 2 tahun, pemeriksaan tahunan berasingan, dan perjalanan pada kadar sekilometer yang diterbitkan. Valet parking tidak boleh dituntut.

rules.en: The Chief of Staff publishes the mileage rates each month; travel cannot be claimed until they are published.
rules.ms: Ketua Staf menerbitkan kadar perbatuan setiap bulan; perjalanan tidak boleh dituntut sehingga kadar diterbitkan.

rules.en: A receipt is claimed within 60 days of its date and goes into one claim only; the wallet warns when 7 days or less are left.
rules.ms: Resit dituntut dalam 60 hari dari tarikhnya dan masuk ke satu tuntutan sahaja; dompet memberi amaran apabila tinggal 7 hari atau kurang.

rules.en: The company head and HR may check in any order; nobody verifies their own claim.
rules.ms: Ketua syarikat dan HR boleh menyemak dalam apa-apa urutan; tiada sesiapa mengesahkan tuntutannya sendiri.

sops.words: claim tuntutan medical perubatan dental pergigian optical optik travel perjalanan mileage perbatuan receipt resit wallet dompet

title.en: Hand-over between departments

purpose.en: Key it once: when one desk saves a record another desk needs, Prima gives the other desk a to-do or a notice with a link.
purpose.ms: Masukkan sekali: apabila satu meja menyimpan rekod yang diperlukan meja lain, Prima memberi meja itu tugasan atau notis dengan pautan.

starter.en: Prima, when a desk saves a record (for example HR adds a staff member)
starter.ms: Prima, apabila meja menyimpan rekod (contohnya HR menambah staf)

does.en: Saves a record on its own screen, for example HR adds a staff member.
does.ms: Menyimpan rekod di skrinnya sendiri, contohnya HR menambah staf.

does.en: Creates a to-do or a notice for each receiving desk, with a due time.
does.ms: Mencipta tugasan atau notis bagi setiap meja penerima, dengan masa akhir.

does.en: Opens it, does the work on their own screen, then marks it Done, Not needed or Noted.
does.ms: Membukanya, melakukan kerja di skrin sendiri, kemudian menandanya Done, Not needed atau Noted.

does.en: See what is late or has nobody to receive it.
does.ms: Melihat apa yang lewat atau tiada penerima.

rules.en: A hand-over tells and links; it never approves, pays or changes the other department’s records.
rules.ms: Serah tugas memberitahu dan memaut; ia tidak sekali-kali meluluskan, membayar atau mengubah rekod jabatan lain.

statusNote.en: In-app only: email and Teams notices stay off until they are set up and checked.
statusNote.ms: Dalam aplikasi sahaja: notis e-mel dan Teams kekal dimatikan sehingga disediakan dan disemak.

title.en: Monthly staff payroll

purpose.en: HR prepares each employer’s month, the Chief of Staff and then the COO approve, Finance pays through the bank, and staff download their payslips.
purpose.ms: HR menyediakan bulan setiap majikan, Ketua Staf kemudian COO meluluskan, Kewangan membayar melalui bank, dan staf memuat turun slip gaji.

label.en: Staff payroll › Start a payroll month

starter.en: HR

does.en: Prepares each employer’s month (this month or last) from the staff records: basic pay, allowances, unpaid leave and approved claims, with EPF, SOCSO, EIS, LINDUNG, an estimated PCB, HRD and zakat. Adds one-off allowances from HR’s list, the e-PCB figure and part-month pay.
does.ms: Menyediakan bulan setiap majikan (bulan ini atau lepas) daripada rekod staf: gaji pokok, elaun, cuti tanpa gaji dan tuntutan yang diluluskan, dengan KWSP, PERKESO, SIP, LINDUNG, anggaran PCB, HRD dan zakat. Menambah elaun sekali bayar daripada senarai HR, angka e-PCB dan gaji separuh bulan.

does.en: Submits the month to the Chief of Staff with a comment.
does.ms: Menghantar bulan itu kepada Ketua Staf dengan komen.

does.en: Approves with a comment, or returns it to HR.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan komen, atau memulangkan kepada HR.

does.en: Approves as COO with a comment (never the person who approved as Chief of Staff), or returns it to HR.
does.ms: Meluluskan sebagai COO dengan komen (bukan orang yang meluluskan sebagai Ketua Staf), atau memulangkan kepada HR.

does.en: Pays through the bank’s payroll service, marks it paid with the bank reference and the PCB checked, and posts to SQL Account. Prima only drafts the bank, SQL, EPF, SOCSO and PCB files.
does.ms: Membayar melalui perkhidmatan gaji bank, menandanya dibayar dengan rujukan bank dan PCB yang disemak, dan memasukkan ke SQL Account. Prima hanya menyediakan draf fail bank, SQL, KWSP, PERKESO dan PCB.

does.en: Sees and downloads their own payslips.
does.ms: Melihat dan memuat turun slip gaji sendiri.

rules.en: Whoever prepares or submits a month cannot approve it. Every step needs a comment.
rules.ms: Sesiapa yang menyediakan atau menghantar bulan itu tidak boleh meluluskannya. Setiap langkah perlu komen.

rules.en: Pay below the RM1,700 minimum wage is flagged on the slip; HR corrects it before approval.
rules.ms: Gaji di bawah gaji minimum RM1,700 ditanda pada slip; HR membetulkannya sebelum kelulusan.

rules.en: A month cannot be submitted while a line is stale (recalculate first) or a staff movement into or out of the employer is still waiting.
rules.ms: Bulan tidak boleh dihantar selagi ada baris yang lapuk (kira semula dahulu) atau pergerakan staf masuk atau keluar majikan itu masih menunggu.

rules.en: A new EPF or SOCSO table is loaded by HR or Finance and checked by a second person before use (Staff payroll › EPF and SOCSO tables).
rules.ms: Jadual KWSP atau PERKESO baharu dimuatkan oleh HR atau Kewangan dan disemak oleh orang kedua sebelum digunakan (Gaji staf › Jadual KWSP dan PERKESO).

rules.en: Guards and officers are paid from the JA Group app, not here.
rules.ms: Pengawal dan pegawai dibayar daripada aplikasi JA Group, bukan di sini.

statusNote.en: November and December 2026 salaries are paid the old way while Prima runs side by side (the learning period to about 18 Jan 2027).
statusNote.ms: Gaji November dan Disember 2026 dibayar cara lama sementara Prima berjalan seiring (tempoh pembelajaran hingga kira-kira 18 Jan 2027).

sops.words: payroll gaji salary staff staf payslip slip gaji epf kwsp socso perkeso pcb eis zakat bank

title.en: Basic pay, salary account or allowance change
title.ms: Perubahan gaji pokok, akaun gaji atau elaun

purpose.en: HR sets the new pay, account or allowance; the HR Director verifies, Finance verifies an account change, the Vice Chairman consents to the amount.
purpose.ms: HR menetapkan gaji, akaun atau elaun baharu; Pengarah HR mengesahkan, Kewangan mengesahkan perubahan akaun, Naib Pengerusi memberi persetujuan terhadap jumlah.

starter.en: HR

does.en: Sets the new basic pay or salary account on the staff form with the reason and start date; or picks an allowance from HR’s list with the amount, start date and reason.
does.ms: Menetapkan gaji pokok atau akaun gaji baharu di borang staf dengan sebab dan tarikh mula; atau memilih elaun daripada senarai HR dengan jumlah, tarikh mula dan sebab.

does.en: Verifies with a comment, or refuses with a reason.
does.ms: Mengesahkan dengan komen, atau menolak dengan sebab.

does.en: Verifies a salary account change, with a comment.
does.ms: Mengesahkan perubahan akaun gaji, dengan komen.

does.en: Consents to the amount with a comment.
does.ms: Memberi persetujuan terhadap jumlah dengan komen.

does.en: A change consented for a later date waits; on or after that date HR applies the changes due today.
does.ms: Perubahan yang dipersetujui untuk tarikh kemudian menunggu; pada atau selepas tarikh itu HR melaksanakan perubahan yang perlu hari ini.

rules.en: Nobody verifies a change they asked for or their own pay. Pay for the CoS or DCoS goes to the Vice Chairman alone.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa mengesahkan perubahan yang dia minta atau gajinya sendiri. Gaji Ketua Staf atau Timbalan pergi kepada Naib Pengerusi sahaja.

rules.en: A new salary account is used only after the HR Director and Finance both verify it; a refusal clears the waiting account.
rules.ms: Akaun gaji baharu hanya digunakan selepas Pengarah HR dan Kewangan kedua-duanya mengesahkannya; penolakan mengosongkan akaun yang menunggu.

rules.en: The start date cannot be before the first day of last month; only one change can wait per person.
rules.ms: Tarikh mula tidak boleh sebelum hari pertama bulan lepas; hanya satu perubahan boleh menunggu bagi setiap orang.

rules.en: Only HR changes the allowance list; each allowance’s EPF, SOCSO, PCB and HRD ticks are HR’s decision.
rules.ms: Hanya HR mengubah senarai elaun; tanda KWSP, PERKESO, PCB dan HRD setiap elaun adalah keputusan HR.

sops.words: pay change perubahan gaji increment kenaikan basic pokok allowance elaun salary account akaun gaji bank vice chairman

title.en: Statutory rates and contribution tables

purpose.en: The CEO sets the EPF, SOCSO, EIS, LINDUNG and HRD rates from a month; HR or Finance loads the published tables, checked by a second person.
purpose.ms: CEO menetapkan kadar KWSP, PERKESO, SIP, LINDUNG dan HRD mulai sesuatu bulan; HR atau Kewangan memuatkan jadual yang diterbitkan, disemak oleh orang kedua.

starter.en: The CEO (rates); HR or Finance (tables)

does.en: Changes the rates from a month, or adds a new contribution type, with a reason and the law reference.
does.ms: Mengubah kadar mulai sesuatu bulan, atau menambah jenis caruman baharu, dengan sebab dan rujukan undang-undang.

does.en: Loads a newly published EPF or SOCSO table, row by row.
does.ms: Memuatkan jadual KWSP atau PERKESO yang baru diterbitkan, baris demi baris.

label.en: Staff payroll › EPF and SOCSO tables
label.ms: Gaji staf › Jadual KWSP dan PERKESO

does.en: Checks the new table before it is used.
does.ms: Menyemak jadual baharu sebelum ia digunakan.

label.en: Staff payroll › EPF and SOCSO tables
label.ms: Gaji staf › Jadual KWSP dan PERKESO

does.en: Recalculates any draft month from the change onwards.
does.ms: Mengira semula mana-mana bulan draf mulai perubahan itu.

rules.en: Only the CEO changes the rates; HR and Finance see them.
rules.ms: Hanya CEO mengubah kadar; HR dan Kewangan melihatnya.

rules.en: A change cannot be backdated before last month; the old version is kept.
rules.ms: Perubahan tidak boleh dibuat ke belakang sebelum bulan lepas; versi lama disimpan.

rules.en: Guard pay and staff pay both read the version in force for the pay month.
rules.ms: Gaji pengawal dan gaji staf kedua-duanya membaca versi yang berkuat kuasa bagi bulan gaji itu.

sops.words: statutory berkanun epf kwsp socso perkeso eis sip lindung hrd rate kadar table jadual contribution caruman

title.en: Guard pay formula set by ACT

purpose.en: ACT keeps the pay formulas (basic, hours, overtime rates, allowances) and chooses which applies to the group, a region, a company or a site.
purpose.ms: ACT menyimpan formula gaji (gaji pokok, jam, kadar lebih masa, elaun) dan memilih yang mana terpakai bagi kumpulan, wilayah, syarikat atau tapak.

starter.en: ACT (Director, Deputy or Assistants)

does.en: Prepares a formula or a change, with a reason.
does.ms: Menyediakan formula atau perubahan, dengan sebab.

does.en: Sets it live or sends it back, with a reason (or sets a formula live directly).
does.ms: Menjadikannya aktif atau memulangkannya, dengan sebab (atau terus mengaktifkan formula).

does.en: Picks the formula for the whole group, a region, a company or a site, from a month. The narrowest choice wins.
does.ms: Memilih formula bagi seluruh kumpulan, wilayah, syarikat atau tapak, mulai sesuatu bulan. Pilihan paling khusus diguna pakai.

does.en: Use the salary calculator to see how a guard’s month is worked out.
does.ms: Menggunakan kalkulator gaji untuk melihat cara bulan seorang pengawal dikira.

rules.en: A change makes a new version from a month; older months keep the old version; nothing starts in a past month.
rules.ms: Perubahan mencipta versi baharu mulai sesuatu bulan; bulan lama kekal dengan versi lama; tiada yang bermula pada bulan lepas.

rules.en: A figure below the Employment Act is saved and flagged to the CEO.
rules.ms: Angka di bawah Akta Kerja disimpan dan ditanda kepada CEO.

rules.en: Group leadership sees everything and changes nothing; HR and company managers do not see the screen.
rules.ms: Pimpinan kumpulan melihat semua dan tidak mengubah apa-apa; HR dan pengurus syarikat tidak melihat skrin ini.

rules.en: The day divisor (26 today) is set by the CEO in the pay law settings.
rules.ms: Pembahagi hari (26 sekarang) ditetapkan oleh CEO dalam tetapan undang-undang gaji.

sops.words: pay formula formula gaji act overtime lebih masa shift syif rest rehat salary calculator kalkulator gaji

title.en: Monthly guard pay run

purpose.en: A company’s named preparer works out the month from locked attendance and the ACT formula; the COO approves; Finance pays; guards see payslips on Duty.
purpose.ms: Penyedia yang dinamakan syarikat mengira bulan itu daripada kehadiran yang dikunci dan formula ACT; COO meluluskan; Kewangan membayar; pengawal melihat slip gaji di Tugas.

starter.en: The company executive the company manager names
starter.ms: Eksekutif syarikat yang dinamakan pengurus syarikat

does.en: Names one or more people in the company office who prepare the guard pay, with a reason. OMs cannot be named.
does.ms: Menamakan seorang atau lebih di pejabat syarikat yang menyediakan gaji pengawal, dengan sebab. OM tidak boleh dinamakan.

does.en: Prepares or recalculates the month (this month or last) and may enter a PCB from e-PCB or a one-off item with a reason.
does.ms: Menyediakan atau mengira semula bulan itu (bulan ini atau lepas) dan boleh memasukkan PCB daripada e-PCB atau item sekali bayar dengan sebab.

does.en: Submits the month. It is refused while a shift is unlocked or has no clock-out, a worked site has no formula, a guard has no account and is not listed for cash, hours paid do not match hours recorded, or a line is negative.
does.ms: Menghantar bulan itu. Ia ditolak selagi ada syif belum dikunci atau tiada daftar keluar, tapak tanpa formula, pengawal tanpa akaun dan tidak disenaraikan untuk tunai, jam dibayar tidak sepadan dengan jam direkod, atau baris negatif.

who.en: COO (the CEO stands in during the pilot)

does.en: Approves with a reason, or returns it to the company with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan sebab, atau memulangkan kepada syarikat dengan sebab.

does.en: Pays with the bank reference and the PCB checked, and takes the bank file, e-wallet list and statutory files after COO approval.
does.ms: Membayar dengan rujukan bank dan PCB disemak, dan mengambil fail bank, senarai e-dompet dan fail berkanun selepas kelulusan COO.

does.en: Sees their own payslips on Duty, for paid months.
does.ms: Melihat slip gaji sendiri di Tugas, bagi bulan yang telah dibayar.

rules.en: Nobody approves a month they prepared or submitted.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa meluluskan bulan yang dia sediakan atau hantar.

rules.en: Pay is due by the 7th of the next month; later is recorded as late (Employment Act s.19).
rules.ms: Gaji perlu dibayar sebelum 7 hari bulan berikutnya; selepas itu direkod sebagai lewat (Akta Kerja s.19).

rules.en: Equipment is never charged to the guard; uniform and item deductions wait for a management and legal decision.
rules.ms: Peralatan tidak sekali-kali dicaj kepada pengawal; potongan uniform dan barang menunggu keputusan pengurusan dan undang-undang.

rules.en: All the employer’s deductions together stay within half the month’s wages (EPF, SOCSO and PCB are outside this cap).
rules.ms: Semua potongan majikan bersama tidak melebihi separuh gaji bulan itu (KWSP, PERKESO dan PCB di luar had ini).

rules.en: A guard whose absence still waits for the OD or OGM decision is left out and paid in a later run; everyone else is paid on time.
rules.ms: Pengawal yang ketidakhadirannya masih menunggu keputusan OD atau OGM dikecualikan dan dibayar dalam larian kemudian; yang lain dibayar tepat pada masanya.

statusNote.en: Prima takes over guard pay on 1 Aug 2027. Until then the JA Group app pays guards; each run here is a trial compared with JA, cannot be marked paid, and its bank file says not to upload it.
statusNote.ms: Prima mengambil alih gaji pengawal pada 1 Ogos 2027. Sebelum itu aplikasi JA Group membayar pengawal; setiap larian di sini ialah percubaan yang dibandingkan dengan JA, tidak boleh ditanda dibayar, dan fail banknya menyatakan jangan dimuat naik.

sops.words: guard pay gaji pengawal payroll run larian officer pegawai payslip slip gaji coo bank ja

title.en: Guard paid into another account, or in cash by exception
title.ms: Gaji pengawal ke akaun orang lain, atau tunai secara pengecualian

purpose.en: Guards are paid by bank account or e-wallet only. Someone else’s account needs a sworn consent letter the COO approves; cash is an exception the CEO decides.
purpose.ms: Pengawal dibayar melalui akaun bank atau e-dompet sahaja. Akaun orang lain memerlukan surat persetujuan bersumpah yang diluluskan COO; tunai ialah pengecualian yang diputuskan CEO.

starter.en: HR (account); Director Office (cash)

does.en: Records whose account it is: own, joint, an immediate relative’s or a close friend’s; bank or e-wallet.
does.ms: Merekod akaun siapa: sendiri, bersama, saudara terdekat atau kawan rapat; bank atau e-dompet.

does.en: For someone else’s account, attaches the guard’s consent letter stamped by a Commissioner for Oaths (Pesuruhjaya Sumpah).
does.ms: Bagi akaun orang lain, melampirkan surat persetujuan pengawal yang dicop oleh Pesuruhjaya Sumpah.

does.en: Approves the consent letter with a reason (no CEO stand-in; never the HR officer who recorded it). Until then the account cannot be paid into.
does.ms: Meluluskan surat persetujuan dengan sebab (tiada ganti oleh CEO; bukan pegawai HR yang merekodnya). Sebelum itu akaun tidak boleh dibayar.

does.en: Lists a guard with no usable account for wage cash, with the exact net amount and a reason.
does.ms: Menyenaraikan pengawal tanpa akaun yang boleh digunakan untuk gaji tunai, dengan jumlah bersih tepat dan sebab.

does.en: Alone decides the wage cash, with a reason.
does.ms: Seorang diri memutuskan gaji tunai, dengan sebab.

who.en: CEO or COO, then Director Office
who.ms: CEO atau COO, kemudian Pejabat Pengarah

does.en: The CEO or COO hands the cash over once the month is approved and records the date; the Director Office uploads the guard’s genuine signed receipt.
does.ms: CEO atau COO menyerahkan tunai setelah bulan itu diluluskan dan merekod tarikh; Pejabat Pengarah memuat naik resit asli bertandatangan pengawal.

rules.en: Cash is an exception, never a normal way of paying wages.
rules.ms: Tunai ialah pengecualian, bukan cara biasa membayar gaji.

rules.en: An e-wallet or third-party account stays a legal point for the CEO even with consent (Employment Act s.25).
rules.ms: E-dompet atau akaun pihak ketiga kekal sebagai isu undang-undang untuk CEO walaupun dengan persetujuan (Akta Kerja s.25).

rules.en: Cash is never handed out on a trial month.
rules.ms: Tunai tidak sekali-kali diserahkan bagi bulan percubaan.

statusNote.en: Part of the guard pay run, a trial until Prima pays guards on 1 Aug 2027.
statusNote.ms: Sebahagian larian gaji pengawal, percubaan sehingga Prima membayar pengawal pada 1 Ogos 2027.

source.decided: Fauzan, 6 Nov 2026; 8 Nov 2026 (the CEO alone decides wage cash)

sops.words: account akaun consent persetujuan pesuruhjaya sumpah e-wallet e-dompet cash tunai third party pihak ketiga

title.en: Guard wage advance (the 20th)

purpose.en: The OM sets an advance for a guard or a site; the Operations Director or OGM approves; Finance pays; the month’s pay takes it back.
purpose.ms: OM menetapkan pendahuluan bagi pengawal atau tapak; Pengarah Operasi atau OGM meluluskan; Kewangan membayar; gaji bulan itu memotongnya semula.

starter.en: OM or Regional OM

does.en: Sets the amount and pay date (usually the 20th) for one guard, or in bulk for a site, zone or region; this month or next month only.
does.ms: Menetapkan jumlah dan tarikh bayar (biasanya 20 hari bulan) bagi seorang pengawal, atau secara pukal bagi tapak, zon atau wilayah; bulan ini atau bulan depan sahaja.

who.en: Operations Director (private sites) or OGM (government sites)
who.ms: Pengarah Operasi (tapak swasta) atau OGM (tapak kerajaan)

does.en: Approves with a reason, one or many at once.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan sebab, satu atau banyak sekali gus.

does.en: Marks it paid with the bank reference, only once Prima pays guards.
does.ms: Menandanya dibayar dengan rujukan bank, hanya setelah Prima membayar pengawal.

does.en: Takes back only advances actually paid, after the statutory shares.
does.ms: Memotong semula hanya pendahuluan yang benar-benar dibayar, selepas bahagian berkanun.

rules.en: Refused: no usable account, a second advance in the same month, or more than last month’s wages (Employment Act s.22).
rules.ms: Ditolak: tiada akaun yang boleh digunakan, pendahuluan kedua dalam bulan yang sama, atau lebih daripada gaji bulan lepas (Akta Kerja s.22).

rules.en: Nobody approves an advance they set or changed; a change after approval needs one more approval.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa meluluskan pendahuluan yang dia tetapkan atau ubah; perubahan selepas kelulusan perlu satu lagi kelulusan.

statusNote.en: The JA Group app still pays guards, so advances are not paid from Prima until 1 Aug 2027; the trial pay run still takes approved advances back so the figures can be compared.
statusNote.ms: Aplikasi JA Group masih membayar pengawal, jadi pendahuluan tidak dibayar daripada Prima sehingga 1 Ogos 2027; larian gaji percubaan tetap memotong pendahuluan yang diluluskan supaya angka boleh dibandingkan.

sops.words: advance pendahuluan gaji wage 20th 20 hari bulan om ogm operations director

title.en: Guard advance or loan scheme

purpose.en: HR records an advance or loan with the worker’s signed agreement; the Chief of Staff and then the CEO approve; Finance pays and follows what is owed.
purpose.ms: HR merekod pendahuluan atau pinjaman dengan perjanjian bertandatangan pekerja; Ketua Staf kemudian CEO meluluskan; Kewangan membayar dan memantau baki hutang.

starter.en: HR

does.en: Records the kind (advance or loan), limit, amount, purpose, repayment period (1 to 24 months), first repayment month and the worker’s signed agreement.
does.ms: Merekod jenis (pendahuluan atau pinjaman), had, jumlah, tujuan, tempoh bayaran balik (1 hingga 24 bulan), bulan bayaran pertama dan perjanjian bertandatangan pekerja.

does.en: Approves with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan sebab.

does.en: Approves with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan sebab.

does.en: Is told at each step, pays it into the guard’s own account with the bank reference, and watches what is still owed.
does.ms: Dimaklumkan pada setiap langkah, membayar ke akaun pengawal sendiri dengan rujukan bank, dan memantau baki yang masih terhutang.

does.en: Takes the repayments only from these records; at zero the record is settled.
does.ms: Memotong bayaran balik hanya daripada rekod ini; apabila sifar rekod diselesaikan.

rules.en: Nobody decides a record they made or already approved.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa memutuskan rekod yang dia buat atau telah luluskan.

rules.en: All deductions together stay within half the month’s wages; what does not fit waits, and the balance stays on the record.
rules.ms: Semua potongan bersama tidak melebihi separuh gaji bulan itu; yang tidak muat menunggu, dan baki kekal dalam rekod.

rules.en: Separate from the wage advance on the 20th, and from exceptional guard cash support (which is never a loan).
rules.ms: Berasingan daripada pendahuluan gaji 20 hari bulan, dan daripada sokongan tunai luar biasa pengawal (yang tidak sekali-kali pinjaman).

statusNote.en: Records can be made and approved now; Finance pays them out from Prima only after 1 Aug 2027, because repayments come off Prima’s pay run.
statusNote.ms: Rekod boleh dibuat dan diluluskan sekarang; Kewangan membayarnya daripada Prima hanya selepas 1 Ogos 2027, kerana bayaran balik dipotong daripada larian gaji Prima.

sops.words: loan pinjaman advance pendahuluan scheme skim repayment bayaran balik cos ceo finance kewangan

title.en: Exceptional cash support for a guard
title.ms: Sokongan tunai luar biasa untuk pengawal

purpose.en: Extra support for a named guard on a named day, asked by the OM and approved by the CEO outside Prima; the Director Office hands the list to Finance, who pays and accounts for it.
purpose.ms: Sokongan tambahan untuk pengawal yang dinamakan pada hari tertentu, dipohon OM dan diluluskan CEO di luar Prima; Pejabat Pengarah menyerahkan senarai kepada Kewangan, yang membayar dan merekodkannya.

label.ms: Pejabat Pengarah › Tunai luar biasa pengawal

starter.en: The OM asks, outside Prima

does.en: Asks for support for a named guard, outside Prima.
does.ms: Memohon sokongan untuk pengawal yang dinamakan, di luar Prima.

does.en: Approves each named guard, exact amount and payment day, outside Prima, and sends the list to the Director Office.
does.ms: Meluluskan setiap pengawal yang dinamakan, jumlah tepat dan hari bayaran, di luar Prima, dan menghantar senarai kepada Pejabat Pengarah.

does.en: Downloads the read-only guard list, prepares the controlled Excel workbook, and submits the approved handover with the request and approval evidence.
does.ms: Memuat turun senarai pengawal baca sahaja, menyediakan buku kerja Excel terkawal, dan menghantar serahan yang diluluskan bersama bukti permohonan dan kelulusan.

label.ms: Pejabat Pengarah › Tunai luar biasa pengawal

does.en: Prepares the cash, then records the actual payment (never more than approved) with evidence.
does.ms: Menyediakan tunai, kemudian merekod bayaran sebenar (tidak melebihi yang diluluskan) dengan bukti.

does.en: Uploads the guard’s signed receipt for that payment.
does.ms: Memuat naik resit bertandatangan pengawal bagi bayaran itu.

label.ms: Pejabat Pengarah › Tunai luar biasa pengawal

does.en: Counts any cash returned, reconciles it, and records the payroll journal against the named site.
does.ms: Mengira tunai yang dipulangkan, menyelaraskannya, dan merekod jurnal gaji terhadap tapak yang dinamakan.

rules.en: It is additional pay: ordinary wages are paid in full, and it is never a loan or a deduction.
rules.ms: Ia ialah bayaran tambahan: gaji biasa dibayar penuh, dan ia tidak sekali-kali pinjaman atau potongan.

rules.en: Approval is not a payout; a stored signature is never proof of payment.
rules.ms: Kelulusan bukan bayaran; tandatangan yang disimpan tidak sekali-kali bukti bayaran.

rules.en: Budgeted under Miscellaneous payroll expenses.
rules.ms: Dibajetkan di bawah Perbelanjaan gaji pelbagai.

statusNote.en: Finance and a legal adviser review the cash treatment before real cash is used.
statusNote.ms: Kewangan dan penasihat undang-undang menyemak layanan tunai ini sebelum tunai sebenar digunakan.

title.en: Renewing a foreign worker’s papers

purpose.en: Permit (PLKS), passport, FOMEMA, insurance, SPIKPA and the KDN letter sit on a reminder ladder; FWM renews them and sends the OM dated tasks.
purpose.ms: Permit (PLKS), pasport, FOMEMA, insurans, SPIKPA dan surat KDN berada pada tangga peringatan; FWM memperbaharuinya dan menghantar tugasan bertarikh kepada OM.

starter.en: FWM Manager, Deputy or Executives

does.en: Puts each paper on the ladder at 120, 90, 60, 30, 15 and 7 days, and escalates late steps to FWM, Chief of Staff, COO and CEO.
does.ms: Meletakkan setiap dokumen pada tangga 120, 90, 60, 30, 15 dan 7 hari, dan menaikkan langkah lewat kepada FWM, Ketua Staf, COO dan CEO.

does.en: Sends the OM a dated task (bring the worker, collect a paper).
does.ms: Menghantar tugasan bertarikh kepada OM (bawa pekerja, ambil dokumen).

label.en: Foreign workers › Papers › Send task to OM
label.ms: Pekerja asing › Dokumen › Hantar tugasan kepada OM

does.en: Does the task and sends the proof.
does.ms: Melaksanakan tugasan dan menghantar bukti.

does.en: Accepts the proof or sends it back; records Renewal submitted with its receipt (the ladder pauses).
does.ms: Menerima bukti atau memulangkannya; merekod Renewal submitted dengan resitnya (tangga berhenti seketika).

does.en: Records the new paper from its copy (New paper received); the ladder restarts on the new date.
does.ms: Merekod dokumen baharu daripada salinannya (New paper received); tangga bermula semula pada tarikh baharu.

rules.en: At 30 days or less everyone alerted acknowledges within 1 working day: FWM and Chief of Staff from 30 days, COO from 15, CEO from 7.
rules.ms: Pada 30 hari atau kurang setiap yang dimaklumkan mengakui dalam 1 hari bekerja: FWM dan Ketua Staf dari 30 hari, COO dari 15, CEO dari 7.

rules.en: When Prima and the JA app differ, the ladder counts to the earlier date until FWM settles it.
rules.ms: Apabila Prima dan aplikasi JA berbeza, tangga mengira ke tarikh yang lebih awal sehingga FWM menyelesaikannya.

rules.en: Passport numbers are kept as the last 4 characters only.
rules.ms: Nombor pasport disimpan 4 aksara terakhir sahaja.

rules.en: Old paper dates and workers are added by FWM or the owner (Add, Import from file); a later correction that moves an expiry later needs the copy.
rules.ms: Tarikh dokumen lama dan pekerja ditambah oleh FWM atau pemilik (Tambah, Import dari fail); pembetulan yang melewatkan tarikh tamat perlu salinan.

sops.words: permit plks passport pasport fomema insurance insurans spikpa kdn renewal pembaharuan ladder tangga fwm foreign worker pekerja asing

title.en: Recruiting a foreign worker

purpose.en: One recruitment file per worker: agency licence, embassy confirmation, interview, age check and bilingual contract, before the FWM Manager clears travel.
purpose.ms: Satu fail rekrut bagi setiap pekerja: lesen agensi, pengesahan kedutaan, temu duga, semakan umur dan kontrak dwibahasa, sebelum Pengurus FWM membenarkan perjalanan.

label.en: Foreign workers › Recruitment steps › New recruitment file
label.ms: Pekerja asing › Langkah rekrut › Fail rekrut baharu

starter.en: FWM staff

does.en: Records each step with its paper: agency licence (not expired), embassy letter, interview result, date of birth from the passport (age 18 to 60 at travel), and the signed contract in English and Malay.
does.ms: Merekod setiap langkah dengan dokumennya: lesen agensi (belum tamat), surat kedutaan, keputusan temu duga, tarikh lahir dari pasport (umur 18 hingga 60 semasa perjalanan), dan kontrak bertandatangan dalam Bahasa Inggeris dan Melayu.

does.en: Clears the worker to travel once all five steps fit the travel date.
does.ms: Membenarkan pekerja melakukan perjalanan apabila kelima-lima langkah sesuai dengan tarikh perjalanan.

does.en: On arrival, links the worker’s staff record; the zero-fees check follows in welfare.
does.ms: Semasa ketibaan, memautkan rekod staf pekerja; semakan sifar yuran menyusul dalam kebajikan.

rules.en: A failed interview or an age outside 18 to 60 stops the file; the reason is kept and nothing is deleted.
rules.ms: Temu duga gagal atau umur di luar 18 hingga 60 menghentikan fail; sebab disimpan dan tiada yang dipadam.

rules.en: Moving the travel date after clearance re-checks the steps and may withdraw the clearance.
rules.ms: Mengalih tarikh perjalanan selepas kebenaran menyemak semula langkah dan boleh menarik balik kebenaran.

rules.en: A company manager sees only the step status of its own files.
rules.ms: Pengurus Syarikat hanya melihat status langkah fail syarikatnya sendiri.

sops.words: recruitment rekrut agency agensi embassy kedutaan interview temu duga contract kontrak travel perjalanan nepal

title.en: Foreign worker welfare checks

purpose.en: Arrival fee check, passport check and a private welfare talk every 90 days; anything raised opens a follow-up that someone else closes.
purpose.ms: Semakan yuran ketibaan, semakan pasport dan perbualan kebajikan peribadi setiap 90 hari; apa-apa yang dibangkitkan membuka susulan yang ditutup oleh orang lain.

starter.en: FWM staff

does.en: Records the arrival fee check: did the worker pay anything to get the job, to whom and how much.
does.ms: Merekod semakan yuran ketibaan: adakah pekerja membayar apa-apa untuk mendapat kerja, kepada siapa dan berapa.

does.en: Records the passport check (the worker has it, or the company keeps it with signed consent).
does.ms: Merekod semakan pasport (pekerja memegangnya, atau syarikat menyimpannya dengan persetujuan bertandatangan).

does.en: Holds a private welfare talk every 90 days and records what the worker raised.
does.ms: Mengadakan perbualan kebajikan peribadi setiap 90 hari dan merekod apa yang dibangkitkan pekerja.

who.en: Someone other than who opened it

does.en: Closes the follow-up with how it was dealt with.
does.ms: Menutup susulan dengan cara ia ditangani.

label.en: Recruitment and welfare › Close the follow-up

rules.en: Zero recruitment fees: a fee paid, a passport held without consent or a concern opens a follow-up.
rules.ms: Sifar yuran rekrut: yuran dibayar, pasport dipegang tanpa persetujuan atau kebimbangan membuka susulan.

rules.en: Confidential to FWM and group leaders.
rules.ms: Sulit kepada FWM dan pemimpin kumpulan.

sops.words: welfare kebajikan recruitment fee yuran rekrut passport pasport consent persetujuan talk perbualan iway

title.en: Recruitment cost when a worker works for another company
title.ms: Kos rekrut apabila pekerja bekerja untuk syarikat lain

purpose.en: When a foreign worker works under another company’s or a branch’s job, the host pays FWM a monthly recruitment cost and FWM pays the owning company back.
purpose.ms: Apabila pekerja asing bekerja di bawah kerja syarikat atau cawangan lain, hos membayar FWM kos rekrut bulanan dan FWM membayar balik syarikat pemilik.

starter.en: FWM staff

does.en: Sets the charge rate and the payback rate.
does.ms: Menetapkan kadar caj dan kadar bayaran balik.

does.en: Records each placement (worker, host company or branch, from and to), oldest first with the real start date.
does.ms: Merekod setiap penempatan (pekerja, syarikat atau cawangan hos, dari dan hingga), yang tertua dahulu dengan tarikh mula sebenar.

does.en: Drafts each finished month’s charges.
does.ms: Merangka caj bagi setiap bulan yang selesai.

does.en: Approves the month with a reason, or rejects it for correction.
does.ms: Meluluskan bulan itu dengan sebab, atau menolaknya untuk pembetulan.

does.en: Records the invoice, then the payment with its slip.
does.ms: Merekod invois, kemudian bayaran dengan slipnya.

rules.en: Any day in a month counts as the full month; two hosts in one month pay half each.
rules.ms: Mana-mana hari dalam sebulan dikira sebulan penuh; dua hos dalam sebulan membayar separuh setiap satu.

rules.en: A charged month is locked: a back-dated placement into it is refused until the FD or CEO rejects the draft.
rules.ms: Bulan yang telah dicaj dikunci: penempatan bertarikh ke belakang ditolak sehingga FD atau CEO menolak draf.

rules.en: The worker keeps wearing the owning company’s uniform. Legal flags go to the CEO log; they never stop the work.
rules.ms: Pekerja terus memakai uniform syarikat pemilik. Isu undang-undang dihantar ke log CEO; ia tidak menghentikan kerja.

statusNote.en: No charge can be drafted until the FD or CEO sets both rates.
statusNote.ms: Tiada caj boleh dirangka sehingga FD atau CEO menetapkan kedua-dua kadar.

sops.words: recruitment cost kos rekrut placement penempatan host hos payback bayaran balik charge caj nepali branch cawangan

title.en: Nepali EPF and SOCSO recharge
title.ms: Caj semula KWSP dan PERKESO pekerja Nepal

purpose.en: The permit company pays EPF and SOCSO; the company or branch that used the worker repays its share every month by debit note.
purpose.ms: Syarikat pemegang permit membayar KWSP dan PERKESO; syarikat atau cawangan yang menggunakan pekerja membayar balik bahagiannya setiap bulan melalui nota debit.

label.en: Nepali EPF and SOCSO › Months to charge
label.ms: KWSP dan PERKESO Nepal › Bulan untuk dicaj

starter.en: The owner company's Finance team or the FD
starter.ms: Pasukan Kewangan syarikat pemilik atau FD

does.en: Pays KWSP and PERKESO every month as usual, by the 15th, whether or not the user has repaid.
does.ms: Membayar KWSP dan PERKESO setiap bulan seperti biasa, menjelang 15hb, sama ada pengguna telah membayar balik atau tidak.

does.en: Prepares and issues the debit note per user company or branch: wage and amounts actually paid per worker, with the KWSP and PERKESO receipt numbers.
does.ms: Menyediakan dan mengeluarkan nota debit bagi setiap syarikat atau cawangan pengguna: gaji dan amaun sebenar dibayar bagi setiap pekerja, dengan nombor resit KWSP dan PERKESO.

label.en: Nepali EPF and SOCSO › Prepare the debit note
label.ms: KWSP dan PERKESO Nepal › Sediakan nota debit

who.en: User company staff or Finance; the Branch Manager for a branch
who.ms: Staf atau Kewangan syarikat pengguna; Pengurus Cawangan bagi cawangan

does.en: Transfers the full amount within 30 days and records the repayment.
does.ms: Memindahkan amaun penuh dalam 30 hari dan merekod bayaran balik.

label.en: Nepali EPF and SOCSO › Record the repayment
label.ms: KWSP dan PERKESO Nepal › Rekod bayaran balik

who.en: Owner's Finance (not who recorded the payment)

does.en: Matches the transfer to the bank statement and checks the money in.
does.ms: Memadankan pindahan dengan penyata bank dan mengesahkan wang masuk.

label.en: Nepali EPF and SOCSO › Check in the money
label.ms: KWSP dan PERKESO Nepal › Sahkan wang masuk

rules.en: A mid-month move is split by days used over days in the month.
rules.ms: Pertukaran pertengahan bulan dibahagi mengikut hari digunakan berbanding hari dalam bulan.

rules.en: The salary is not part of the debit note; it is paid by the user company or branch.
rules.ms: Gaji bukan sebahagian nota debit; ia dibayar oleh syarikat atau cawangan pengguna.

rules.en: A recharged month locks the placement; cancel the note first to change it.
rules.ms: Bulan yang telah dicaj semula mengunci penempatan; batalkan nota dahulu untuk mengubahnya.

statusNote.en: 30 days to repay and the prefilled rates are proposals waiting for Fauzan.
statusNote.ms: 30 hari untuk membayar balik dan kadar yang dipraisi masih cadangan menunggu Fauzan.

title.en: Hostel bill payment

purpose.en: The company that owns or rents a hostel asks for payment approval; FWM checks; the Operations Director or OGM, then the COO approve; the company pays.
purpose.ms: Syarikat yang memiliki atau menyewa asrama memohon kelulusan bayaran; FWM menyemak; Pengarah Operasi atau OGM, kemudian COO meluluskan; syarikat membayar.

starter.en: The owning company’s office (company manager or admin executive)
starter.ms: Pejabat syarikat pemilik (Pengurus Syarikat atau eksekutif admin)

does.en: Adds the bill on the hostel and asks for payment approval.
does.ms: Menambah bil pada asrama dan memohon kelulusan bayaran.

does.en: Checks it with a comment and passes it on, or sends it back.
does.ms: Menyemak dengan komen dan menghantarnya, atau memulangkannya.

who.en: Operations Director (private) or OGM (government), then the COO
who.ms: Pengarah Operasi (swasta) atau OGM (kerajaan), kemudian COO

does.en: Each approves with a comment, or sends it back.
does.ms: Masing-masing meluluskan dengan komen, atau memulangkannya.

does.en: Pays from the company’s bank and uploads the slip; when Finance records the payment it shows as paid at once.
does.ms: Membayar dari bank syarikat dan memuat naik slip; apabila Kewangan merekod bayaran ia terus ditunjukkan sebagai dibayar.

rules.en: Reminders 14, 7 and 3 days before due; overdue climbs to the Chief of Staff, COO and CEO.
rules.ms: Peringatan 14, 7 dan 3 hari sebelum tarikh akhir; tertunggak dinaikkan kepada Ketua Staf, COO dan CEO.

rules.en: Finance sees hostel bills in its checks and looks for each paid bill on the bank statement.
rules.ms: Kewangan melihat bil asrama dalam semakannya dan mencari setiap bil yang dibayar dalam penyata bank.

statusNote.en: Reminder days and the overdue ladder are proposals.
statusNote.ms: Hari peringatan dan tangga tertunggak masih cadangan.

sops.words: hostel asrama bill bil rent sewa utility utiliti approval kelulusan slip fwm coo

title.en: Hostel electricity and water above the allowance
title.ms: Elektrik dan air asrama melebihi elaun

purpose.en: Prima works out each worker’s share of electricity above RM30 and water above RM20 a month; HR decides per person: a notice or, from the third time, a deduction.
purpose.ms: Prima mengira bahagian setiap pekerja bagi elektrik melebihi RM30 dan air melebihi RM20 sebulan; HR memutuskan bagi setiap orang: notis atau, dari kali ketiga, potongan.

starter.en: Prima, from the hostel bills

does.en: Shares the excess by bed-days for each worker.
does.ms: Membahagi lebihan mengikut hari katil bagi setiap pekerja.

does.en: Gives a notice the 1st and 2nd time, and records that the worker signed it.
does.ms: Memberi notis pada kali pertama dan kedua, dan merekod pekerja telah menandatanganinya.

label.en: Hostels › Utility excess › Give a notice

does.en: Before any deduction, files the signed contract clause and the worker’s signed acknowledgement.
does.ms: Sebelum sebarang potongan, memfailkan klausa kontrak bertandatangan dan pengakuan bertandatangan pekerja.

does.en: From the 3rd time, may choose Deduct from pay.
does.ms: Dari kali ketiga, boleh memilih Potong dari gaji.

label.en: Hostels › Utility excess › Deduct from pay
label.ms: Asrama › Lebihan utiliti › Potong dari gaji

rules.en: A deduction only when the employment contract has the utility clause; the count never resets.
rules.ms: Potongan hanya apabila kontrak pekerjaan ada klausa utiliti; kiraan tidak pernah ditetapkan semula.

rules.en: Total deductions in a month stay within 50% of wages (Employment Act s.24(8)).
rules.ms: Jumlah potongan sebulan kekal dalam 50% gaji (Akta Kerja s.24(8)).

statusNote.en: JTK’s written confirmation of the practice is not on file yet (legal item L4).
statusNote.ms: Pengesahan bertulis JTK tentang amalan ini belum ada dalam fail (isu undang-undang L4).

title.en: Hostel needs and repairs

purpose.en: The OM asks for items or a repair for a foreign worker hostel; FWM verifies, the Operations Director or OGM approves, Asset Management buys or orders the work.
purpose.ms: OM memohon barang atau pembaikan untuk asrama pekerja asing; FWM mengesahkan, Pengarah Operasi atau OGM meluluskan, Pengurusan Aset membeli atau mengarahkan kerja.

label.en: Hostels › Foreign worker hostels › Mohon keperluan
label.ms: Asrama › Asrama pekerja asing › Mohon keperluan

starter.en: OM (or the company office)

does.en: Raises the need (or a repair with before photos) on the hostel; the screen shows the residents and the items already there.
does.ms: Memohon keperluan (atau pembaikan dengan gambar sebelum) pada asrama; skrin menunjukkan penghuni dan barang yang sedia ada.

does.en: Verifies the need.
does.ms: Mengesahkan keperluan.

who.en: Operations Director or OGM (not the raiser)

does.en: Approves or rejects with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan sebab.

does.en: Sees only approved needs (hostel name and address, no worker data) and buys once against the need, within the usual COO approval limits.
does.ms: Hanya melihat keperluan yang diluluskan (nama dan alamat asrama, tiada data pekerja) dan membeli sekali bagi keperluan itu, dalam had kelulusan COO biasa.

does.en: Confirms receipt with a photo (or marks the repair done with after photos); the hostel list updates.
does.ms: Mengesahkan penerimaan dengan gambar (atau menanda pembaikan siap dengan gambar selepas); senarai asrama dikemas kini.

rules.en: Company-paid repairs need at least 2 quotes; fewer than 3 needs the Asset Director’s reason.
rules.ms: Pembaikan dibayar syarikat perlu sekurang-kurangnya 2 sebut harga; kurang daripada 3 perlu sebab Pengarah Aset.

rules.en: Weekly, monthly, audit and 90-day checks need 2 photos; a missed check shows on the OM’s Do today.
rules.ms: Semakan mingguan, bulanan, audit dan 90 hari perlu 2 gambar; semakan yang terlepas dipapar pada Buat hari ini OM.

rules.en: Damage needs a photo; a penalty only with a negligence finding and a named worker; a pay deduction is HR’s decision.
rules.ms: Kerosakan perlu gambar; denda hanya dengan dapatan kecuaian dan pekerja dinamakan; potongan gaji ialah keputusan HR.

title.en: Moving a foreign worker to another hostel or site
title.ms: Memindah pekerja asing ke asrama atau tapak lain

purpose.en: A move of hostel, site or both is signed by five people in turn, then released, received and closed by FWM with the JA reference.
purpose.ms: Pemindahan asrama, tapak atau kedua-duanya ditandatangani lima orang secara bergilir, kemudian dilepaskan, diterima dan ditutup oleh FWM dengan rujukan JA.

starter.en: The OM of the site (FWM for a new arrival)

does.en: Raises the move at least 3 working days ahead (urgent needs a reason).
does.ms: Memohon pemindahan sekurang-kurangnya 3 hari bekerja lebih awal (segera perlu sebab).

who.en: Origin PIC, new PIC, FWM, the new company head, then the Operations Director or OGM
who.ms: PIC asal, PIC baharu, FWM, ketua syarikat baharu, kemudian Pengarah Operasi atau OGM

does.en: Each signs in turn. Only FWM returns a move.
does.ms: Masing-masing menandatangani secara bergilir. Hanya FWM boleh memulangkan pemindahan.

does.en: Release, transit and receive (which creates the stay and sets the work site); FWM closes it with the JA reference.
does.ms: Lepas, dalam perjalanan dan terima (yang mencipta penginapan dan menetapkan tapak kerja); FWM menutupnya dengan rujukan JA.

rules.en: Nobody signs two steps.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa menandatangani dua langkah.

rules.en: A move to another company’s site keeps the employer; papers to file are shown as warnings.
rules.ms: Pemindahan ke tapak syarikat lain mengekalkan majikan; dokumen yang perlu difailkan dipapar sebagai amaran.

rules.en: A received move not closed after 24 hours reminds FWM.
rules.ms: Pemindahan yang diterima tetapi tidak ditutup selepas 24 jam mengingatkan FWM.

statusNote.en: The signing, release and receive steps are on the screen; the form to raise a move is not on any screen yet.
statusNote.ms: Langkah tandatangan, lepas dan terima ada pada skrin; borang untuk memohon pemindahan belum ada pada mana-mana skrin.
