title.en: Arrival cash for a new foreign worker
title.ms: Tunai ketibaan untuk pekerja asing baharu

purpose.en: Cash for a recently arrived worker with no wages yet, awaiting PLKS: FWM asks, the CEO decides each request, FWM hands it over against a signed receipt, and it is recovered from wages.
purpose.ms: Tunai untuk pekerja yang baru tiba tanpa gaji lagi, menunggu PLKS: FWM memohon, CEO memutuskan setiap permohonan, FWM menyerahkannya dengan resit bertandatangan, dan ia dipulihkan daripada gaji.

starter.en: FWM Manager

does.en: Requests each amount and purpose, and sets the number of recovery months.
does.ms: Memohon setiap amaun dan tujuan, dan menetapkan bilangan bulan pemulihan.

does.en: Records the Finance/legal review for the record: reviewed cap, months, receivable account and references.
does.ms: Merekod semakan Kewangan/undang-undang bagi rekod itu: had yang disemak, bulan, akaun belum terima dan rujukan.

who.en: CEO (or the FD as the CEO’s stand-in)

does.en: Approves or refuses each request with a reason, never their own.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak setiap permohonan dengan sebab, bukan permohonan sendiri.

does.en: Records the actual handover and attaches the worker’s genuine signed receipt for this payment.
does.ms: Merekod penyerahan sebenar dan melampirkan resit bertandatangan asli pekerja bagi bayaran ini.

does.en: Recovers it from the first wage months over the months FWM set, within the reviewed cap.
does.ms: Memulihkannya daripada bulan gaji pertama mengikut bulan yang ditetapkan FWM, dalam had yang disemak.

rules.en: Approval creates no debt; only a recorded handover does.
rules.ms: Kelulusan tidak mewujudkan hutang; hanya penyerahan yang direkod.

rules.en: Recovery is held until the genuine signed receipt is attached; a stored signature is never pasted.
rules.ms: Pemulihan ditahan sehingga resit bertandatangan asli dilampirkan; tandatangan tersimpan tidak sekali-kali ditampal.

rules.en: The FD decides only while the CEO has turned the stand-in on, and never a request the FD made.
rules.ms: FD hanya memutuskan semasa CEO menghidupkan pengganti, dan tidak sekali-kali permohonan yang dibuat FD.

statusNote.en: Each record needs the Finance/legal review before any handover; Finance and a legal adviser review the cash treatment before real use.
statusNote.ms: Setiap rekod perlu semakan Kewangan/undang-undang sebelum sebarang penyerahan; Kewangan dan penasihat undang-undang menyemak layanan tunai sebelum penggunaan sebenar.

sops.words: arrival cash tunai ketibaan advance pendahuluan new worker pekerja baharu plks receipt resit recovery pemulihan ceo

title.en: A new lead: research to won

purpose.en: Research a prospect and survey the site before pricing; a lead is won only with an accepted quotation.
purpose.ms: Kaji prospek dan tinjau tapak sebelum memberi harga; prospek hanya menang dengan sebut harga yang diterima.

label.en: Tenders and quotations › Leads › New lead
label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Prospek › Prospek baharu

starter.en: Company admin executive, company manager or Branch Manager
starter.ms: Eksekutif admin syarikat, Pengurus Syarikat atau Pengurus Cawangan

does.en: Adds the lead, then saves the research: SSM search (company is live), payment record, current provider and risks.
does.ms: Menambah prospek, kemudian menyimpan kajian: carian SSM (syarikat aktif), rekod bayaran, penyedia semasa dan risiko.

does.en: Surveys the site and saves the survey.
does.ms: Meninjau tapak dan menyimpan tinjauan.

does.en: For a slow or unknown payer, accepts the risk with a reason (deposit, terms).
does.ms: Bagi pembayar lambat atau tidak diketahui, menerima risiko dengan sebab (deposit, terma).

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Prospek › Terima

does.en: Links the quotation, then marks the lead won, lost to another, or dropped.
does.ms: Memautkan sebut harga, kemudian menanda prospek menang, kalah kepada pihak lain, atau digugurkan.

rules.en: A lead another group company is chasing shows as a conflict.
rules.ms: Prospek yang sedang dikejar syarikat kumpulan lain ditunjukkan sebagai konflik.

rules.en: A lead with no next step for 14 days is flagged.
rules.ms: Prospek tanpa langkah seterusnya selama 14 hari ditanda.

rules.en: A branch may find a lead; the licensed company still contracts.
rules.ms: Cawangan boleh menemui prospek; syarikat berlesen tetap yang berkontrak.

sops.words: lead prospek prospect client research kajian ssm survey tinjauan won menang sales jualan

title.en: Quotation

purpose.en: The admin team prepares a quotation; the company manager approves it before it goes to the client.
purpose.ms: Pasukan admin menyediakan sebut harga; Pengurus Syarikat meluluskannya sebelum dihantar kepada klien.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Sebut harga baharu

starter.en: Company admin executive

does.en: Prepares the quotation (client, site, guards, hours, rate, validity) and saves the draft.
does.ms: Menyediakan sebut harga (klien, tapak, pengawal, jam, kadar, tempoh sah) dan menyimpan draf.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Sebut harga

does.en: Sends it to the manager for approval.
does.ms: Menghantarnya kepada pengurus untuk kelulusan.

does.en: Approves within written authority, or returns it for changes.
does.ms: Meluluskan dalam had kuasa bertulis, atau memulangkan untuk perubahan.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Sebut harga

does.en: Marks it sent to the client, then client accepted or client rejected.
does.ms: Menanda dihantar kepada klien, kemudian klien terima atau klien tolak.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Sebut harga

rules.en: The preparer never approves their own quotation.
rules.ms: Penyedia tidak sekali-kali meluluskan sebut harga sendiri.

rules.en: Guards, rate or date are corrected with a reason; every change is audited.
rules.ms: Pengawal, kadar atau tarikh dibetulkan dengan sebab; setiap perubahan diaudit.

rules.en: No automatic pricing until costing rules are approved; prices are typed by the admin team.
rules.ms: Tiada harga automatik sehingga peraturan kos diluluskan; harga ditaip oleh pasukan admin.

sops.words: quotation sebut harga quote harga price client klien approve lulus company manager

title.en: A tender from notice to submission

purpose.en: Bid in the licensed company’s own name: papers, checklist, decision, protocol steps, bid files, two signatures and the submission slip.
purpose.ms: Bida atas nama syarikat berlesen sendiri: kertas, senarai semak, keputusan, langkah protokol, fail bida, dua tandatangan dan slip penghantaran.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Tambah tender

starter.en: Company admin executive or the Director Office
starter.ms: Eksekutif admin syarikat atau Pejabat Pengarah

does.en: Adds the tender and uploads the papers (notice, arahan petender, specification, forms).
does.ms: Menambah tender dan memuat naik kertas (notis, arahan petender, spesifikasi, borang).

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Saluran tender

does.en: Checks and confirms the checklist Prima drafted from the papers.
does.ms: Menyemak dan mengesahkan senarai semak yang dirangka Prima daripada kertas.

does.en: Decides Teruskan, Tangguh or Tidak bida, with the reason. Questions go to the buyer in writing.
does.ms: Memutuskan Teruskan, Tangguh atau Tidak bida, dengan sebab. Soalan dihantar kepada pembeli secara bertulis.

does.en: Ticks each protocol step with who and when, and uploads the bid files named as the tender asks. The technical part must carry no company name.
does.ms: Menanda setiap langkah protokol dengan siapa dan bila, dan memuat naik fail bida dinamakan seperti yang diminta tender. Bahagian teknikal tidak boleh ada nama syarikat.

does.en: The preparer signs, the company manager signs that all is verified, then the submission slip is recorded. Outcome: won, lost or no bid.
does.ms: Penyedia menandatangani, Pengurus Syarikat menandatangani bahawa semua disahkan, kemudian slip penghantaran direkod. Keputusan: menang, kalah atau tiada bida.

rules.en: A company bids only with a valid KDN licence and insurance, and MOF registration for government tenders.
rules.ms: Syarikat hanya membida dengan lesen KDN dan insurans yang sah, dan pendaftaran MOF bagi tender kerajaan.

rules.en: A tender cannot move on with a protocol step not done.
rules.ms: Tender tidak boleh diteruskan dengan langkah protokol yang belum siap.

rules.en: The price check is a guide only: not a wage and not an approved bid.
rules.ms: Semakan harga hanya panduan: bukan gaji dan bukan bida yang diluluskan.

sops.words: tender bid bida eperolehan myprocurement protocol protokol submission penghantaran kdn mof checklist senarai semak

title.en: Joint tender (several group companies)

purpose.en: The Director Office chooses which companies enter the same tender; each fills its own bid; the CEO gets the report after closing.
purpose.ms: Pejabat Pengarah memilih syarikat yang memasuki tender yang sama; setiap satu mengisi bidanya sendiri; CEO menerima laporan selepas tutup.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Tender bersama

starter.en: Director Office

does.en: Records the tender found, chooses the companies and sends them the checked checklist.
does.ms: Merekod tender yang ditemui, memilih syarikat dan menghantar senarai semak yang disemak.

label.en: Tenders and quotations › Tenders and quotations found
label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Tender dan sebut harga ditemui

does.en: Fills its own bid.
does.ms: Mengisi bidanya sendiri.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Tender bersama

does.en: Verifies the bid with the submission slip.
does.ms: Mengesahkan bida dengan slip penghantaran.

label.ms: Tender dan sebut harga › Tender bersama

does.en: 24 hours after closing, the CEO’s home shows how many entered, filled the guide and slipped.
does.ms: 24 jam selepas tutup, laman utama CEO menunjukkan berapa yang masuk, mengisi panduan dan menghantar slip.

rules.en: A company may tell the Director Office about a tender it found; that only informs, no approval is needed.
rules.ms: Syarikat boleh memaklumkan Pejabat Pengarah tentang tender yang ditemuinya; itu hanya makluman, tiada kelulusan diperlukan.

rules.en: Only a tender whose checklist is checked is sent to companies.
rules.ms: Hanya tender yang senarai semaknya sudah disemak dihantar kepada syarikat.

sops.words: joint tender tender bersama director office pejabat pengarah peluang opportunity group companies

title.en: Client due diligence

purpose.en: Before taking a client on, the company office checks seven things and the company manager decides. Repeated every 12 months.
purpose.ms: Sebelum menerima klien, pejabat syarikat menyemak tujuh perkara dan Pengurus Syarikat memutuskan. Diulang setiap 12 bulan.

label.en: Clients › the client › Open the client file
label.ms: Klien › klien itu › Buka fail klien

starter.en: Company admin executive

does.en: Works the seven checks with a reference each: who the client is (SSM or agency), signer’s authority, lawful purpose, can pay, no conflict, site risk, client data and CCTV handled.
does.ms: Menjalankan tujuh semakan dengan rujukan masing-masing: siapa klien (SSM atau agensi), kuasa penandatangan, tujuan sah, mampu bayar, tiada konflik, risiko tapak, data klien dan CCTV yang dikendalikan.

label.en: Clients › client file › Client due diligence
label.ms: Klien › fail klien › Usaha wajar klien

does.en: Decides with a reason: accepted, accepted with conditions (needed when there is a concern), or declined.
does.ms: Memutuskan dengan sebab: diterima, diterima bersyarat (perlu jika ada kebimbangan), atau ditolak.

does.en: The contract’s mobilisation checklist will not pass until diligence is accepted and not overdue.
does.ms: Senarai semak mobilisasi kontrak tidak akan lulus sehingga usaha wajar diterima dan tidak tertunggak.

rules.en: A concern, or a check marked not needed, needs a reason.
rules.ms: Kebimbangan, atau semakan yang ditanda tidak perlu, memerlukan sebab.

rules.en: Reviewed again 12 months after the decision or when the contract ends, whichever comes first; earlier rounds are kept.
rules.ms: Disemak semula 12 bulan selepas keputusan atau apabila kontrak tamat, yang mana lebih awal; pusingan terdahulu disimpan.

sops.words: due diligence usaha wajar client klien kyc ssm iso 9001 pikm check semakan

title.en: Signed contract to site go-live

purpose.en: Record the signed contract, work the mobilisation items with proof, sign the Ready-to-Operate Certificate, go live, then review at day 1, 7, 14 and 30.
purpose.ms: Rekod kontrak yang ditandatangani, jalankan item mobilisasi dengan bukti, tandatangan Sijil Sedia Beroperasi, mula beroperasi, kemudian semak pada hari 1, 7, 14 dan 30.

starter.en: Company manager

does.en: Records the signed contract or letter of award with its copy, posts and rates, terms and bond. Prima can read the attached copy and propose values; nothing is filled until the manager presses Use.
does.ms: Merekod kontrak atau surat setuju terima yang ditandatangani dengan salinannya, pos dan kadar, terma dan bon. Prima boleh membaca salinan yang dilampirkan dan mencadangkan nilai; tiada yang diisi sehingga pengurus menekan Use.

who.en: Company office, Operations (OM and up), HR, Finance, Arms Control
who.ms: Pejabat syarikat, Operasi (OM ke atas), HR, Kewangan, Kawalan Senjata

does.en: Work each mobilisation item with proof (photo or document), including the assignment instructions for every post, signed by the client.
does.ms: Menjalankan setiap item mobilisasi dengan bukti (gambar atau dokumen), termasuk arahan tugasan bagi setiap pos, ditandatangani klien.

does.en: Accepts the risk on a non-critical item for up to 30 days if needed, signs the Ready-to-Operate Certificate once every critical item is done, then Go live.
does.ms: Menerima risiko bagi item tidak kritikal sehingga 30 hari jika perlu, menandatangani Sijil Sedia Beroperasi apabila setiap item kritikal siap, kemudian Go live.

does.en: Record the reviews at day 1, 7, 14 and 30; day 30 checks the first invoice against the contract.
does.ms: Merekod semakan pada hari 1, 7, 14 dan 30; hari 30 menyemak invois pertama dengan kontrak.

rules.en: Billing changes only through a recorded variation; a new site or more guards opens its own round and its own Ready-to-Operate.
rules.ms: Bil berubah hanya melalui variasi yang direkod; tapak baharu atau tambahan pengawal membuka pusingan dan Sedia Beroperasi tersendiri.

rules.en: Prima re-checks the roster, guard clearance and client due diligence when Ready-to-Operate is signed.
rules.ms: Prima menyemak semula roster, kelulusan pengawal dan usaha wajar klien apabila Sedia Beroperasi ditandatangani.

rules.en: Guards do not see the assignment instructions in Prima; officers brief them on site.
rules.ms: Pengawal tidak melihat arahan tugasan dalam Prima; pegawai memberi taklimat di tapak.

statusNote.en: Item wording, due days and default terms are proposals until Operations confirms.
statusNote.ms: Perkataan item, hari akhir dan terma lalai masih cadangan sehingga Operasi mengesahkan.

sops.words: contract kontrak mobilisation mobilisasi ready-to-operate sedia beroperasi go live site tapak variation variasi renewal pembaharuan loa

title.en: Looking after a client

purpose.en: Visits, monthly reports, satisfaction, complaints and invoices sent, logged on the client so the company and the COO see how each client is doing.
purpose.ms: Lawatan, laporan bulanan, kepuasan, aduan dan invois dihantar, dilog pada klien supaya syarikat dan COO melihat keadaan setiap klien.

starter.en: OM, Operations Director or officers

does.en: Logs each visit, meeting or call, the monthly report sent, and the client’s satisfaction rating.
does.ms: Mencatat setiap lawatan, mesyuarat atau panggilan, laporan bulanan yang dihantar, dan penilaian kepuasan klien.

does.en: Logs a complaint and closes it with what was done.
does.ms: Mencatat aduan dan menutupnya dengan tindakan yang diambil.

does.en: Records each invoice sent to the client with proof.
does.ms: Merekod setiap invois yang dihantar kepada klien dengan bukti.

does.en: Decides each renewal and sends the renewal offer.
does.ms: Memutuskan setiap pembaharuan dan menghantar tawaran pembaharuan.

rules.en: Unknown is never shown as fine: a client with no record shows Unknown.
rules.ms: Tidak diketahui tidak pernah dipapar sebagai baik: klien tanpa rekod dipapar Tidak diketahui.

rules.en: The COO monitors every company and holds a monthly operations meeting with each.
rules.ms: COO memantau setiap syarikat dan mengadakan mesyuarat operasi bulanan dengan setiap satu.

sops.words: client klien visit lawatan monthly report laporan bulanan satisfaction kepuasan complaint aduan invoice invois renewal pembaharuan crm

title.en: Client report link

purpose.en: The company manager makes a time-limited, read-only link for one client showing its sites, incidents, complaints and invoices sent.
purpose.ms: Pengurus Syarikat membuat pautan baca sahaja bertempoh untuk seorang klien yang menunjukkan tapak, insiden, aduan dan invois dihantar.

label.en: Clients › the client › Client report links
label.ms: Klien › klien itu › Pautan laporan klien

starter.en: Company manager

does.en: Makes the link for a period of up to 92 days, open 1 to 30 days, naming who at the client receives it, and previews it.
does.ms: Membuat pautan bagi tempoh sehingga 92 hari, terbuka 1 hingga 30 hari, menamakan penerima di pihak klien, dan pratonton.

does.en: Sends the link from their own email. Prima does not send email.
does.ms: Menghantar pautan dari e-mel sendiri. Prima tidak menghantar e-mel.

does.en: Revokes a link with a reason; it stops working at once.
does.ms: Membatalkan pautan dengan sebab; ia berhenti berfungsi serta-merta.

rules.en: The page never shows staff or guard names, case descriptions, overdue amounts or payment status.
rules.ms: Halaman tidak pernah menunjukkan nama staf atau pengawal, butiran kes, amaun tertunggak atau status bayaran.

rules.en: At most 5 open links per client. Every view is audited.
rules.ms: Maksimum 5 pautan terbuka bagi setiap klien. Setiap paparan diaudit.

statusNote.en: Built. Links for real clients need Fauzan’s approval and the link settings; until then they cannot be made.
statusNote.ms: Sudah dibina. Pautan untuk klien sebenar memerlukan kelulusan Fauzan dan tetapan pautan; sehingga itu ia tidak boleh dibuat.

sops.words: client portal portal klien share link pautan kongsi report laporan read-only

title.en: Buy for the store (purchase with 3 quotes)

purpose.en: Everything Procurement buys for operations and cleaning: 3 supplier quotes and an online price, COO (and CEO) approval, order, goods received with the DO, Finance’s three-way match, SQL Account.
purpose.ms: Semua yang Perolehan beli untuk operasi dan pembersihan: 3 sebut harga pembekal dan harga dalam talian, kelulusan COO (dan CEO), pesanan, terima barang dengan DO, padanan tiga hala Kewangan, SQL Account.

starter.en: Procurement executive, or a company manager or admin executive for their company (a site supplies “buy” line becomes a purchase too)
starter.ms: Eksekutif Perolehan, atau pengurus syarikat atau eksekutif admin bagi syarikatnya (baris “beli” permohonan bekalan tapak juga menjadi pembelian)

does.en: Raises the purchase with its lines, quantities and estimated prices.
does.ms: Membuka pembelian dengan baris, kuantiti dan anggaran harga.

does.en: Adds 3 quotes from approved suppliers and the online or marketplace price, each with its document, picks the quote and sends it for approval. Not the lowest, or more than 5% above online, needs a reason.
does.ms: Menambah 3 sebut harga daripada pembekal yang diluluskan dan harga dalam talian atau marketplace, setiap satu dengan dokumen, memilih sebut harga dan menghantar untuk kelulusan. Bukan yang terendah, atau lebih 5% di atas harga dalam talian, perlu sebab.

does.en: Approve or reject with a note. Within the CEO’s purchase limit the COO approves alone; above it, or with no limit set, the CEO approves after the COO.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan catatan. Dalam had pembelian CEO, COO meluluskan seorang; melebihi had atau jika had belum ditetapkan, CEO meluluskan selepas COO.

does.en: Places the order and records the PO number.
does.ms: Membuat pesanan dan merekod nombor PO.

does.en: Counts what arrived, records the supplier’s DO number with a photo of the DO, and any damaged or wrong pieces with a note. Only good pieces go into the store.
does.ms: Mengira barang yang tiba, merekod nombor DO pembekal dengan gambar DO, dan sebarang helai rosak atau salah dengan catatan. Hanya helai baik masuk ke stor.

does.en: Matches the invoice: order, goods received and the e-Invoice UUID (within 1%). Only a passed match is entered in SQL Account, then the reference is recorded.
does.ms: Memadankan invois: pesanan, barang diterima dan UUID e-Invois (dalam 1%). Hanya padanan yang lulus dimasukkan ke SQL Account, kemudian rujukannya direkod.

rules.en: Every purchase needs 3 quotes, whatever the amount; an office purchase needs 2 online prices.
rules.ms: Setiap pembelian perlu 3 sebut harga, walau berapa pun jumlahnya; pembelian pejabat perlu 2 harga dalam talian.

rules.en: Nobody approves their own request, and an approver never receives the goods.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa meluluskan permohonan sendiri, dan pelulus tidak menerima barang.

rules.en: A rejected purchase is corrected and sent again with fresh quotes and a fresh approval round.
rules.ms: Pembelian yang ditolak dibetulkan dan dihantar semula dengan sebut harga baharu dan pusingan kelulusan baharu.

rules.en: No goods are received while a major stock count is open.
rules.ms: Tiada barang diterima semasa kiraan stok besar dibuka.

source.decided: Fauzan, 27 Oct 2026 (PUR-DOA); 3 Nov 2026 (CEO limit); 14 Nov 2026 (U16 DO, U-X14)

sops.words: buy beli purchase pembelian quote sebut harga quotation po order pesanan grn goods received terima barang do invoice invois e-invoice sql account

title.en: Approve a supplier

purpose.en: Only an approved supplier can quote: Procurement registers it, Finance verifies the bank account, and the anti-bribery checks are on file and reviewed every year.
purpose.ms: Hanya pembekal yang diluluskan boleh memberi sebut harga: Perolehan mendaftarkannya, Kewangan mengesahkan akaun bank, dan semakan anti-rasuah disimpan dan disemak setiap tahun.

starter.en: Procurement executive

does.en: Adds the supplier: name, SSM number, categories, bank and account.
does.ms: Menambah pembekal: nama, nombor SSM, kategori, bank dan akaun.

does.en: Verifies the bank account against the bank letter.
does.ms: Mengesahkan akaun bank berdasarkan surat bank.

does.en: Records the conflict-of-interest declaration and the anti-bribery acknowledgement (MACC Act s.17A).
does.ms: Merekod pengisytiharan konflik kepentingan dan pengakuan anti-rasuah (Akta SPRM s.17A).

does.en: Does the yearly review; blocks or unblocks a supplier with a reason.
does.ms: Membuat semakan tahunan; menyekat atau membuka sekatan pembekal dengan sebab.

rules.en: A supplier with a check missing, a review overdue (365 days) or a block cannot be chosen for a quote.
rules.ms: Pembekal yang kurang semakan, semakan tahunan lewat (365 hari) atau disekat tidak boleh dipilih untuk sebut harga.

rules.en: One registration per SSM number per company.
rules.ms: Satu pendaftaran bagi setiap nombor SSM bagi setiap syarikat.

sops.words: supplier pembekal vendor ssm bank anti-bribery rasuah sprm coi

title.en: Office supplies, utilities and rent request; operation claim
title.ms: Permohonan bekalan pejabat, utiliti dan sewa; tuntutan operasi

purpose.en: Office consumables (not IT or asset items), utilities and rent are requested by the company manager and approved by the Chief of Staff then the COO. An operation claim is set by the OM and approved by the COO.
purpose.ms: Bekalan pejabat (bukan barang IT atau aset), utiliti dan sewa dipohon oleh pengurus syarikat dan diluluskan oleh Ketua Staf kemudian COO. Tuntutan operasi ditetapkan oleh OM dan diluluskan oleh COO.

starter.en: Company manager (office request); OM (operation claim)

does.en: Enters the month’s lines with the bill attached and sends. Rent or utilities can start from last month’s approved request.
does.ms: Memasukkan baris bulan itu dengan bil dilampirkan dan menghantar. Sewa atau utiliti boleh bermula daripada permohonan bulan lepas yang diluluskan.

does.en: Approves, sends back or rejects with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan, memulangkan atau menolak dengan sebab.

label.en: Claims and requests › Waiting for me

does.en: Gives the final approval, sends back or rejects with a reason.
does.ms: Memberi kelulusan akhir, memulangkan atau menolak dengan sebab.

label.en: Claims and requests › Waiting for me

rules.en: IT items go to IT and assets (furniture, renovation) to Asset Management, not here.
rules.ms: Barang IT dihantar kepada IT dan aset (perabot, pengubahsuaian) kepada Pengurusan Aset, bukan di sini.

rules.en: Every decision needs a reason; nobody approves their own request.
rules.ms: Setiap keputusan perlu sebab; tiada sesiapa meluluskan permohonan sendiri.

sops.words: office request permohonan pejabat supplies bekalan utilities utiliti rent sewa operation claim tuntutan operasi chief of staff ketua staf coo

title.en: Paying a supplier or a bill

purpose.en: Every payment out of a company: Finance prepares it, someone else reviews it, the right approver approves it, and a fourth person records the release after paying in the bank portal.
purpose.ms: Setiap bayaran keluar dari syarikat: Kewangan menyediakannya, orang lain menyemak, pelulus yang betul meluluskan, dan orang keempat merekod pelepasan selepas membayar di portal bank.

starter.en: Finance data entry, the team deputy or leader, the Finance Director (FD) or the CEO
starter.ms: Kemasukan data Kewangan, timbalan atau ketua pasukan, Pengarah Kewangan (FD) atau CEO

does.en: Prepares the payment: payee from the verified payee list, what it is for (this decides the approver), amount, due date, bank account, the SQL Account document number and at least one supporting document.
does.ms: Menyediakan bayaran: penerima dari senarai penerima yang disahkan, untuk apa (ini menentukan pelulus), amaun, tarikh akhir, akaun bank, nombor dokumen SQL Account dan sekurang-kurangnya satu dokumen sokongan.

does.en: Reviews it with a comment, or returns it with a reason. Never the preparer.
does.ms: Menyemak dengan komen, atau memulangkan dengan sebab. Bukan penyedia.

who.en: FD or CEO (Finance payments); COO or CEO (Operations, IT, FWM, Procurement, Transport, Goodwill Empire)
who.ms: FD atau CEO (bayaran Kewangan); COO atau CEO (Operasi, IT, FWM, Perolehan, Pengangkutan, Goodwill Empire)

does.en: Approves with a comment or returns it. The COO does this on his own "Payments to approve" page. Never the preparer or the reviewer.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan komen atau memulangkan. COO melakukannya di halaman "Bayaran untuk diluluskan" miliknya. Bukan penyedia atau penyemak.

who.en: Finance team (not the approver, not the preparer)

does.en: Pays in the bank portal, then records the release in Prima with the bank reference, the last 4 digits and the account name the portal shows. Prima stops it if they differ from the verified payee.
does.ms: Membayar di portal bank, kemudian merekod pelepasan dalam Prima dengan rujukan bank, 4 digit terakhir dan nama akaun yang ditunjukkan portal. Prima menghalang jika berbeza daripada penerima yang disahkan.

does.en: Matches the payment to the bank statement once it is loaded, and lists any release that fails the check for the leaders, FD and CEO.
does.ms: Memadankan bayaran dengan penyata bank apabila dimuat naik, dan menyenaraikan pelepasan yang gagal semakan untuk ketua, FD dan CEO.

rules.en: Every approval needs a comment; returns and cancellations need a reason of at least 10 characters.
rules.ms: Setiap kelulusan perlu komen; pemulangan dan pembatalan perlu sebab sekurang-kurangnya 10 aksara.

rules.en: Prepare, review, approve and release are four different people. The CEO is bound by the same rule.
rules.ms: Sedia, semak, lulus dan lepas ialah empat orang berbeza. CEO juga terikat dengan peraturan yang sama.

rules.en: An approval lapses after 30 days if not released; the payment goes back for a fresh approval.
rules.ms: Kelulusan luput selepas 30 hari jika tidak dilepaskan; bayaran kembali untuk kelulusan baharu.

rules.en: The same SQL document, or the same payee and amount, is refused as a likely duplicate.
rules.ms: Dokumen SQL yang sama, atau penerima dan amaun yang sama, ditolak sebagai kemungkinan pendua.

rules.en: Prima never pays: money moves only in the bank portal. Payments of RM500,000 or more also remind the CEO.
rules.ms: Prima tidak pernah membayar: wang bergerak hanya di portal bank. Bayaran RM500,000 ke atas turut mengingatkan CEO.

statusNote.en: Approval in Teams is built but switched off; every payment is approved in Prima. SQL Account is not connected yet.
statusNote.ms: Kelulusan dalam Teams sudah dibina tetapi dimatikan; setiap bayaran diluluskan dalam Prima. SQL Account belum disambungkan.

sops.words: payment bayaran pay supplier pembekal bill bil release lepas approve lulus coo fd voucher baucar bank portal

title.en: Payment request from a company

purpose.en: A company head asks for money to be paid. The department head, Finance and the COO (or FD) approve it once; Finance then pays it without a second approval.
purpose.ms: Ketua syarikat memohon wang dibayar. Ketua jabatan, Kewangan dan COO (atau FD) meluluskannya sekali; Kewangan kemudian membayar tanpa kelulusan kedua.

starter.en: The company head (company manager)

does.en: Creates the request and chooses what it is for; that decides the department head who approves.
does.ms: Membuat permohonan dan memilih untuk apa; itu menentukan ketua jabatan yang meluluskan.

does.en: Approves or returns it: OGM (government sites, Procurement & Inventory, Goodwill Empire), Operations Director (private sites), IT Manager, FWM Manager or the Transport head. Finance subjects skip this step.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau memulangkan: OGM (tapak kerajaan, Perolehan & Inventori, Goodwill Empire), Pengarah Operasi (tapak swasta), Pengurus IT, Pengurus FWM atau ketua Pengangkutan. Perkara Kewangan melangkau langkah ini.

who.en: Finance (the company's team leader or deputy, or the FD)
who.ms: Kewangan (ketua atau timbalan pasukan syarikat, atau FD)

does.en: Checks the calculation, or returns it.
does.ms: Menyemak kiraan, atau memulangkannya.

who.en: COO or CEO (COO departments); FD or CEO (Finance)
who.ms: COO atau CEO (jabatan COO); FD atau CEO (Kewangan)

does.en: Gives the final approval with a comment, or returns it.
does.ms: Memberi kelulusan akhir dengan komen, atau memulangkannya.

does.en: Prepares the payment from the approved request (same amount). The request’s final approval counts as the payment’s approval; review and release follow as for any payment.
does.ms: Menyediakan bayaran daripada permohonan yang diluluskan (amaun sama). Kelulusan akhir permohonan dikira sebagai kelulusan bayaran; semakan dan pelepasan seperti bayaran biasa.

rules.en: Nobody acts twice on a request, and the creator never approves it.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa bertindak dua kali pada satu permohonan, dan pembuatnya tidak sekali-kali meluluskannya.

rules.en: A return, or a lapse of its payment, sends it back to the company head, and the whole chain approves again.
rules.ms: Pemulangan, atau bayarannya luput, menghantarnya kembali kepada ketua syarikat, dan seluruh rantaian meluluskan semula.

rules.en: A returned request can be edited and resubmitted; its history and documents are kept.
rules.ms: Permohonan yang dipulangkan boleh disunting dan dihantar semula; sejarah dan dokumennya disimpan.

sops.words: payment request permohonan bayaran company head ketua syarikat department head ogm coo claim tuntutan

title.en: Adding and verifying a payee

purpose.en: Money goes only to a payee on the company’s payee list whose bank details someone else has verified by call-back.
purpose.ms: Wang hanya dibayar kepada penerima dalam senarai syarikat yang butiran banknya telah disahkan oleh orang lain melalui panggilan semula.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Paying out › Add payee
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bayaran keluar › Tambah penerima

starter.en: Finance team

does.en: Adds the payee: name, type, registration number, bank, the last 4 digits only and the account name the bank shows.
does.ms: Menambah penerima: nama, jenis, nombor pendaftaran, bank, 4 digit terakhir sahaja dan nama akaun yang ditunjukkan bank.

does.en: Verifies it: calls back on a number from the company’s own records (never the number on the request), or uses a bank letter or the portal’s name check, and records where the number came from.
does.ms: Mengesahkan: membuat panggilan semula ke nombor dari rekod syarikat sendiri (bukan nombor pada permohonan), atau guna surat bank atau semakan nama portal, dan merekod sumber nombor itu.

does.en: When the payee changes bank account: Change bank details. The payee goes back to "To verify" and its open payments are held until verified again.
does.ms: Apabila penerima menukar akaun bank: Tukar butiran bank. Penerima kembali ke "Untuk disahkan" dan bayaran terbukanya ditahan sehingga disahkan semula.

rules.en: Prima never keeps full account numbers, bank passwords or TACs.
rules.ms: Prima tidak pernah menyimpan nombor akaun penuh, kata laluan bank atau TAC.

rules.en: Whoever entered or changed a payee’s bank details does not prepare, review, approve or release payments to that payee.
rules.ms: Sesiapa yang memasukkan atau menukar butiran bank penerima tidak menyediakan, menyemak, meluluskan atau melepaskan bayaran kepada penerima itu.

rules.en: A blocked payee cannot be used. The team leader, FD or CEO blocks or unblocks with a reason; an unblocked payee is verified again.
rules.ms: Penerima yang disekat tidak boleh digunakan. Ketua pasukan, FD atau CEO menyekat atau membuka sekatan dengan sebab; penerima yang dibuka sekatan disahkan semula.

sops.words: payee penerima supplier pembekal bank account akaun call-back panggilan semula verify sahkan fraud penipuan

title.en: Bank statement and reconciliation

purpose.en: Each month, for every bank account: load the statement, paste SQL Account’s ledger, let Prima pair the lines, explain the rest and have it reviewed.
purpose.ms: Setiap bulan, bagi setiap akaun bank: muat naik penyata, tampal lejar SQL Account, biar Prima memadankan baris, terangkan bakinya dan minta disemak.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bank › Muat naik penyata

starter.en: Finance team (not whoever released payments from that account that month)
starter.ms: Pasukan Kewangan (bukan sesiapa yang melepaskan bayaran dari akaun itu bulan tersebut)

does.en: Loads the month’s statement (CSV from the bank portal) with the opening and closing balance. Prima refuses a file that does not add up.
does.ms: Memuat naik penyata bulan itu (CSV dari portal bank) dengan baki awal dan akhir. Prima menolak fail yang tidak seimbang.

does.en: Pastes SQL Account’s ledger for the same account and presses Reconcile now. Prima pairs lines by reference, amount and date and lists what is left.
does.ms: Menampal lejar SQL Account bagi akaun yang sama dan tekan Reconcile now. Prima memadankan baris mengikut rujukan, amaun dan tarikh serta menyenaraikan bakinya.

does.en: Explains each bank-only line with its SQL posting reference, or matches by hand with a comment, until the balance proves to RM0.00.
does.ms: Menerangkan setiap baris yang hanya ada di bank dengan rujukan catatan SQL, atau memadankan secara manual dengan komen, sehingga baki terbukti RM0.00.

who.en: Someone who did not run it

does.en: Reviews the reconciliation with a comment.
does.ms: Menyemak penyesuaian dengan komen.

rules.en: Banks are reconciled by the 10th of the next month.
rules.ms: Bank disesuaikan selewat-lewatnya 10hb bulan berikutnya.

rules.en: Money out with no approved Prima payment, and payments released 5 or more days ago that are not on a statement, must be explained before the close.
rules.ms: Wang keluar tanpa bayaran Prima yang diluluskan, dan bayaran yang dilepaskan 5 hari atau lebih tetapi tiada dalam penyata, mesti diterangkan sebelum tutup akaun.

rules.en: Nobody hand-matches a payment they prepared, approved or released.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa memadankan secara manual bayaran yang mereka sediakan, luluskan atau lepaskan.

rules.en: A reviewed reconciliation is redone only by the FD or the CEO.
rules.ms: Penyesuaian yang telah disemak hanya dibuat semula oleh FD atau CEO.

statusNote.en: SQL Account is not connected: its ledger is an export staff paste in.
statusNote.ms: SQL Account belum disambungkan: lejarnya dieksport dan ditampal oleh staf.

sops.words: bank statement penyata reconciliation penyesuaian rekonsiliasi bank rec csv ledger lejar sql account match padan

title.en: Month-end close (approved financials)
title.ms: Tutup akaun hujung bulan (penyata kewangan diluluskan)

purpose.en: Each company’s last month is closed only when SQL Account is closed, every bank is reconciled, the statement tests pass and every exception is explained; the FD or CEO then approves the financials.
purpose.ms: Bulan lepas setiap syarikat hanya ditutup apabila SQL Account ditutup, setiap bank disesuaikan, ujian penyata lulus dan setiap pengecualian diterangkan; FD atau CEO kemudian meluluskan penyata kewangan.

starter.en: The company's Finance team

does.en: Finishes the monthly checks (bank reconciliations, ageing, e-Invoice, SST, intercompany, statement tests FS-01 to FS-12) and attaches each bank’s reconciliation report.
does.ms: Menyiapkan semakan bulanan (penyesuaian bank, umur hutang, e-Invois, SST, antara syarikat, ujian penyata FS-01 hingga FS-12) dan melampirkan laporan penyesuaian setiap bank.

does.en: Explains every exception, then sends the close for review.
does.ms: Menerangkan setiap pengecualian, kemudian menghantar penutupan untuk semakan.

label.en: Finance › Month-end close › Send for review
label.ms: Kewangan › Tutup hujung bulan › Hantar untuk semakan

who.en: Team deputy or leader (not the preparer)

does.en: Marks it reviewed with a comment, or returns it.
does.ms: Menanda sudah disemak dengan komen, atau memulangkannya.

label.ms: Kewangan › Tutup hujung bulan › Tanda disemak

who.en: FD or CEO (not the preparer or reviewer)
who.ms: FD atau CEO (bukan penyedia atau penyemak)

does.en: Approves the financials once the month’s bank pack is reviewed, or returns it to the team to explain what appeared after review.
does.ms: Meluluskan penyata kewangan setelah pek bank bulan itu disemak, atau memulangkan kepada pasukan untuk menerangkan apa yang muncul selepas semakan.

label.ms: Kewangan › Tutup hujung bulan › Luluskan penyata kewangan

rules.en: Blocked while: no SQL Account figures in the last 48 hours, the month is not closed in SQL Account, a bank is not reconciled, or FS-01, FS-02 or FS-06 is not exactly RM0.00.
rules.ms: Disekat selagi: tiada angka SQL Account dalam 48 jam lepas, bulan belum ditutup dalam SQL Account, bank belum disesuaikan, atau FS-01, FS-02 atau FS-06 bukan tepat RM0.00.

rules.en: The month is closed by the 15th. Reopening needs a reason.
rules.ms: Bulan ditutup selewat-lewatnya 15hb. Membuka semula perlu sebab.

rules.en: The FD and CEO are reminded of closes not approved by the 15th.
rules.ms: FD dan CEO diingatkan tentang penutupan yang belum diluluskan menjelang 15hb.

statusNote.en: SQL Account figures are typed from its reports until it is connected.
statusNote.ms: Angka SQL Account ditaip daripada laporannya sehingga ia disambungkan.

sops.words: month end close tutup akaun hujung bulan financials penyata kewangan fs-01 fs-06 approve lulus fd

title.en: Monthly packs: bank, payment, audit file, auditor and tax
title.ms: Pek bulanan: bank, bayaran, fail audit, juruaudit dan cukai

purpose.en: The papers each company keeps up every month: bank pack by the 10th, payment pack by the 15th, monthly audit file by the 20th, and the papers for the auditor and the tax agent.
purpose.ms: Kertas yang setiap syarikat siapkan setiap bulan: pek bank menjelang 10hb, pek bayaran menjelang 15hb, fail audit bulanan menjelang 20hb, dan kertas untuk juruaudit dan ejen cukai.

starter.en: Finance data entry

does.en: Prepares each item. Prima marks an item prepared by itself when it already holds everything (statement, reconciliation, released payments, ageing, SST return).
does.ms: Menyediakan setiap item. Prima menanda item sebagai disediakan sendiri apabila ia sudah memegang semuanya (penyata, penyesuaian, bayaran dilepaskan, umur hutang, penyata SST).

does.en: Reviews each item with a comment. Never an item they prepared or whose work it lists.
does.ms: Menyemak setiap item dengan komen. Bukan item yang mereka sediakan atau yang menyenaraikan kerja mereka.

does.en: Sends it with a comment. Papers for the auditor and the tax agent are tracked the same way.
does.ms: Menghantarnya dengan komen. Kertas untuk juruaudit dan ejen cukai dijejak dengan cara yang sama.

rules.en: Nobody reviews or sends a paper they prepared; reviewing and sending need a comment.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa menyemak atau menghantar kertas yang mereka sediakan; menyemak dan menghantar perlu komen.

rules.en: Year-end: audited accounts circulated within 6 months of year end, lodged with SSM within 30 days after, Form C within 7 months.
rules.ms: Hujung tahun: akaun beraudit diedarkan dalam 6 bulan selepas hujung tahun, diserah kepada SSM dalam 30 hari selepas itu, Borang C dalam 7 bulan.

sops.words: bank pack payment pack pek bank pek bayaran audit file fail audit auditor juruaudit tax agent ejen cukai papers kertas

title.en: Unpaid invoices, credit notes and bad debt
title.ms: Invois tidak berbayar, nota kredit dan hutang lapuk

purpose.en: Every invoice unpaid 90 days or more gets a case that is followed up until paid, re-issued to the right payer, provided for or written off.
purpose.ms: Setiap invois tidak berbayar 90 hari atau lebih dibuka kes yang disusuli sehingga dibayar, dikeluarkan semula kepada pembayar yang betul, diperuntukkan atau dihapus kira.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Money in › Open case
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Wang masuk › Buka kes

starter.en: Finance team

does.en: Opens a case for the invoice and the reason (wrong payer, site changed, dispute, refused, insolvent, government pays late, other).
does.ms: Membuka kes untuk invois dan sebabnya (pembayar salah, tapak bertukar, pertikaian, enggan, muflis, kerajaan bayar lewat, lain-lain).

does.en: Follows up at least every 30 days (reminder, call, letter of demand, lawyer) and records each step.
does.ms: Menyusul sekurang-kurangnya setiap 30 hari (peringatan, panggilan, surat tuntutan, peguam) dan merekod setiap langkah.

does.en: Wrong payer or site: approves a credit note in SQL Account plus a new invoice to the right payer. Doubtful debt: deputy, leader, FD or CEO approves the provision.
does.ms: Pembayar atau tapak salah: meluluskan nota kredit dalam SQL Account serta invois baharu kepada pembayar yang betul. Hutang ragu: timbalan, ketua, FD atau CEO meluluskan peruntukan.

does.en: Approves a bad debt write-off after 180 days of recovery steps (earlier if insolvent), with at least 2 pieces of evidence and the SQL Account credit note or journal.
does.ms: Meluluskan hapus kira hutang lapuk selepas 180 hari langkah pemulihan (lebih awal jika muflis), dengan sekurang-kurangnya 2 bukti dan nota kredit atau jurnal SQL Account.

does.en: Signs off each company’s overdue list every month with a comment.
does.ms: Menandatangani senarai tertunggak setiap syarikat setiap bulan dengan komen.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Money in › Sign off
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Wang masuk › Sign off

rules.en: Never delete an invoice. Cancelling in MyInvois only for a validated e-Invoice within 72 hours.
rules.ms: Jangan sekali-kali padam invois. Batal dalam MyInvois hanya bagi e-Invois yang disahkan dalam 72 jam.

rules.en: A customer receipt counts only once Prima finds the money on the loaded bank statement.
rules.ms: Penerimaan pelanggan hanya dikira apabila Prima menemui wang itu dalam penyata bank yang dimuat naik.

rules.en: A credit note for an audited year is dated in the current open month; tell the auditor.
rules.ms: Nota kredit bagi tahun yang telah diaudit bertarikh dalam bulan terbuka semasa; maklumkan juruaudit.

sops.words: invoice invois unpaid tertunggak overdue bad debt hutang lapuk write-off hapus kira credit note nota kredit ageing collection kutipan

title.en: Service tax (SST) return and payment to Customs
title.ms: Penyata cukai perkhidmatan (SST) dan bayaran kepada Kastam

purpose.en: For each two-month period: prepare the return from the money received, have it reviewed, file it in MySST and pay Customs the exact tax.
purpose.ms: Bagi setiap tempoh dua bulan: sediakan penyata daripada wang yang diterima, minta disemak, failkan dalam MySST dan bayar Kastam cukai yang tepat.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

starter.en: Finance team

does.en: Prepares the return from the money received for taxable services: tax = 8/108 of it. It must agree with the SST on the invoices paid, within RM1, or be explained.
does.ms: Menyediakan penyata daripada wang diterima bagi perkhidmatan bercukai: cukai = 8/108 daripadanya. Ia mesti sepadan dengan SST pada invois yang dibayar, dalam RM1, atau diterangkan.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

does.en: Reviews the return.
does.ms: Menyemak penyata.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

does.en: Files it in MySST and records the acknowledgement number and date.
does.ms: Memfailkannya dalam MySST dan merekod nombor pengakuan dan tarikh.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Tax and month-end › Record filing
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan › Rekod pemfailan

who.en: Finance team, then the FD or CEO
who.ms: Pasukan Kewangan, kemudian FD atau CEO

does.en: Pays Customs as a normal Prima payment to the tax payee, for exactly the declared tax.
does.ms: Membayar Kastam sebagai bayaran Prima biasa kepada penerima cukai, tepat amaun cukai yang diisytiharkan.

rules.en: Security services are taxable at 8% (since 1 March 2024). The group pays SST when the customer pays, not on invoice.
rules.ms: Perkhidmatan keselamatan dikenakan cukai 8% (sejak 1 Mac 2024). Kumpulan membayar SST apabila pelanggan membayar, bukan semasa invois.

rules.en: A warning shows when taxable services pass RM500,000 in 12 months and the company is not registered.
rules.ms: Amaran dipapar apabila perkhidmatan bercukai melebihi RM500,000 dalam 12 bulan dan syarikat belum berdaftar.

rules.en: Only the FD or CEO marks a company "not registered for SST".
rules.ms: Hanya FD atau CEO menanda syarikat "tidak berdaftar SST".

sops.words: sst service tax cukai perkhidmatan customs kastam mysst sst-02 8% tax return penyata cukai

title.en: Monthly e-Invoice check (LHDN MyInvois)

purpose.en: SQL Account sends e-Invoices; Prima checks every month that it did, per company.
purpose.ms: SQL Account menghantar e-Invois; Prima menyemak setiap bulan bahawa ia telah berbuat demikian, bagi setiap syarikat.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

starter.en: Finance team

does.en: Sets each company up: its own turnover, required or not (RM3 million and above is required), start date and how it sends.
does.ms: Menetapkan setiap syarikat: perolehannya sendiri, wajib atau tidak (RM3 juta ke atas wajib), tarikh mula dan cara penghantaran.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

does.en: By the 10th records the month: sales documents issued, valid, invalid, stuck and not sent; the consolidated e-Invoice number and date; self-billed e-Invoices; late cancellations.
does.ms: Menjelang 10hb merekod bulan itu: dokumen jualan dikeluarkan, sah, tidak sah, tersangkut dan tidak dihantar; nombor dan tarikh e-Invois disatukan; e-Invois bil sendiri; pembatalan lewat.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

does.en: Reviews the check.
does.ms: Menyemak semakan itu.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

rules.en: Each company is tested on its own turnover, not group sales.
rules.ms: Setiap syarikat diuji mengikut perolehannya sendiri, bukan jualan kumpulan.

rules.en: The close is blocked without the reviewed check, while a sales document is not validated, or when the consolidated e-Invoice is missing.
rules.ms: Tutup akaun disekat tanpa semakan yang disemak, selagi dokumen jualan belum disahkan, atau apabila e-Invois disatukan tiada.

rules.en: Ask the supplier for its validated e-Invoice before paying.
rules.ms: Minta e-Invois yang disahkan daripada pembekal sebelum membayar.

sops.words: e-invoice e-invois myinvois lhdn consolidated disatukan self-billed uuid

title.en: Budget, revisions and forecasts

purpose.en: One budget per company per year, approved by the FD or CEO; actuals and forecasts after each close; variances over the limit explained.
purpose.ms: Satu bajet bagi setiap syarikat setiap tahun, diluluskan oleh FD atau CEO; angka sebenar dan ramalan selepas setiap tutup akaun; varians melebihi had diterangkan.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Tax and month-end › Budget
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan › Bajet

starter.en: Team deputy, team leader, FD or CEO
starter.ms: Timbalan pasukan, ketua pasukan, FD atau CEO

does.en: Drafts the budget by line with written assumptions and submits it for approval.
does.ms: Merangka bajet mengikut baris dengan andaian bertulis dan menghantarnya untuk kelulusan.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

does.en: Approves the budget with a comment or returns it.
does.ms: Meluluskan bajet dengan komen atau memulangkannya.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

does.en: After each close saves the month’s actuals from the SQL Account P&L and explains each variance over the limit.
does.ms: Selepas setiap tutup akaun menyimpan angka sebenar dari P&L SQL Account dan menerangkan setiap varians melebihi had.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

who.en: Deputy or leader drafts; FD or CEO approves
who.ms: Timbalan atau ketua merangka; FD atau CEO meluluskan

does.en: A budget revision or a three-statement forecast is drafted with a reason and approved by the FD or the CEO (either is enough), never its author.
does.ms: Semakan semula bajet atau ramalan tiga penyata dirangka dengan sebab dan diluluskan oleh FD atau CEO (salah seorang memadai), bukan penulisnya.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

rules.en: The approved budget is never changed; changes come as revisions.
rules.ms: Bajet yang diluluskan tidak pernah diubah; perubahan dibuat sebagai semakan semula.

rules.en: Variances above 5% are explained, with an owner and a due day; the FD or CEO accepts each explanation.
rules.ms: Varians melebihi 5% diterangkan, dengan pemilik dan tarikh akhir; FD atau CEO menerima setiap penjelasan.

rules.en: Next year’s budget is due by 10 December (an FD setting).
rules.ms: Bajet tahun hadapan perlu siap menjelang 10 Disember (tetapan FD).

statusNote.en: Budget limit amounts are an open decision (Finance to give them).
statusNote.ms: Amaun had bajet masih keputusan terbuka (Kewangan akan memberikannya).

sops.words: budget bajet forecast ramalan revision semakan semula variance varians actuals angka sebenar plan

title.en: Regular payments: instalments, bills, statutory and zakat
title.ms: Bayaran berkala: ansuran, bil, berkanun dan zakat

purpose.en: Hire purchase, loans, bills, rent, insurance premiums, EPF, PERKESO, HRD Corp, PCB, CP204, zakat, tax and levy: listed once, checked, then paid on each due date.
purpose.ms: Sewa beli, pinjaman, bil, sewa, premium insurans, KWSP, PERKESO, HRD Corp, PCB, CP204, zakat, cukai dan levi: disenaraikan sekali, disemak, kemudian dibayar pada setiap tarikh akhir.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Paying out › Regular payments
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bayaran keluar › Bayaran berkala

starter.en: Finance team

does.en: Adds the entry: verified payee, reference, account, how often, due day, and a fixed amount or "from each bill".
does.ms: Menambah entri: penerima disahkan, rujukan, akaun, kekerapan, hari akhir, dan amaun tetap atau "ikut setiap bil".

does.en: Checks the entry against the agreement or letter. Any change sends it back for checking.
does.ms: Menyemak entri dengan perjanjian atau surat. Sebarang perubahan menghantarnya semula untuk disemak.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Paying out › Check against agreement
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bayaran keluar › Semak dengan perjanjian

does.en: Records each varying bill with its document, then prepares all due transfers for exactly the amount due.
does.ms: Merekod setiap bil yang berubah dengan dokumennya, kemudian menyediakan semua pindahan yang perlu dibayar untuk amaun yang tepat.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Paying out › Prepare all due
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bayaran keluar › Sediakan semua yang perlu

does.en: After the review, approves the regular payments together with one comment (Prima still checks each one); release follows as for any payment.
does.ms: Selepas semakan, meluluskan bayaran berkala sekali gus dengan satu komen (Prima tetap menyemak setiap satu); pelepasan seperti bayaran biasa.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Paying out › Regular payments
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bayaran keluar › Bayaran berkala

rules.en: Statutory, zakat, tax and levy are always Finance payments, approved by the FD or the CEO.
rules.ms: Berkanun, zakat, cukai dan levi sentiasa bayaran Kewangan, diluluskan oleh FD atau CEO.

rules.en: A bill above 125% or below 50% of the last three needs an explanation; whoever recorded the bill does not prepare its payment.
rules.ms: Bil melebihi 125% atau kurang 50% daripada tiga terakhir perlu penjelasan; sesiapa yang merekod bil tidak menyediakan bayarannya.

rules.en: Direct debits are found on the bank statement; one not seen stays an exception at the close.
rules.ms: Debit terus dicari dalam penyata bank; yang tidak ditemui kekal pengecualian semasa tutup akaun.

sops.words: regular payment bayaran berkala hire purchase sewa beli loan pinjaman bill bil epf kwsp perkeso socso pcb zakat levy levi direct debit

title.en: Bank guarantees (IG and BG) and their cash collateral
title.ms: Jaminan bank (IG dan BG) dan cagaran tunainya

purpose.en: Record each guarantee given to a client and claim the cash collateral back when it is released or expires.
purpose.ms: Rekod setiap jaminan yang diberi kepada klien dan tuntut semula cagaran tunai apabila ia dilepaskan atau tamat.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Paying out › IG and BG
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bayaran keluar › IG dan BG

starter.en: Finance team

who.en: Finance team, checked by a second person
who.ms: Pasukan Kewangan, disemak oleh orang kedua

does.en: Records the issuer, number, client, contract, amount, cash collateral, refund account and expiry.
does.ms: Merekod pengeluar, nombor, klien, kontrak, amaun, cagaran tunai, akaun bayaran balik dan tarikh tamat.

does.en: Records the client’s release letter (or the expiry); 14 days later Prima asks to claim the collateral back. The claim is recorded with its documents.
does.ms: Merekod surat pelepasan klien (atau tarikh tamat); 14 hari kemudian Prima meminta cagaran dituntut semula. Tuntutan direkod bersama dokumennya.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Paying out › Claim sent
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Bayaran keluar › Tuntutan dihantar

does.en: Finds the refund on the bank statement and marks it refunded; the guarantee closes only then.
does.ms: Menemui bayaran balik dalam penyata bank dan menandanya dibayar balik; jaminan hanya ditutup selepas itu.

rules.en: Prima warns 60 days before expiry, and when no refund is seen 30 days after the claim.
rules.ms: Prima memberi amaran 60 hari sebelum tamat, dan apabila tiada bayaran balik 30 hari selepas tuntutan.

rules.en: Only the FD or CEO records a guarantee the client called.
rules.ms: Hanya FD atau CEO merekod jaminan yang dituntut oleh klien.

sops.words: bank guarantee jaminan bank ig bg collateral cagaran deposit refund bayaran balik performance bond

title.en: Posting to SQL Account

purpose.en: Prima posts each released payment (as a payment voucher) and each matched customer receipt into the company’s own SQL Account book through the vendor API.
purpose.ms: Prima mengepos setiap bayaran yang dilepaskan (sebagai baucar bayaran) dan setiap penerimaan pelanggan yang dipadankan ke buku SQL Account syarikat sendiri melalui API vendor.

label.en: Finance › Checks › Tax and month-end › SQL Account posting
label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan › Pengeposan SQL Account

starter.en: Prima, once a payment is released or a receipt matched
starter.ms: Prima, apabila bayaran dilepaskan atau penerimaan dipadankan

who.en: Finance team, checked by a second person
who.ms: Pasukan Kewangan, disemak oleh orang kedua

does.en: Enters each payee’s SQL Account code (customer code for receipts); a second person checks it.
does.ms: Memasukkan kod SQL Account setiap penerima (kod pelanggan untuk penerimaan); orang kedua menyemaknya.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

does.en: Makes a job for each finished record; it waits, with the reason shown, until the codes and switches are in place.
does.ms: Membuat tugas bagi setiap rekod yang selesai; ia menunggu, dengan sebab dipaparkan, sehingga kod dan suis tersedia.

who.en: Finance team, checked by someone else
who.ms: Pasukan Kewangan, disemak oleh orang lain

does.en: Explains each exception from the daily check; unchecked exceptions hold the month-end close.
does.ms: Menerangkan setiap pengecualian dari semakan harian; pengecualian yang belum disemak menahan tutup akaun.

label.ms: Kewangan › Semakan › Cukai dan hujung bulan

rules.en: SQL Account stays the books; Prima never writes SQL Account’s tables and never changes an amount to make a post pass.
rules.ms: SQL Account kekal sebagai buku akaun; Prima tidak pernah menulis jadual SQL Account dan tidak mengubah amaun untuk meluluskan pengeposan.

rules.en: Each company switch is set by the FD or CEO with a reason, after its SQL Account set-up is confirmed.
rules.ms: Suis setiap syarikat ditetapkan oleh FD atau CEO dengan sebab, selepas tetapan SQL Account disahkan.

rules.en: Sales invoices stay raised in SQL Account; payroll is not posted by Prima.
rules.ms: Invois jualan kekal dibuat dalam SQL Account; gaji tidak dipos oleh Prima.

statusNote.en: Built; not connected for any company. Posting is switched off until the CEO’s go-ahead (sandbox test, then one parallel month).
statusNote.ms: Sudah dibina; belum disambungkan untuk mana-mana syarikat. Pengeposan dimatikan sehingga CEO memberi kebenaran (ujian sandbox, kemudian satu bulan selari).

sops.words: sql account posting pengeposan voucher baucar api book buku akaun sync

title.en: Daily cash pay (closed)

purpose.en: The old route where Finance listed people paid daily in cash. Closed to new lists; its history and receipts can still be read.
purpose.ms: Laluan lama di mana Kewangan menyenaraikan orang yang dibayar tunai harian. Ditutup kepada senarai baharu; sejarah dan resitnya masih boleh dibaca.

starter.en: Nobody (closed)

does.en: Reads the history of earlier lists under Legacy cash history.
does.ms: Membaca sejarah senarai terdahulu di bawah Sejarah tunai lama.

does.en: Extra cash support for a guard now goes as a specific OM request, a CEO-only approval and the Director Office’s controlled list; arrival cash for new foreign workers has its own flow.
does.ms: Bantuan tunai tambahan untuk pengawal kini melalui permohonan khusus OM, kelulusan CEO sahaja dan senarai terkawal Pejabat Pengarah; tunai ketibaan pekerja asing baharu ada alirannya sendiri.

rules.en: No cash salary choice and no self-service cash request.
rules.ms: Tiada pilihan gaji tunai dan tiada permohonan tunai layan diri.

rules.en: A stored signature is never proof of payment; each handout needs a fresh signed acknowledgement.
rules.ms: Tandatangan tersimpan bukan bukti bayaran; setiap pemberian perlu pengakuan bertandatangan yang baharu.

statusNote.en: Closed by the owner’s correction of 8 Nov 2026.
statusNote.ms: Ditutup melalui pembetulan pemilik pada 8 Nov 2026.

sops.words: daily cash tunai harian cash pay bayaran tunai coo ceo hand over serah

title.en: PWVSB financing to a group company

purpose.en: PWVSB lends to, or pays on behalf of, a group company: record the financing, its stamping and SSM charge, and every repayment.
purpose.ms: PWVSB meminjamkan kepada, atau membayar bagi pihak, syarikat kumpulan: rekod pembiayaan, setem dan gadaian SSM, serta setiap bayaran balik.

starter.en: The credit officer (or the owner)

does.en: Records the new financing: company, amount, rate, schedule and collateral.
does.ms: Merekod pembiayaan baharu: syarikat, amaun, kadar, jadual dan cagaran.

label.en: PWVSB credit › Loans and amounts paid on behalf
label.ms: Kredit PWVSB › Pinjaman dan bayaran bagi pihak

does.en: Records the agreement stamped and the charge lodged with SSM, each within 30 days.
does.ms: Merekod perjanjian disetem dan gadaian diserah kepada SSM, masing-masing dalam 30 hari.

does.en: Records each repayment with its bank reference.
does.ms: Merekod setiap bayaran balik dengan rujukan banknya.

does.en: Records the KPKT licence check; staff never wait on it.
does.ms: Merekod semakan lesen KPKT; staf tidak perlu menunggunya.

rules.en: Interest at most 12% secured, 18% unsecured (Moneylenders Act; counsel to confirm).
rules.ms: Faedah maksimum 12% bercagar, 18% tidak bercagar (Akta Pemberi Pinjam Wang; peguam untuk sahkan).

rules.en: A beneficial-interest agreement is collateral only; ownership never changes by software.
rules.ms: Perjanjian kepentingan benefisial hanya cagaran; pemilikan tidak pernah berubah melalui perisian.

rules.en: A correction to collateral, stamping, charge or signing date needs a reason.
rules.ms: Pembetulan cagaran, setem, gadaian atau tarikh tandatangan perlu sebab.

sops.words: pwvsb credit kredit loan pinjaman financing pembiayaan paid on behalf bayar bagi pihak stamping setem ssm charge gadaian kpkt

title.en: Missed instalment: investigation to default

purpose.en: A missed instalment on PWVSB financing opens an investigation, never a default. A default needs the checks and the credit officer and FD (and legal on a template’s first default).
purpose.ms: Ansuran pembiayaan PWVSB yang terlepas membuka siasatan, bukan ingkar. Ingkar memerlukan semakan dan pegawai kredit serta FD (dan undang-undang bagi ingkar pertama sesuatu templat).

label.en: PWVSB credit › Run the daily check

starter.en: Credit officer or Finance

does.en: Runs the daily check; each missed instalment opens an investigation.
does.ms: Menjalankan semakan harian; setiap ansuran terlepas membuka siasatan.

does.en: Records that the bank is reconciled. The other checks: no open dispute, no agreed deferral, cure period passed, still unpaid.
does.ms: Merekod bank telah disesuaikan. Semakan lain: tiada pertikaian terbuka, tiada penangguhan dipersetujui, tempoh pemulihan berlalu, masih belum dibayar.

does.en: Clears it as not a default when the money is found or the checks fail, with a note.
does.ms: Menutupnya sebagai bukan ingkar apabila wang ditemui atau semakan gagal, dengan catatan.

label.en: PWVSB credit › Clear, not a default

who.en: Credit officer, then the FD (and legal on a template’s first default)
who.ms: Pegawai kredit, kemudian FD (dan undang-undang bagi ingkar pertama templat)

does.en: Each confirms the default with a note; only then does the enforcement case open.
does.ms: Masing-masing mengesahkan ingkar dengan catatan; hanya selepas itu kes penguatkuasaan dibuka.

who.en: Credit officer; legal or Finance may suspend
who.ms: Pegawai kredit; undang-undang atau Kewangan boleh menggantung

does.en: Records each enforcement step in order. Legal or Finance may suspend and resume enforcement.
does.ms: Merekod setiap langkah penguatkuasaan mengikut turutan. Undang-undang atau Kewangan boleh menggantung dan menyambung semula.

rules.en: Enforcement steps 7 to 9 stay off until counsel approves the agreement template.
rules.ms: Langkah penguatkuasaan 7 hingga 9 kekal dimatikan sehingga peguam meluluskan templat perjanjian.

rules.en: Ownership never changes by software; only the company secretary’s verified update changes it.
rules.ms: Pemilikan tidak pernah berubah melalui perisian; hanya kemas kini setiausaha syarikat yang disahkan mengubahnya.

sops.words: missed instalment ansuran terlepas default ingkar investigation siasatan enforcement penguatkuasaan cure period

title.en: Opening a new branch

purpose.en: A branch is proposed, its papers, bank accounts and business case checked, a SQL Account project code set, and then activated by the company manager.
purpose.ms: Cawangan dicadangkan, kertas, akaun bank dan kes perniagaannya disemak, kod projek SQL Account ditetapkan, kemudian diaktifkan oleh Pengurus Syarikat.

starter.en: Company manager

does.en: Proposes the branch (name, state, model A, B or C) and records the signed agreement version.
does.ms: Mencadangkan cawangan (nama, negeri, model A, B atau C) dan merekod versi perjanjian yang ditandatangani.

does.en: Record the KDN approval, premises licence and insurance references, add the bank accounts, and write the business case with a 13-week cash forecast.
does.ms: Merekod rujukan kelulusan KDN, lesen premis dan insurans, menambah akaun bank, dan menulis kes perniagaan dengan ramalan tunai 13 minggu.

does.en: Verifies each bank account, reviews the business case with a comment, and sets the SQL Account project code.
does.ms: Mengesahkan setiap akaun bank, menyemak kes perniagaan dengan komen, dan menetapkan kod projek SQL Account.

does.en: Confirms the company is the legal employer and activates the branch with a comment.
does.ms: Mengesahkan syarikat ialah majikan sah dan mengaktifkan cawangan dengan komen.

rules.en: Activation is refused while anything is missing: signed agreement, the three references, project code, employer confirmation, a verified bank account and a reviewed business case.
rules.ms: Pengaktifan ditolak selagi ada yang kurang: perjanjian ditandatangani, tiga rujukan, kod projek, pengesahan majikan, akaun bank disahkan dan kes perniagaan disemak.

rules.en: Whoever added an account never verifies it. The branch contracts only through its licensed company.
rules.ms: Sesiapa yang menambah akaun tidak sekali-kali mengesahkannya. Cawangan berkontrak hanya melalui syarikat berlesennya.

sops.words: branch cawangan new branch formation open buka activate aktif kdn project code kod projek business case

title.en: Branch month and settlement

purpose.en: Each finished month a branch’s ledger is prepared from SQL Account lines, approved by the company manager, agreed to SQL by Finance and paid (or closed) by another Finance person.
purpose.ms: Setiap bulan yang selesai, lejar cawangan disediakan daripada baris SQL Account, diluluskan Pengurus Syarikat, dipadankan dengan SQL oleh Kewangan dan dibayar (atau ditutup) oleh orang Kewangan yang lain.

starter.en: Company staff, the Branch Manager or Finance
starter.ms: Staf syarikat, Pengurus Cawangan atau Kewangan

who.en: Company staff, Branch Manager or Finance
who.ms: Staf syarikat, Pengurus Cawangan atau Kewangan

does.en: Prepares the month: each line cites its SQL Account document or payroll reference; billing names a site of this branch with a signed contract.
does.ms: Menyediakan bulan: setiap baris memetik dokumen SQL Account atau rujukan gaji; bil menamakan tapak cawangan ini yang ada kontrak ditandatangani.

does.en: Approves the settlement under the signed model with a comment, or returns it with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan penyelesaian mengikut model yang ditandatangani dengan komen, atau memulangkan dengan sebab.

does.en: Agrees the month to the SQL Account project ledger.
does.ms: Memadankan bulan itu dengan lejar projek SQL Account.

who.en: A different Finance person (Model B: the FD decides the payout)
who.ms: Orang Kewangan yang lain (Model B: FD menentukan bayaran)

does.en: Records the payment with the bank reference, or closes the month with nothing paid out.
does.ms: Merekod bayaran dengan rujukan bank, atau menutup bulan tanpa bayaran.

rules.en: A settlement is held while the branch bank is unreconciled, wages or EPF are unpaid, or the licence has an issue.
rules.ms: Penyelesaian ditahan selagi bank cawangan belum disesuaikan, gaji atau KWSP belum dibayar, atau lesen bermasalah.

rules.en: A partner is paid only into its own verified business account.
rules.ms: Rakan kongsi hanya dibayar ke akaun perniagaannya sendiri yang disahkan.

rules.en: Model B purchases and expenses: request with a quotation, company manager consents, FD or CEO approves (the FD may set another style).
rules.ms: Pembelian dan perbelanjaan Model B: permohonan dengan sebut harga, Pengurus Syarikat bersetuju, FD atau CEO meluluskan (FD boleh menetapkan gaya lain).

rules.en: Branch actions not reviewed in 3 days go to the company manager’s home; after 7 days to PWVSB.
rules.ms: Tindakan cawangan yang tidak disemak dalam 3 hari dihantar ke laman utama Pengurus Syarikat; selepas 7 hari ke PWVSB.

sops.words: branch cawangan settlement penyelesaian month bulan ledger lejar model a b c jv management fee yuran pengurusan payout

title.en: Insurance claim

purpose.en: A claim moves step by step from telling the insurer to the money received; it is settled only when the money is on the bank statement.
purpose.ms: Tuntutan bergerak langkah demi langkah dari memaklumkan penanggung insurans hingga wang diterima; ia selesai hanya apabila wang ada dalam penyata bank.

starter.en: Company desk (manager or admin executive) or the Chief of Staff
starter.ms: Meja syarikat (pengurus atau eksekutif admin) atau Ketua Staf

who.en: Company desk or Chief of Staff

does.en: Records the claim (policy, what happened, incident date, amount), then records the insurer told with its reference.
does.ms: Merekod tuntutan (polisi, apa berlaku, tarikh kejadian, amaun), kemudian merekod penanggung insurans telah dimaklumkan dengan rujukannya.

who.en: Company desk or Chief of Staff

does.en: Adds each document, sends it for assessment, then records the insurer’s offer (or rejection).
does.ms: Menambah setiap dokumen, menghantar untuk penilaian, kemudian merekod tawaran penanggung insurans (atau penolakan).

who.en: Company manager (not who recorded the offer)

does.en: Accepts the offer with a comment; an offer below the amount claimed needs the reason. May appeal a rejection once.
does.ms: Menerima tawaran dengan komen; tawaran kurang daripada amaun tuntutan perlu sebab. Boleh merayu penolakan sekali.

who.en: Company Finance team or FD (not who accepted)
who.ms: Pasukan Kewangan syarikat atau FD (bukan yang menerima)

does.en: Records the money received with the bank statement reference and date. Only then is the claim settled.
does.ms: Merekod wang diterima dengan rujukan penyata bank dan tarikh. Hanya selepas itu tuntutan selesai.

rules.en: After the insurer is told, the claim can no longer be edited; it moves only by these steps.
rules.ms: Selepas penanggung insurans dimaklumkan, tuntutan tidak boleh disunting lagi; ia bergerak hanya melalui langkah ini.

rules.en: An offer cannot be above the sum insured.
rules.ms: Tawaran tidak boleh melebihi jumlah diinsuranskan.

sops.words: insurance insurans claim tuntutan insurer penanggung offer tawaran settle selesai appeal rayuan

title.en: Keep each company licence on record

purpose.en: Every company keeps its KDN licence, MOF registration, group insurance and SSM annual return in Prima with the expiry date, so reminders start on time.
purpose.ms: Setiap syarikat menyimpan lesen KDN, pendaftaran MOF, insurans kumpulan dan penyata tahunan SSM dalam Prima bersama tarikh tamat, supaya peringatan bermula tepat pada masanya.

starter.en: Company Manager or the company’s admin executives
starter.ms: Pengurus Syarikat atau eksekutif admin syarikat

does.en: Adds the licence (or presses Update on its row) with the expiry date and reference.
does.ms: Tambah lesen (atau tekan Update pada barisnya) bersama tarikh tamat dan rujukan.

does.en: Shows each licence as valid, due soon, expired or “No record”, and starts reminders 120 (KDN), 90 (MOF), 90 (insurance) and 60 (SSM) days before expiry.
does.ms: Menunjukkan setiap lesen sebagai sah, hampir tamat, tamat atau “Tiada rekod”, dan mula memberi peringatan 120 (KDN), 90 (MOF), 90 (insurans) dan 60 (SSM) hari sebelum tamat.

does.en: When a licence is due, opens its renewal on the Renewals screen.
does.ms: Apabila lesen hampir tamat, buka pembaharuannya di skrin Pembaharuan.

rules.en: A licence with no expiry on record counts as a problem (Unknown), never as valid.
rules.ms: Lesen tanpa tarikh tamat dalam rekod dikira sebagai masalah (Unknown), bukan sah.

rules.en: An expired security licence blocks new contracts and bids for that company.
rules.ms: Lesen keselamatan yang tamat menyekat kontrak dan bidaan baru bagi syarikat itu.

rules.en: Filing is done by a person; Prima keeps the date and receipt.
rules.ms: Pemfailan dibuat oleh orang; Prima menyimpan tarikh dan resit.

source.decided: Fauzan, 24 Oct to 2 Nov 2026 (renewal lead times)

sops.words: licence lesen kdn mof ssm insurance insurans expiry tamat tempoh permit

title.en: Renewing a licence, registration or certificate

purpose.en: Each company renews its own licences, council (majlis) licences, vendor registrations and ISO certificates; Central Admin monitors and confirms the new expiry. Prima never lodges or pays.
purpose.ms: Setiap syarikat membaharui lesen sendiri, lesen majlis, pendaftaran vendor dan sijil ISO; Pentadbiran Pusat memantau dan mengesahkan tarikh tamat baru. Prima tidak sekali-kali menghantar permohonan atau membayar.

starter.en: The company admin team (owner of the item)

does.en: Opens the renewal at its lead time and ticks or adds each paper on the checklist.
does.ms: Buka pembaharuan pada masa awalnya dan tanda atau tambah setiap dokumen dalam senarai semak.

does.en: Checks and presses “Sign the application”. The preparer never signs it off.
does.ms: Semak dan tekan “Sign the application”. Penyedia tidak boleh menandatanganinya.

does.en: Pays the agency fee through a normal payment request with a reason; the owner records the payment reference (“Record fee”).
does.ms: Membayar yuran agensi melalui permohonan bayaran biasa dengan sebab; pemilik merekod rujukan bayaran (“Record fee”).

does.en: Submits to the agency outside Prima, then records the submission reference; adds an agency note at each follow-up.
does.ms: Menghantar kepada agensi di luar Prima, kemudian merekod rujukan penghantaran; tambah nota agensi pada setiap susulan.

does.en: Records the new certificate with its new expiry date.
does.ms: Merekod sijil baru bersama tarikh tamat baru.

who.en: Deputy Chief of Staff (ACT for ISO and compliance items)
who.ms: Timbalan Ketua Staf (ACT bagi item ISO dan pematuhan)

does.en: Confirms the new expiry matches the certificate, or queries it or sends it back.
does.ms: Mengesahkan tarikh tamat baru sepadan dengan sijil, atau mempersoalkannya atau menghantarnya balik.

rules.en: Cases open ahead of expiry: KDN licence 120 days, MOF 90, insurance 90, SSM 60, majlis 60, ISO 120 days before each audit.
rules.ms: Kes dibuka sebelum tamat: lesen KDN 120 hari, MOF 90, insurans 90, SSM 60, majlis 60, ISO 120 hari sebelum setiap audit.

rules.en: A late renewal steps up: Deputy Chief of Staff, then Chief of Staff, then CEO.
rules.ms: Pembaharuan lewat dinaikkan: Timbalan Ketua Staf, kemudian Ketua Staf, kemudian CEO.

rules.en: A renewal closes only when the new certificate or receipt is recorded.
rules.ms: Pembaharuan hanya ditutup apabila sijil atau resit baru direkod.

rules.en: Refused or more papers asked: back to the checklist with the reason.
rules.ms: Ditolak atau diminta dokumen tambahan: kembali ke senarai semak dengan sebabnya.

statusNote.en: Lead times and paper lists are starting proposals; the agency’s current form decides.
