title.en: KDN licence renewal 2027

purpose.en: Each licensed company prepares the 15-line KDN checklist (Lampiran C), a director signs, the eSIMS appointment is booked and the result recorded. Prima never logs in to eSIMS, lodges or pays.
purpose.ms: Setiap syarikat berlesen menyediakan senarai semak KDN 15 baris (Lampiran C), pengarah menandatangan, janji temu eSIMS ditempah dan keputusannya direkod. Prima tidak log masuk ke eSIMS, menghantar atau membayar.

starter.en: The company’s admin team

does.en: Opens the renewal in the “Pembaharuan Lesen KDN 2027” panel and uploads each paper (PDF or scan of the signed hardcopy); each paper is checked for its date or period.
does.ms: Buka pembaharuan di panel “Pembaharuan Lesen KDN 2027” dan muat naik setiap dokumen (PDF atau imbasan salinan bertandatangan); setiap dokumen disemak tarikh atau tempohnya.

does.en: The company head confirms the CSG/TNG not-trained counts with a reason; Finance ticks no SST arrears with the MySST reference; FWM marks each Nepali guard entered in eSIMS.
does.ms: Ketua syarikat mengesahkan bilangan CSG/TNG belum berlatih dengan sebab; Kewangan menanda tiada tunggakan SST dengan rujukan MySST; FWM menanda setiap pengawal Nepal sudah dimasukkan dalam eSIMS.

does.en: Checks the papers (“Semak dokumen (pengurus)”).
does.ms: Menyemak dokumen (“Semak dokumen (pengurus)”).

who.en: A director of the same company

does.en: Ticks the declaration and signs (“Tandatangan pengarah”). Never the preparer or the checker; refused until papers, eSIMS, counts, check, Nepali eSIMS and SST are all done.
does.ms: Tanda pengakuan dan tandatangan (“Tandatangan pengarah”). Bukan penyedia atau penyemak; ditolak sehingga dokumen, eSIMS, bilangan, semakan, eSIMS Nepal dan SST semuanya selesai.

does.en: Books the eSIMS appointment inside a session (on a weekday, with the eSIMS reference and attendee), goes to KDN, then records the result of the day: accepted, papers lacking, or left at the counter.
does.ms: Tempah janji temu eSIMS dalam satu sesi (hari bekerja, dengan rujukan eSIMS dan siapa hadir), pergi ke KDN, kemudian rekod keputusan hari itu: diterima, dokumen tidak lengkap, atau ditinggalkan di kaunter.

rules.en: Late ladder on home: not opened by 18 Nov goes to the Deputy CoS, no appointment by 23 Nov to the CoS, not accepted by 11 Dec to the CEO.
rules.ms: Tangga lewat di laman utama: belum dibuka pada 18 Nov kepada Timbalan Ketua Staf, tiada janji temu pada 23 Nov kepada Ketua Staf, belum diterima pada 11 Dis kepada CEO.

rules.en: Director IC numbers are never shown on screens or exports. One company’s papers are never mixed with another’s.
rules.ms: Nombor IC pengarah tidak sekali-kali dipaparkan di skrin atau eksport. Dokumen satu syarikat tidak dicampur dengan syarikat lain.

rules.en: The pendrive pack (ZIP of the company’s soft copies) is for company staff and Central Admin only, and is logged.
rules.ms: Pek pendrive (ZIP salinan lembut syarikat) hanya untuk staf syarikat dan Pentadbiran Pusat, dan direkod.

statusNote.en: FWM’s per-guard “entered in eSIMS” mark has no button on any screen yet; ask the lead before a company with Nepali guards reaches the signing step.
statusNote.ms: Tanda “dimasukkan dalam eSIMS” bagi setiap pengawal oleh FWM belum ada butang di mana-mana skrin; rujuk ketua projek sebelum syarikat yang ada pengawal Nepal sampai ke langkah tandatangan.

source.decided: Fauzan, answers W-X1 to W-X13, 14 Nov 2026

title.en: Yearly self-audit

purpose.en: Every company checks itself once a year (the company office, one site, or everything) against hours, pay, contracts, fees, passports, training, safety and permits, and fixes what is not right.
purpose.ms: Setiap syarikat menyemak dirinya sekali setahun (pejabat syarikat, satu tapak, atau semua) tentang waktu kerja, gaji, kontrak, yuran, pasport, latihan, keselamatan dan permit, dan membetulkan yang tidak betul.

starter.en: Company Manager or the company’s admin executives
starter.ms: Pengurus Syarikat atau eksekutif admin syarikat

does.en: Chooses what it covers, answers every line OK, Not right or N/A (with a note), attaches the proof and saves.
does.ms: Pilih skopnya, jawab setiap baris OK, Not right atau N/A (dengan nota), lampirkan bukti dan simpan.

does.en: For each line marked Not right, presses “Record fix” with what was done and the proof.
does.ms: Bagi setiap baris Not right, tekan “Record fix” dengan apa yang dibuat dan buktinya.

does.en: See where each company stands and open each site’s client requirements from here.
does.ms: Melihat kedudukan setiap syarikat dan membuka keperluan klien setiap tapak dari sini.

rules.en: Once every 12 months; reminders 60, 30 and 7 days before it is due.
rules.ms: Sekali setiap 12 bulan; peringatan 60, 30 dan 7 hari sebelum tarikh akhir.

rules.en: Every line must be answered before it can be saved.
rules.ms: Setiap baris mesti dijawab sebelum boleh disimpan.

statusNote.en: The reminder days and the 14-day fix target are proposals.
statusNote.ms: Hari peringatan dan sasaran 14 hari untuk membetulkan adalah cadangan.

source.decided: Fauzan, 6 Nov 2026 (after the IKEA IWAY audit; rule CLIENT-CODE)

title.en: RBA trace review (one month, about 20 workers)

purpose.en: ACT lines up roster, clock, overtime, pay and bank payment for a sample of workers, foreign workers first, and settles every mismatch.
purpose.ms: ACT menyusun roster, jam kehadiran, kerja lebih masa, gaji dan bayaran bank bagi sampel pekerja, pekerja asing dahulu, dan menyelesaikan setiap ketidakpadanan.

starter.en: ACT

does.en: Picks the company and month and presses “Run the trace”.
does.ms: Pilih syarikat dan bulan, kemudian tekan “Run the trace”.

does.en: Compares each worker’s roster hours, clocked hours, days and overtime paid, and pay by the 7th; lists every mismatch.
does.ms: Membandingkan jam roster, jam yang direkod, hari dan kerja lebih masa yang dibayar, dan gaji sebelum 7 haribulan bagi setiap pekerja; menyenaraikan setiap ketidakpadanan.

does.en: Settles each worker with a note: Explained, Corrected, or Finding (which then goes through the ACT finding steps).
does.ms: Menyelesaikan setiap pekerja dengan nota: Explained, Corrected, atau Finding (yang kemudian melalui langkah dapatan ACT).

rules.en: Sample of 20 workers, 4 hours of tolerance, 8-hour normal day (approved 8 Nov 2026).
rules.ms: Sampel 20 pekerja, toleransi 4 jam, hari biasa 8 jam (diluluskan 8 Nov 2026).

rules.en: Red items on a site’s RBA list go the same day to ACT, the Chief of Staff and the COO.
rules.ms: Item merah dalam senarai RBA tapak dihantar pada hari yang sama kepada ACT, Ketua Staf dan COO.

rules.en: Guard pay is still in trial, so JA keeps the bank proof.
rules.ms: Gaji pengawal masih dalam percubaan, jadi JA menyimpan bukti bank.

rules.en: Prima keeps the records; it is not an RBA certificate.
rules.ms: Prima menyimpan rekod; ia bukan sijil RBA.

sops.words: rba trace jejak payslip slip gaji roster clock overtime ot foreign worker pekerja asing mismatch

title.en: Ethics declaration and the RBA committee

purpose.en: Every staff member signs the ethics declaration once on entering service and declares any conflicting interest; ACT reviews declared interests. The Chief of Staff names the RBA committee each year.
purpose.ms: Setiap staf menandatangani pengakuan etika sekali semasa mula berkhidmat dan mengisytiharkan sebarang kepentingan yang bercanggah; ACT menyemak kepentingan yang diisytiharkan. Ketua Staf menamakan jawatankuasa RBA setiap tahun.

starter.en: Every office staff member

does.en: Ticks every statement, writes any interest (or ticks “I have no such interests”) and presses Sign.
does.ms: Tanda setiap kenyataan, tulis sebarang kepentingan (atau tanda “I have no such interests”) dan tekan Sign.

does.en: Reviews each declared interest with a reason: No conflict, or Managed (and what was put in place).
does.ms: Menyemak setiap kepentingan yang diisytiharkan dengan sebab: No conflict, atau Managed (dan langkah yang diambil).

does.en: Names the RBA committee for the year: the Operations Director and a few company heads.
does.ms: Menamakan jawatankuasa RBA bagi tahun itu: Pengarah Operasi dan beberapa ketua syarikat.

rules.en: Signed once, on entering service.
rules.ms: Ditandatangani sekali, semasa mula berkhidmat.

rules.en: The committee has at most 6 members.
rules.ms: Jawatankuasa mempunyai paling ramai 6 ahli.

rules.en: No fee, deposit, fine or penalty for leaving is taken from pay.
rules.ms: Tiada yuran, deposit, denda atau penalti berhenti dipotong daripada gaji.

sops.words: ethics etika declaration pengakuan conflict of interest konflik kepentingan rba committee jawatankuasa

title.en: ACT finding: from raised to closed
title.ms: Dapatan ACT: dari dibangkitkan hingga ditutup

purpose.en: ACT records a discrepancy with an owner; the owner plans and fixes it with proof; ACT checks the fix. Overdue findings are shown to the next level, never punished.
purpose.ms: ACT merekod ketidakpatuhan bersama pemilik; pemilik merancang dan membetulkannya dengan bukti; ACT menyemak pembetulan. Dapatan lewat ditunjukkan kepada peringkat seterusnya, tidak dihukum.

starter.en: ACT Director, Auditor or Enforcement officer
starter.ms: Pengarah ACT, Juruaudit atau pegawai Penguatkuasa

does.en: Raises the finding (from a monitor signal, a workflow audit, a spot check or speak-up) with severity and owner. One the Director raises waits until it is given to Team 1 or Team 2.
does.ms: Membangkitkan dapatan (daripada isyarat pemantauan, audit aliran kerja, semakan mengejut atau speak-up) dengan tahap dan pemilik. Dapatan oleh Pengarah menunggu sehingga diberi kepada Pasukan 1 atau 2.

does.en: In “My findings” saves the plan (cause, fix, done-by date), does the fix, then marks it fixed with the proof.
does.ms: Di “My findings” simpan pelan (punca, pembetulan, tarikh siap), buat pembetulan, kemudian tanda sudah dibetulkan dengan bukti.

does.en: Follows up an owner who has no plan, is past the due date or failed the check (call, message, email, visit, meeting or memo, with the next date).
does.ms: Membuat susulan dengan pemilik yang tiada pelan, lewat tarikh akhir atau gagal semakan (panggilan, mesej, e-mel, lawatan, mesyuarat atau memo, dengan tarikh seterusnya).

who.en: Team Auditor, then the ACT Manager

does.en: Checks the fix: “Fix works, close” or “Not fixed” (back to the owner). With an ACT Manager on record, the Auditor’s check is the first check and the ACT Manager second-checks it.
does.ms: Menyemak pembetulan: “Fix works, close” atau “Not fixed” (kembali kepada pemilik). Jika ada Pengurus ACT, semakan Juruaudit ialah semakan pertama dan Pengurus ACT membuat semakan kedua.

does.en: Closes high findings (only the Director may).
does.ms: Menutup dapatan tahap tinggi (hanya Pengarah boleh).

rules.en: Fix within 14, 30 or 60 days by severity.
rules.ms: Betulkan dalam 14, 30 atau 60 hari mengikut tahap.

rules.en: Overdue findings are shown to the Chief of Staff, then the COO after 14 days and the CEO after 30. Nothing is automatic discipline.
rules.ms: Dapatan lewat ditunjukkan kepada Ketua Staf, kemudian COO selepas 14 hari dan CEO selepas 30 hari. Tiada tindakan disiplin automatik.

rules.en: ACT is never the owner of a finding, and Auditors and Enforcement act only on their own team’s findings.
rules.ms: ACT tidak sekali-kali menjadi pemilik dapatan, dan Juruaudit serta Penguatkuasa hanya bertindak atas dapatan pasukan sendiri.

rules.en: Enforcement never checks a fix; nobody second-checks their own check.
rules.ms: Penguatkuasa tidak menyemak pembetulan; tiada sesiapa menyemak semula semakan sendiri.

statusNote.en: The 5-day plan follow-up and the 7-day follow-up cycle are proposals awaiting Fauzan.
statusNote.ms: Susulan pelan 5 hari dan kitaran susulan 7 hari adalah cadangan yang menunggu Fauzan.

source.decided: Fauzan, 27 Oct and 2 Nov 2026; second check, 11 Nov 2026

sops.words: act audit finding dapatan corrective action pembetulan enforcement penguatkuasa auditor escalation

title.en: ACT check of the monthly reports
title.ms: Semakan ACT ke atas laporan bulanan

purpose.en: ACT reads the same monthly report each department sends to the Director Office and checks it is on time, complete and true.
purpose.ms: ACT membaca laporan bulanan yang sama yang dihantar setiap jabatan kepada Pejabat Pengarah dan menyemak ia tepat pada masa, lengkap dan benar.

starter.en: ACT Director

does.en: Sends the monthly report on the Reports screen and ticks the sections it covers.
does.ms: Menghantar laporan bulanan di skrin Laporan dan menanda bahagian yang dilaporkan.

does.en: Gives each report’s review to Team 1 or Team 2 (“Review: Team 1/2”) and sets each department’s form (“Save form”).
does.ms: Memberi semakan setiap laporan kepada Pasukan 1 atau 2 (“Review: Team 1/2”) dan menetapkan borang setiap jabatan (“Save form”).

does.en: Compares the key figures with Prima’s own records (for example headcount against HR, collections against Finance) and records the review done.
does.ms: Membandingkan angka utama dengan rekod Prima sendiri (contohnya bilangan staf dengan HR, kutipan dengan Kewangan) dan merekod semakan selesai.

does.en: A late or wrong report becomes a finding with the department head as owner.
does.ms: Laporan lewat atau salah menjadi dapatan dengan ketua jabatan sebagai pemilik.

rules.en: Monthly reports are due on the 25th of the next month.
rules.ms: Laporan bulanan perlu dihantar sebelum 25 haribulan bulan berikutnya.

rules.en: A department with no report set is never green; a report with sections missing shows “Incomplete”.
rules.ms: Jabatan tanpa laporan ditetapkan tidak sekali-kali hijau; laporan yang tertinggal bahagian dipaparkan “Incomplete”.

rules.en: Work given to a team is recorded done by that team’s Auditor (or the Director).
rules.ms: Kerja yang diberi kepada pasukan direkod selesai oleh Juruaudit pasukan itu (atau Pengarah).

statusNote.en: The nine-section standard form is a proposal; the ACT Director decides each department’s form.
statusNote.ms: Borang standard sembilan bahagian adalah cadangan; Pengarah ACT menentukan borang setiap jabatan.

sops.words: monthly report laporan bulanan act review semakan director office 25th

title.en: Record patterns and investigations

purpose.en: Fixed checks over Prima’s records show patterns for ACT to verify (never proof or an accusation); ACT decides whether to raise a finding or open an investigation.
purpose.ms: Semakan tetap ke atas rekod Prima menunjukkan corak untuk ACT sahkan (bukan bukti atau tuduhan); ACT memutuskan sama ada membangkitkan dapatan atau membuka siasatan.

starter.en: ACT Director (any team) or an Auditor (own team)
starter.ms: Pengarah ACT (mana-mana pasukan) atau Juruaudit (pasukan sendiri)

does.en: Looks at a pattern and opens an investigation file for a team.
does.ms: Meneliti corak dan membuka fail siasatan untuk sesuatu pasukan.

does.en: Adds evidence and notes; each file is kept with its fingerprint and every open, add and view is logged.
does.ms: Menambah bukti dan nota; setiap fail disimpan dengan cap jarinya dan setiap buka, tambah dan lihat direkod.

does.en: Closes the file with an outcome (substantiated, not substantiated, or referred, naming to whom, such as HR or Legal) and a reason.
does.ms: Menutup fail dengan keputusan (terbukti, tidak terbukti, atau dirujuk dengan nama pihak seperti HR atau Undang-undang) dan sebab.

rules.en: Only the assigned team and the Director see a file; the other team sees only “Under investigation”.
rules.ms: Hanya pasukan yang ditugaskan dan Pengarah melihat fail; pasukan lain hanya melihat “Under investigation”.

rules.en: Nothing is removed; the same file cannot be attached twice; a closed file takes no more evidence.
rules.ms: Tiada apa dibuang; fail yang sama tidak boleh dilampirkan dua kali; fail yang ditutup tidak menerima bukti lagi.

rules.en: Prima never disciplines anyone; whoever it is referred to decides any action.
rules.ms: Prima tidak sekali-kali mendisiplinkan sesiapa; pihak yang dirujuk memutuskan sebarang tindakan.

statusNote.en: The look-back period and pattern limits are proposals.
statusNote.ms: Tempoh semakan ke belakang dan had corak adalah cadangan.

sops.words: fraud penipuan pattern corak investigation siasatan evidence bukti anomaly duplicate claim

title.en: Improvement led by ACT

purpose.en: ACT proposes an improvement to a workflow; the COO or CEO approves it; the steps are ticked off and the result recorded.
purpose.ms: ACT mencadangkan penambahbaikan aliran kerja; COO atau CEO meluluskannya; langkah ditanda selesai dan keputusan direkod.

starter.en: ACT

does.en: Proposes the improvement with its steps and target.
does.ms: Mencadangkan penambahbaikan bersama langkah dan sasarannya.

does.en: Approves it with a note.
does.ms: Meluluskannya dengan nota.

does.en: Ticks each step done, then records the result.
does.ms: Menanda setiap langkah selesai, kemudian merekod keputusannya.

rules.en: Improvements are approved by the COO or the CEO.
rules.ms: Penambahbaikan diluluskan oleh COO atau CEO.

sops.words: improvement penambahbaikan transformation transformasi act process proses

title.en: Speak up (whistleblowing) report

purpose.en: Anyone, guards included, can report wrongdoing, anonymously if they wish. The report never reaches anyone it names.
purpose.ms: Sesiapa sahaja, termasuk pengawal, boleh melaporkan salah laku, tanpa nama jika mahu. Laporan tidak sekali-kali sampai kepada sesiapa yang dinamakan di dalamnya.

starter.en: Anyone with a Prima sign-in

does.en: Writes what it is about and sends it; keeps the receipt code to check on it, answer questions or report retaliation later.
does.ms: Menulis perkaranya dan menghantar; menyimpan kod resit untuk menyemak, menjawab soalan atau melaporkan tindakan balas kemudian.

label.en: Speak up and assurance › Speak up
label.ms: Speak up dan jaminan › Speak up

who.en: Handler (ACT Director, else the Chairman or Vice Chairman, never anyone named)
who.ms: Pengendali (Pengarah ACT, jika tidak Pengerusi atau Naib Pengerusi, bukan sesiapa yang dinamakan)

does.en: Acknowledges, investigates, adds notes, writes to the reporter, then proposes closing.
does.ms: Mengakui terima, menyiasat, menambah nota, menulis kepada pelapor, kemudian mencadangkan penutupan.

does.en: “Agree and close” or “Send back” with a note.
does.ms: “Agree and close” atau “Send back” dengan nota.

rules.en: Acknowledge within 7 days.
rules.ms: Akui terima dalam 7 hari.

rules.en: While open, the handler updates the reporter at least every 30 days.
rules.ms: Semasa terbuka, pengendali memaklumkan pelapor sekurang-kurangnya setiap 30 hari.

rules.en: The receipt code can report retaliation for 365 days after closing.
rules.ms: Kod resit boleh melaporkan tindakan balas selama 365 hari selepas ditutup.

rules.en: Closing always needs a second handler.
rules.ms: Penutupan sentiasa memerlukan pengendali kedua.

statusNote.en: The 7-day acknowledgement and the handler order are proposals.
statusNote.ms: Akuan terima 7 hari dan susunan pengendali adalah cadangan.

source.decided: Fauzan, 8 Nov 2026 (update and retaliation periods, rule AUD-GRC)

sops.words: speak up whistleblowing pemberi maklumat aduan complaint wrongdoing salah laku anonymous tanpa nama retaliation

title.en: Declaring a gift or hospitality

purpose.en: Everyone declares every gift or hospitality given or received; larger ones, any with a public official and any cash need a decision.
purpose.ms: Semua orang mengisytiharkan setiap hadiah atau keraian yang diberi atau diterima; yang besar, yang melibatkan penjawat awam dan sebarang wang tunai memerlukan keputusan.

starter.en: Anyone with a Prima sign-in

does.en: Declares the gift: given or received, from or to whom, what, value, date, cash or not.
does.ms: Mengisytiharkan hadiah: diberi atau diterima, daripada atau kepada siapa, apa, nilai, tarikh, tunai atau tidak.

does.en: Decides: keep (needs a comment), return, donate or refuse.
does.ms: Memutuskan: simpan (perlu ulasan), pulangkan, dermakan atau tolak.

rules.en: Above RM500, anything with a public official, and any cash need a decision.
rules.ms: Melebihi RM500, apa-apa dengan penjawat awam, dan sebarang wang tunai memerlukan keputusan.

rules.en: Cash is never kept; a gift with a public official or in cash cannot be approved to keep.
rules.ms: Wang tunai tidak sekali-kali disimpan; hadiah dengan penjawat awam atau tunai tidak boleh diluluskan untuk disimpan.

statusNote.en: The RM500 limit is a proposal.
statusNote.ms: Had RM500 adalah cadangan.

sops.words: gift hadiah hospitality keraian bribery rasuah macc 17a cash tunai

title.en: What each company must prove (obligations)
title.ms: Apa yang setiap syarikat mesti buktikan (kewajipan)

purpose.en: Each company records proof of its recurring legal and policy duties (OSH, anti-bribery and others); ACT accepts or rejects the proof. No proof is Unknown, never green.
purpose.ms: Setiap syarikat merekod bukti kewajipan undang-undang dan polisi yang berulang (OSH, anti-rasuah dan lain-lain); ACT menerima atau menolak bukti. Tiada bukti bermakna Unknown, bukan hijau.

starter.en: Company Manager or the company team

does.en: Records the date and reference of the proof for each obligation as it falls due.
does.ms: Merekod tarikh dan rujukan bukti bagi setiap kewajipan apabila tiba masanya.

does.en: Accepts or rejects the proof with a note.
does.ms: Menerima atau menolak bukti dengan nota.

does.en: Records each site’s risk assessment (HIRARC) review.
does.ms: Merekod semakan penilaian risiko (HIRARC) setiap tapak.

label.en: Speak up and assurance › Site safety
label.ms: Speak up dan jaminan › Keselamatan tapak

rules.en: Every site has a risk assessment reviewed every 12 months (OSHA 1994 s.18B); a site with none is Unknown.
rules.ms: Setiap tapak mempunyai penilaian risiko yang disemak setiap 12 bulan (OSHA 1994 s.18B); tapak tanpanya ialah Unknown.

rules.en: The person who records proof does not check it.
rules.ms: Orang yang merekod bukti tidak menyemaknya.

sops.words: obligation kewajipan proof bukti osh hirarc risk assessment penilaian risiko anti bribery

title.en: ISO 9001 and PIKM requirements: evidence and check
title.ms: Keperluan ISO 9001 dan PIKM: bukti dan semakan

purpose.en: One register of what ISO 9001 and the PIKM code ask for, per company, with the Prima records that show it is done. A person checks the evidence; Prima never says a company is compliant.
purpose.ms: Satu daftar keperluan ISO 9001 dan kod PIKM bagi setiap syarikat, dengan rekod Prima yang menunjukkan ia dibuat. Seseorang menyemak bukti; Prima tidak sekali-kali menyatakan syarikat itu patuh.

starter.en: ACT keeps the list; the Company Manager links evidence
starter.ms: ACT menyimpan senarai; Pengurus Syarikat memautkan bukti

does.en: On a fresh install presses “Load starter list” once, then keeps the requirements (adds, edits, retires).
does.ms: Pada pemasangan baru tekan “Load starter list” sekali, kemudian menyelenggara keperluan (tambah, ubah, tamatkan).

does.en: Links the evidence that already exists: a Prima record, a document link, or what was seen on site.
does.ms: Memautkan bukti yang sudah ada: rekod Prima, pautan dokumen, atau apa yang dilihat di tapak.

who.en: ACT (never the person who linked it)

does.en: Checks the evidence with a reason, or marks “Does not apply”, or raises the gap as an ACT finding.
does.ms: Menyemak bukti dengan sebab, atau menanda “Does not apply”, atau membangkitkan jurang sebagai dapatan ACT.

rules.en: Checked evidence is reviewed again every 12 months; “due soon” shows 60 days ahead.
rules.ms: Bukti yang disemak dikaji semula setiap 12 bulan; “due soon” dipaparkan 60 hari lebih awal.

rules.en: Guards and ordinary staff never see clause checklists.
rules.ms: Pengawal dan staf biasa tidak sekali-kali melihat senarai semak klausa.

rules.en: A gap goes to an ACT finding, not a second corrective-action system.
rules.ms: Jurang dibawa ke dapatan ACT, bukan sistem tindakan pembetulan kedua.

statusNote.en: PIKM rows follow the 2022 drafts of Parts 1 and 2; ACT re-checks them when the final code is published.
statusNote.ms: Baris PIKM mengikut draf 2022 Bahagian 1 dan 2; ACT menyemak semula apabila kod muktamad diterbitkan.

sops.words: iso 9001 pikm sirim quality kualiti requirement keperluan evidence bukti clause klausa register

title.en: Service fault (the service was not what was agreed)
title.ms: Kesalahan perkhidmatan (perkhidmatan tidak seperti yang dipersetujui)

purpose.en: One record of what went wrong, what was done at once and whether the client was told; serious or repeat faults go to ACT for the root cause.
purpose.ms: Satu rekod apa yang salah, tindakan segera dan sama ada klien dimaklumkan; kesalahan serius atau berulang dibawa kepada ACT untuk punca sebenar.

starter.en: Company Manager (own company), Operations OM and up (sites they cover), or ACT
starter.ms: Pengurus Syarikat (syarikat sendiri), Operasi OM ke atas (tapak di bawah jagaan), atau ACT

does.en: Records what happened, what was done at once and whether the client was told (a client complaint says how the client was answered).
does.ms: Merekod apa yang berlaku, tindakan segera dan sama ada klien dimaklumkan (aduan klien menyatakan bagaimana klien dijawab).

does.en: For a fault marked “Root cause needed”, raises an ACT finding owned by the Company Manager.
does.ms: Bagi kesalahan bertanda “Root cause needed”, membangkitkan dapatan ACT dengan Pengurus Syarikat sebagai pemilik.

does.en: Closes it as put right, client accepted (naming the client person) or service stopped.
does.ms: Menutupnya sebagai sudah dibetulkan, diterima klien (menamakan wakil klien) atau perkhidmatan dihentikan.

rules.en: A second fault at the same site within 90 days is a repeat and needs a root cause.
rules.ms: Kesalahan kedua di tapak yang sama dalam 90 hari ialah ulangan dan memerlukan punca sebenar.

sops.words: service fault kesalahan perkhidmatan nonconformity complaint aduan klien client root cause punca

title.en: Controlled documents and management review
title.ms: Dokumen terkawal dan kajian semula pengurusan

purpose.en: SOPs and policies keep one code across versions, each version approved by a second person; the yearly management review record is agreed by the CEO.
purpose.ms: SOP dan polisi mengekalkan satu kod merentas versi, setiap versi diluluskan oleh orang kedua; rekod kajian semula pengurusan dipersetujui oleh CEO.

starter.en: ACT or the Chief of Staff

does.en: Adds the document version with its SharePoint link.
does.ms: Menambah versi dokumen bersama pautan SharePoint.

who.en: Another keeper or the CEO (never the writer)

does.en: Approves the version or sends it back with a reason. The old version stays in force until then.
does.ms: Meluluskan versi atau menghantarnya balik dengan sebab. Versi lama kekal berkuat kuasa sehingga itu.

who.en: ACT or Chief of Staff, then the CEO
who.ms: ACT atau Ketua Staf, kemudian CEO

does.en: Writes the management review record with the inputs pack Prima builds; the CEO agrees it.
does.ms: Menulis rekod kajian semula pengurusan dengan pek input yang Prima bina; CEO mempersetujuinya.

rules.en: Documents are reviewed every 24 months by default.
rules.ms: Dokumen disemak setiap 24 bulan secara lalai.

rules.en: Prima keeps the link and says it is not checked; the file stays in SharePoint.
rules.ms: Prima menyimpan pautan dan menyatakan ia belum disemak; fail kekal di SharePoint.

rules.en: Company Managers see only versions in force.
rules.ms: Pengurus Syarikat hanya melihat versi yang berkuat kuasa.

sops.words: controlled document dokumen terkawal sop policy polisi version versi management review kajian semula pengurusan

title.en: Role competency: profiles and skill checks
title.ms: Kompetensi peranan: profil dan semakan kemahiran

purpose.en: HR proposes what each role needs (licences, training, skills); the HR Director agrees it; managers and officers assess their people, never themselves.
purpose.ms: HR mencadangkan keperluan setiap peranan (lesen, latihan, kemahiran); Pengarah HR mempersetujuinya; pengurus dan pegawai menilai orang mereka, bukan diri sendiri.

starter.en: HR Admin

does.en: Proposes a role profile (or loads the four starter profiles).
does.ms: Mencadangkan profil peranan (atau memuatkan empat profil permulaan).

who.en: HR Director (Chief of Staff or Deputy)

does.en: Agrees or sends back the profile with a reason, never one they proposed.
does.ms: Bersetuju atau menghantar balik profil dengan sebab, bukan yang dicadangkan sendiri.

who.en: Company Manager, stationed officer, OM, or HR
who.ms: Pengurus Syarikat, pegawai bertugas, OM, atau HR

does.en: Assesses each person: competent or not yet, how it was assessed, what was seen, the refresher date and any course it follows.
does.ms: Menilai setiap orang: kompeten atau belum, cara penilaian, apa yang dilihat, tarikh ulangan dan kursus berkaitan.

rules.en: Licences and certificates are read from HR’s records; nobody types them twice.
rules.ms: Lesen dan sijil dibaca daripada rekod HR; tiada sesiapa menaipnya dua kali.

rules.en: Refreshers every 12 months for guards and officers; office Prima and PDPA training every 24 months.
rules.ms: Ulangan setiap 12 bulan bagi pengawal dan pegawai; latihan Prima dan PDPA pejabat setiap 24 bulan.

sops.words: competency kompetensi skill kemahiran guard skills assessment penilaian training latihan refresher profile

title.en: Supplier rating

purpose.en: Procurement (or the Company Manager for its own suppliers) rates each supplier on quality, time and paperwork, again every 12 months.
purpose.ms: Perolehan (atau Pengurus Syarikat bagi pembekal sendiri) menilai setiap pembekal dari segi kualiti, masa dan dokumen, semula setiap 12 bulan.

starter.en: Procurement executive or Company Manager

does.en: Scores the supplier 1 to 5 for quality, time and paperwork; a low score, watch or stop needs a note.
does.ms: Memberi markah 1 hingga 5 untuk kualiti, masa dan dokumen; markah rendah, pantau atau henti perlu nota.

does.en: “Stop” blocks the supplier at once; only Finance unblocks it.
does.ms: “Stop” menyekat pembekal serta-merta; hanya Kewangan boleh membuka sekatan.

rules.en: Each supplier is rated again every 12 months.
rules.ms: Setiap pembekal dinilai semula setiap 12 bulan.

sops.words: supplier pembekal rating penarafan vendor procurement perolehan block sekat

title.en: Sharing out the company office desks

purpose.en: The head of each company office (GM, else Company Manager) gives each of the six desks an owner and a backup, so every piece of company work has a person today.
purpose.ms: Ketua setiap pejabat syarikat (GM, jika tiada Pengurus Syarikat) memberi setiap enam meja seorang pemilik dan pengganti, supaya setiap kerja syarikat ada orangnya hari ini.

starter.en: The company’s office head (GM or Company Manager)
starter.ms: Ketua pejabat syarikat (GM atau Pengurus Syarikat)

does.en: Picks an owner and a backup for each desk (guards and roster; clients and billing; tenders; licences and compliance; cases; office, purchases and claims) and saves with a note.
does.ms: Memilih pemilik dan pengganti bagi setiap meja (pengawal dan roster; klien dan bil; tender; lesen dan pematuhan; kes; pejabat, pembelian dan tuntutan) dan simpan dengan nota.

does.en: Work the office queue for their desks; when an owner is on leave the backup holds the desk for the day.
does.ms: Mengerjakan giliran pejabat untuk meja mereka; apabila pemilik bercuti, pengganti memegang meja itu untuk hari itu.

does.en: Read every office’s staffing, cover and open work; they cannot change a company’s desks.
does.ms: Membaca kakitangan, liputan dan kerja terbuka setiap pejabat; mereka tidak boleh menukar meja syarikat.

rules.en: One head and 2 to 8 executives per company office.
rules.ms: Seorang ketua dan 2 hingga 8 eksekutif bagi setiap pejabat syarikat.

rules.en: If both owner and backup are away, the work falls to the head.
rules.ms: Jika pemilik dan pengganti tiada, kerja jatuh kepada ketua.

rules.en: Approvals and arms always stay with the head.
rules.ms: Kelulusan dan senjata api sentiasa kekal dengan ketua.

rules.en: A company with no licence or too little work can be run by another office; only the Chief of Staff or the CEO sets this, with a reason.
rules.ms: Syarikat tanpa lesen atau kurang kerja boleh dijalankan oleh pejabat lain; hanya Ketua Staf atau CEO menetapkannya, dengan sebab.

statusNote.en: The six desks are a proposal; rename or merge them if the companies split work differently.
statusNote.ms: Enam meja adalah cadangan; namakan semula atau gabungkan jika syarikat membahagi kerja secara berbeza.

sops.words: company office pejabat syarikat desk meja backup pengganti gm company manager executive eksekutif run by

title.en: CEO instruction

purpose.en: The CEO (or the Director Office for the CEO) gives an instruction with what done means and a due date; it lands in the owner’s own Work list and the CEO accepts the result.
purpose.ms: CEO (atau Pejabat Pengarah bagi pihak CEO) memberi arahan bersama maksud siap dan tarikh akhir; ia masuk ke senarai Kerja pemilik dan CEO menerima hasilnya.

starter.en: CEO or the Director Office

does.en: Under “CEO instructions” picks who does it, writes the instruction, what done means and the due date.
does.ms: Di bawah “CEO instructions” pilih siapa yang buat, tulis arahan, maksud siap dan tarikh akhir.

does.en: Does it and marks it done with the proof in My work.
does.ms: Melaksanakannya dan tanda selesai dengan bukti di My work.

does.en: Accepts the result with a reason, or returns it with what to fix.
does.ms: Menerima hasil dengan sebab, atau memulangkannya dengan apa yang perlu dibetulkan.

rules.en: Overdue instructions reach the CEO’s home without anyone reporting them.
rules.ms: Arahan yang lewat sampai ke laman utama CEO tanpa perlu dilaporkan.

rules.en: The Director Office records instructions only for staff within its company access.
rules.ms: Pejabat Pengarah merekod arahan hanya untuk staf dalam akses syarikatnya.

sops.words: ceo instruction arahan ceo task tugasan director office pejabat pengarah follow up

title.en: Corporate change approved by PWVSB

purpose.en: Any change to a company’s directors, shares, owners or other corporate details needs PWVSB approval before the board acts; the SSM filing then opens by itself.
purpose.ms: Sebarang perubahan kepada pengarah, saham, pemilik atau butiran korporat syarikat memerlukan kelulusan PWVSB sebelum lembaga bertindak; pemfailan SSM kemudian dibuka sendiri.

starter.en: Company Manager

does.en: Asks PWVSB to approve the change, with the detail.
does.ms: Memohon PWVSB meluluskan perubahan, bersama butirannya.

who.en: Deputy Chief of Staff (never the person who raised it)
who.ms: Timbalan Ketua Staf (bukan orang yang memohon)

does.en: Approves or rejects with a reason, citing the signed clause. The Chief of Staff monitors.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan sebab, merujuk klausa yang ditandatangani. Ketua Staf memantau.

who.en: Company Manager or Deputy Chief of Staff
who.ms: Pengurus Syarikat atau Timbalan Ketua Staf

does.en: Records the board resolution; the 14-day SSM filing opens by itself.
does.ms: Merekod resolusi lembaga; pemfailan SSM 14 hari dibuka sendiri.

rules.en: Every approval carries a reason; nobody approves their own request.
rules.ms: Setiap kelulusan disertakan sebab; tiada sesiapa meluluskan permohonan sendiri.

sops.words: corporate change perubahan korporat director pengarah shares saham board resolution resolusi lembaga pwvsb

title.en: SSM filing (annual return, financial statements and others)
title.ms: Pemfailan SSM (penyata tahunan, penyata kewangan dan lain-lain)

purpose.en: Head office Corporate Admin records each company’s SSM lodgements from papers ready to SSM receipt; the company and its secretary view them.
purpose.ms: Pentadbiran Korporat ibu pejabat merekod pemfailan SSM setiap syarikat dari dokumen sedia hingga resit SSM; syarikat dan setiausahanya melihatnya.

starter.en: Deputy Chief of Staff (Corporate Admin)

does.en: Adds the filing with its due date, then marks the papers ready for the secretary.
does.ms: Menambah pemfailan bersama tarikh akhir, kemudian menanda dokumen sedia untuk setiausaha.

who.en: Company secretary (outside Prima), then Deputy Chief of Staff
who.ms: Setiausaha syarikat (di luar Prima), kemudian Timbalan Ketua Staf

does.en: The secretary lodges in MBRS; the Deputy records “Secretary lodged it” with the reference.
does.ms: Setiausaha menghantar dalam MBRS; Timbalan merekod “Secretary lodged it” bersama rujukan.

does.en: Records the SSM receipt; until then the filing waits for acknowledgement.
does.ms: Merekod resit SSM; sehingga itu pemfailan menunggu pengakuan.

rules.en: Annual return within 30 days; financial statements circulated within 6 months of year end.
rules.ms: Penyata tahunan dalam 30 hari; penyata kewangan diedarkan dalam 6 bulan selepas tahun kewangan berakhir.

rules.en: Overdue filings show on the Deputy Chief of Staff’s home.
rules.ms: Pemfailan lewat dipaparkan di laman utama Timbalan Ketua Staf.

statusNote.en: Deadlines follow the Companies Act 2016 and are for the secretaries to confirm.
statusNote.ms: Tarikh akhir mengikut Akta Syarikat 2016 dan perlu disahkan oleh setiausaha.

sops.words: ssm filing pemfailan annual return penyata tahunan mbrs secretary setiausaha financial statements

title.en: Company record and company file checked against SSM
title.ms: Rekod syarikat dan fail syarikat disemak dengan SSM

purpose.en: The Head of Company keeps its company’s record (name, SSM number, dates, addresses) and company file (directors, shareholders, owners, key papers) as drafts; the Deputy Chief of Staff checks them against the SSM extract.
purpose.ms: Ketua Syarikat menyimpan rekod syarikat (nama, nombor SSM, tarikh, alamat) dan fail syarikat (pengarah, pemegang saham, pemilik, dokumen utama) sebagai draf; Timbalan Ketua Staf menyemaknya dengan ekstrak SSM.

starter.en: Head of Company (Company Manager)

does.en: Opens “Company record” on Company today and saves the company details as a draft, with the SSM source document reference.
does.ms: Buka “Company record” di Syarikat hari ini dan simpan butiran syarikat sebagai draf, bersama rujukan dokumen sumber SSM.

does.en: Saves the company file (directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, constitution, key papers) as a draft.
does.ms: Menyimpan fail syarikat (pengarah, pemegang saham, pemilik benefisial, perlembagaan, dokumen utama) sebagai draf.

who.en: Deputy Chief of Staff (never their own draft)

does.en: “Matches SSM” with the extract reference, or “Send back with differences”; the company fixes and resubmits.
does.ms: “Matches SSM” bersama rujukan ekstrak, atau “Send back with differences”; syarikat membetulkan dan menghantar semula.

rules.en: Nobody checks their own draft; a confirmation needs a reason.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa menyemak draf sendiri; pengesahan memerlukan sebab.

rules.en: A beneficial owner not notified to SSM within 14 days is flagged.
rules.ms: Pemilik benefisial yang tidak dimaklumkan kepada SSM dalam 14 hari ditanda.

rules.en: SSM data comes only from company-authorised documents, never guesses.
rules.ms: Data SSM hanya daripada dokumen yang dibenarkan syarikat, bukan tekaan.

sops.words: company record rekod syarikat company file fail syarikat ssm director pengarah shareholder pemegang saham beneficial owner

title.en: Delegation and succession

purpose.en: A register of who acts for whom, over what and until when (leave cover, emergency, succession). It gives nobody access or approval rights by itself.
purpose.ms: Daftar siapa bertindak bagi siapa, untuk apa dan sehingga bila (ganti cuti, kecemasan, penggantian). Ia sendiri tidak memberi akses atau hak kelulusan kepada sesiapa.

starter.en: CEO or Chief of Staff (group posts); Company Manager (the company’s posts)
starter.ms: CEO atau Ketua Staf (jawatan kumpulan); Pengurus Syarikat (jawatan syarikat)

who.en: Keeper (CEO, Chief of Staff or Company Manager)
who.ms: Penyimpan (CEO, Ketua Staf atau Pengurus Syarikat)

does.en: Records the delegation line and its evidence (competency; for succession the board resolution).
does.ms: Merekod baris delegasi dan buktinya (kompetensi; bagi penggantian, resolusi lembaga).

who.en: One leader: CEO, COO or Chief of Staff (succession: the Chairman)
who.ms: Seorang pemimpin: CEO, COO atau Ketua Staf (penggantian: Pengerusi)

does.en: Approves with a reason, never the recorder or the person who acts.
does.ms: Meluluskan dengan sebab, bukan perekod atau orang yang bertindak.

does.en: Asks IT for time-limited access and hands chosen open work over; at the end, asks IT to remove access and hands work back.
does.ms: Memohon IT akses terhad masa dan menyerahkan kerja terbuka yang dipilih; di akhir, memohon IT membuang akses dan memulangkan kerja.

rules.en: Emergency and leave cover need an end date; access lasts at most 90 days.
rules.ms: Ganti kecemasan dan cuti perlu tarikh tamat; akses paling lama 90 hari.

rules.en: A succession is put in force only by the Chairman, alone or consenting after the CEO.
rules.ms: Penggantian hanya berkuat kuasa oleh Pengerusi, sendiri atau dengan persetujuan selepas CEO.

rules.en: Lines are ended or revoked with a reason, never deleted.
rules.ms: Baris ditamatkan atau dibatalkan dengan sebab, tidak dipadam.

source.decided: Fauzan, 3 Nov 2026 (one leader approves; successions by the Chairman)

sops.words: delegation delegasi succession penggantian acting pemangku cover ganti critical post jawatan kritikal

title.en: Legal hold on records

purpose.en: For an open legal matter, Legal places a hold on records; while it stands the database keeps every earlier version and refuses deletes. Staff work is not stopped and staff are not told.
purpose.ms: Bagi perkara undang-undang yang terbuka, Undang-undang meletakkan penahanan ke atas rekod; semasa berkuat kuasa pangkalan data menyimpan setiap versi terdahulu dan menolak pemadaman. Kerja staf tidak dihentikan dan staf tidak dimaklumkan.

starter.en: PWVSB legal or the Deputy Chief of Staff
starter.ms: Undang-undang PWVSB atau Timbalan Ketua Staf

who.en: PWVSB legal or Deputy Chief of Staff
who.ms: Undang-undang PWVSB atau Timbalan Ketua Staf

does.en: Places the hold on the record with a reason, kept on the legal matter.
does.ms: Meletakkan penahanan ke atas rekod dengan sebab, disimpan pada perkara undang-undang.

who.en: PWVSB legal or Deputy Chief of Staff
who.ms: Undang-undang PWVSB atau Timbalan Ketua Staf

does.en: Releases the hold with a reason when the matter allows.
does.ms: Melepaskan penahanan dengan sebab apabila perkara itu membenarkan.

rules.en: Seen only by legal and group leaders.
rules.ms: Dilihat hanya oleh undang-undang dan pemimpin kumpulan.

sops.words: legal hold penahanan undang-undang litigation preserve simpan record rekod court mahkamah

title.en: Mandate (management agreement or board mandate)

purpose.en: PWVSB acts in a company only under a signed agreement or mandate that the company’s board confirmed and PWVSB legal verified.
purpose.ms: PWVSB bertindak dalam syarikat hanya di bawah perjanjian atau mandat bertandatangan yang disahkan lembaga syarikat dan disemak oleh undang-undang PWVSB.

starter.en: PWVSB legal or the Chief of Staff

who.en: PWVSB legal or Chief of Staff

does.en: Adds the signed agreement or mandate with the powers it gives PWVSB.
does.ms: Menambah perjanjian atau mandat bertandatangan bersama kuasa yang diberi kepada PWVSB.

does.en: Records that its board confirmed it, with the resolution reference.
does.ms: Merekod bahawa lembaganya telah mengesahkan, bersama rujukan resolusi.

who.en: PWVSB legal (not the person who added it)

does.en: Verifies the signed copy with a reason. Only then is it in force.
does.ms: Mengesahkan salinan bertandatangan dengan sebab. Barulah ia berkuat kuasa.

rules.en: An area with no live mandate shows as Unknown, never covered.
rules.ms: Bidang tanpa mandat yang aktif dipaparkan Unknown, bukan dilindungi.

rules.en: It warns before the end date and gives no power after it.
rules.ms: Ia memberi amaran sebelum tarikh tamat dan tiada kuasa selepasnya.

statusNote.en: The areas and wording are proposals for counsel to check against the signed agreements.
statusNote.ms: Bidang dan perkataan adalah cadangan untuk peguam semak dengan perjanjian yang ditandatangani.

source.decided: V7, V8, V12 (24 Oct 2026); legal reason required (5A)

sops.words: mandate mandat management agreement perjanjian pengurusan authority kuasa board lembaga legal

title.en: Related-party deal

purpose.en: Any rent, loan, purchase, fee or rental between a group company and a director, shareholder, their family, their companies or another PWVSB company is recorded and reviewed.
purpose.ms: Sebarang sewa, pinjaman, pembelian, yuran atau sewaan antara syarikat kumpulan dengan pengarah, pemegang saham, keluarga mereka, syarikat mereka atau syarikat PWVSB lain direkod dan disemak.

starter.en: Deputy Chief of Staff

does.en: Records the deal; Prima matches the other party against declared interests as a hint.
does.ms: Merekod urus niaga; Prima memadankan pihak lain dengan kepentingan yang diisytiharkan sebagai petunjuk.

label.ms: Daftar tadbir urus › Urus niaga pihak berkaitan

who.en: Chief of Staff (never someone named as interested)
who.ms: Ketua Staf (bukan orang yang dinamakan berkepentingan)

does.en: Reviews with a reason (“Price is fair”) or asks a question for the Deputy to answer.
does.ms: Menyemak dengan sebab (“Price is fair”) atau bertanya soalan untuk dijawab Timbalan.

label.ms: Daftar tadbir urus › Urus niaga pihak berkaitan

who.en: The company board (outside Prima), then the Deputy
who.ms: Lembaga syarikat (di luar Prima), kemudian Timbalan

does.en: At or above the CEO’s board limit, the board resolves with interested directors out of the vote; the Deputy records it.
does.ms: Pada atau melebihi had lembaga CEO, lembaga membuat resolusi tanpa undi pengarah berkepentingan; Timbalan merekodnya.

label.ms: Daftar tadbir urus › Urus niaga pihak berkaitan

rules.en: No board step until the CEO sets a limit (with a reason, kept in its history).
rules.ms: Tiada langkah lembaga sehingga CEO menetapkan had (dengan sebab, disimpan dalam sejarahnya).

rules.en: Prima never approves for the board, signs or files.
rules.ms: Prima tidak sekali-kali meluluskan bagi pihak lembaga, menandatangan atau memfail.

statusNote.en: The board limit amount is not set yet by the CEO.
statusNote.ms: Jumlah had lembaga belum ditetapkan oleh CEO.

sops.words: related party pihak berkaitan deal urus niaga director pengarah shareholder conflict konflik loan pinjaman rent sewa

title.en: Directors’ yearly declaration of interests

purpose.en: Each director declares once a year (and when something changes) on a signed paper form; the Deputy Chief of Staff records it and the Chief of Staff reads it.
purpose.ms: Setiap pengarah mengisytiharkan sekali setahun (dan apabila ada perubahan) melalui borang kertas bertandatangan; Timbalan Ketua Staf merekodnya dan Ketua Staf membacanya.

starter.en: Deputy Chief of Staff

does.en: Fills and signs the yearly form, collected by hand.
does.ms: Mengisi dan menandatangani borang tahunan, dikutip secara manual.

does.en: Records the declaration and marks the director done for the year.
does.ms: Merekod pengisytiharan dan menanda pengarah selesai untuk tahun itu.

does.en: Reads it and records a comment.
does.ms: Membacanya dan merekod ulasan.

rules.en: No declaration shows as Unknown, never clear (Companies Act 2016 s.221).
rules.ms: Tiada pengisytiharan dipaparkan Unknown, bukan bersih (Akta Syarikat 2016 s.221).

sops.words: director interests kepentingan pengarah declaration pengisytiharan s221 conflict yearly tahunan

title.en: Risk register

purpose.en: The ACT Director keeps the group’s risks, gives each to an ACT team member to review, and settles and closes them. The CEO views.
purpose.ms: Pengarah ACT menyimpan risiko kumpulan, memberi setiap satu kepada ahli pasukan ACT untuk disemak, dan menyelesaikan serta menutupnya. CEO melihat.

starter.en: ACT Director

does.en: Adds the risk with likelihood and impact (5 x 5) and gives it to a team member with an instruction.
does.ms: Menambah risiko dengan kebarangkalian dan impak (5 x 5) dan memberinya kepada ahli pasukan dengan arahan.

does.en: Reviews the risk and records the review.
does.ms: Menyemak risiko dan merekod semakan.

does.en: Settles and closes it.
does.ms: Menyelesaikan dan menutupnya.

rules.en: A score of 15 or more is high: it needs an action and a due date and is reviewed every 3 months; others every 6.
rules.ms: Skor 15 ke atas adalah tinggi: perlu tindakan dan tarikh akhir dan disemak setiap 3 bulan; yang lain setiap 6 bulan.

statusNote.en: The 5 x 5 scoring and review periods are proposals for the CEO.
statusNote.ms: Pemarkahan 5 x 5 dan tempoh semakan adalah cadangan untuk CEO.

source.decided: Fauzan, 5 Nov 2026 (risk register is ACT only)

sops.words: risk risiko register daftar heat map likelihood kebarangkalian impact impak act

title.en: Personal data breach

purpose.en: The PDPA officer handles every breach: contain it, tell the PDP Commissioner within 72 hours, and the affected people within 7 days after that when the harm is significant.
purpose.ms: Pegawai PDPA mengendalikan setiap pelanggaran: bendung, maklumkan Pesuruhjaya PDP dalam 72 jam, dan orang yang terjejas dalam 7 hari selepas itu jika kemudaratan ketara.

starter.en: PDPA officer

does.en: Opens the breach case; the 72-hour clock counts down on screen.
does.ms: Membuka kes pelanggaran; jam 72 jam mengira detik di skrin.

does.en: Records Contained, Commissioner notified and, if needed, People notified, with notes and proof; then closes.
does.ms: Merekod Contained, Commissioner notified dan, jika perlu, People notified, dengan nota dan bukti; kemudian tutup.

who.en: Operations Director, Chief of Staff, CEO

does.en: Monitor; a late notice shows on the CEO’s home.
does.ms: Memantau; notis lewat dipaparkan di laman utama CEO.

rules.en: Every breach, notified or not, stays on the breach register for at least 2 years.
rules.ms: Setiap pelanggaran, dimaklumkan atau tidak, kekal dalam daftar pelanggaran sekurang-kurangnya 2 tahun.

rules.en: PDPA cases are never routed to other departments.
rules.ms: Kes PDPA tidak sekali-kali dihantar ke jabatan lain.

source.decided: PDPA (Amendment) Act 2024 s.12B; Fauzan, 26 Oct and 5 Nov 2026

sops.words: pdpa breach pelanggaran data peribadi personal data commissioner pesuruhjaya 72 hours jam leak kebocoran

title.en: A person’s request about their own data

purpose.en: Access, correction, a copy to move elsewhere, withdrawing consent or objecting: logged, identity checked first, answered within 21 days or refused only on the Act’s grounds.
purpose.ms: Akses, pembetulan, salinan untuk dipindah, menarik balik persetujuan atau bantahan: direkod, identiti disemak dahulu, dijawab dalam 21 hari atau ditolak hanya atas alasan Akta.

starter.en: PDPA officer

does.en: Logs the request with who asked, what kind and the day it was received; the 21-day clock starts.
does.ms: Merekod permohonan dengan siapa yang meminta, jenis dan tarikh diterima; jam 21 hari bermula.

does.en: Records “Identity checked” first.
does.ms: Merekod “Identity checked” dahulu.

does.en: Answers it, or refuses on one of the Act’s grounds, in writing.
does.ms: Menjawabnya, atau menolak atas salah satu alasan Akta, secara bertulis.

rules.en: Access and correction within 21 days (PDPA s.31 and s.35).
rules.ms: Akses dan pembetulan dalam 21 hari (PDPA s.31 dan s.35).

rules.en: Each company’s data protection officer is notified to the Commissioner within 21 days (DPO register).
rules.ms: Pegawai perlindungan data setiap syarikat dimaklumkan kepada Pesuruhjaya dalam 21 hari (daftar DPO).

statusNote.en: The 21-day period for portability is a proposal; counsel to confirm.
statusNote.ms: Tempoh 21 hari untuk kemudahalihan data adalah cadangan; peguam perlu mengesahkan.

sops.words: pdpa data request permohonan data access akses correction pembetulan consent persetujuan dpo portability

title.en: A task: given, done with proof, accepted
title.ms: Tugasan: diberi, siap dengan bukti, diterima

purpose.en: Everyone sees what to do and what “done” means; the person finishes with proof, asks for more time or help; the manager accepts or returns it with a comment.
purpose.ms: Semua orang melihat apa yang perlu dibuat dan maksud “siap”; orang itu menyiapkan dengan bukti, meminta masa tambahan atau bantuan; pengurus menerima atau memulangkan dengan ulasan.

starter.en: Line manager (group leaders may give a task to anyone on staff)
starter.ms: Pengurus langsung (pemimpin kumpulan boleh memberi tugasan kepada mana-mana staf)

does.en: Gives the task with what done means, the due time and priority.
does.ms: Memberi tugasan bersama maksud siap, masa akhir dan keutamaan.

does.en: Sends the morning check-in by 10:00, then marks the task done with the proof, or asks for more time with a reason, or presses “Stuck? Ask for help”.
does.ms: Menghantar daftar masuk pagi sebelum 10:00, kemudian tanda tugasan siap dengan bukti, atau minta masa tambahan dengan sebab, atau tekan “Stuck? Ask for help”.

does.en: Accepts it, or returns it to fix, with a comment.
does.ms: Menerimanya, atau memulangkan untuk dibetulkan, dengan ulasan.

rules.en: A help request not answered within 30 minutes shows to the manager’s manager.
rules.ms: Permintaan bantuan yang tidak dijawab dalam 30 minit dipaparkan kepada pengurus kepada pengurus.

rules.en: A one-to-one with each team member every week; missing after 7 days shows on the manager’s list.
rules.ms: Sesi satu-ke-satu dengan setiap ahli pasukan setiap minggu; tiada selepas 7 hari dipaparkan dalam senarai pengurus.

rules.en: Only the person’s managers (or the named duty checker) accept or return a task, always with a comment.
rules.ms: Hanya pengurus orang itu (atau penyemak tugas yang dinamakan) menerima atau memulangkan tugasan, sentiasa dengan ulasan.

statusNote.en: The “due soon” 3 days and the 80% on-time standard are proposals.
statusNote.ms: “Due soon” 3 hari dan standard 80% tepat masa adalah cadangan.

sops.words: task tugasan work kerja done siap proof bukti check-in daftar masuk help bantuan one-to-one manager pengurus

title.en: Duty checklists (daily to yearly duties)

purpose.en: Each company or unit loads the group template of duties per person; each line opens as a task in My work in its window, and done in the window counts on time.
purpose.ms: Setiap syarikat atau unit memuatkan templat tugas kumpulan bagi setiap orang; setiap baris dibuka sebagai tugasan di My work dalam tempohnya, dan siap dalam tempoh dikira tepat masa.

starter.en: Company Manager or unit head

does.en: In “Senarai tugas” loads the template for a person with PIC, backup and checker (not the PIC), then adds or removes lines (removing needs a reason).
does.ms: Di “Senarai tugas” muatkan templat untuk seseorang dengan PIC, pengganti dan penyemak (bukan PIC), kemudian tambah atau buang baris (membuang perlu sebab).

does.en: Does the task when it opens (due on the last day of the window at 17:00) and marks it done with proof.
does.ms: Melaksanakan tugasan apabila dibuka (tamat pada hari terakhir tempoh jam 17:00) dan tanda siap dengan bukti.

who.en: The named checker or the line manager
who.ms: Penyemak yang dinamakan atau pengurus langsung

does.en: Accepts or returns each task.
does.ms: Menerima atau memulangkan setiap tugasan.

rules.en: “KPI senarai tugas” shows each person’s on-time share for the month.
rules.ms: “KPI senarai tugas” menunjukkan peratus tepat masa setiap orang bagi bulan itu.

statusNote.en: Real checklist lines are entered by each company or unit only after the real-data go-ahead.
statusNote.ms: Baris senarai tugas sebenar dimasukkan oleh syarikat atau unit hanya selepas kebenaran data sebenar.

source.decided: Fauzan, answers Y-Q1 to Y-Q10, 14 Nov 2026 (Y6, Y7)

sops.words: duty checklist senarai tugas daily harian monthly bulanan yearly tahunan pic backup kpi template templat

title.en: A meeting: agenda, pre-brief, minutes, actions
title.ms: Mesyuarat: agenda, taklimat awal, minit, tindakan

purpose.en: Every meeting has an agenda and a pre-briefing checklist ready 24 hours before; after it the minutes and action items are kept, and the Director Office confirms the summary.
purpose.ms: Setiap mesyuarat ada agenda dan senarai semak taklimat awal yang siap 24 jam sebelum; selepasnya minit dan item tindakan disimpan, dan Pejabat Pengarah mengesahkan ringkasan.

starter.en: Director Office, department heads, Company Managers (whoever may schedule)
starter.ms: Pejabat Pengarah, ketua jabatan, Pengurus Syarikat (yang boleh menjadualkan)

does.en: Sets the meeting (one time or repeating) with its agenda and invitees; a checklist for its kind is added.
does.ms: Menetapkan mesyuarat (sekali atau berulang) dengan agenda dan jemputan; senarai semak mengikut jenisnya ditambah.

does.en: Answer the invitation (yes, maybe, or no with a reason).
does.ms: Menjawab jemputan (ya, mungkin, atau tidak dengan sebab).

does.en: Ticks the pre-briefing checklist; after the meeting saves the minutes and adds action items with owners and dates.
does.ms: Menanda senarai semak taklimat awal; selepas mesyuarat simpan minit dan tambah item tindakan dengan pemilik dan tarikh.

does.en: Checks the summary (“Summary is right”).
does.ms: Menyemak ringkasan (“Summary is right”).

does.en: Mark their action items done.
does.ms: Menanda item tindakan mereka selesai.

rules.en: A meeting not ready 24 hours before is flagged.
rules.ms: Mesyuarat yang tidak siap 24 jam sebelum ditanda.

rules.en: Standing meetings: group management, department toolbox and company office every two weeks; the COO joins each company operations meeting every two months; company board once a year; a monthly general meeting.
rules.ms: Mesyuarat tetap: pengurusan kumpulan, toolbox jabatan dan pejabat syarikat setiap dua minggu; COO menyertai mesyuarat operasi setiap syarikat setiap dua bulan; lembaga syarikat sekali setahun; mesyuarat agung bulanan.

sops.words: meeting mesyuarat agenda minutes minit action item tindakan pre-brief taklimat calendar kalendar outlook

title.en: Company and department toolbox meeting (every 2 weeks)
title.ms: Mesyuarat toolbox syarikat dan jabatan (setiap 2 minggu)

purpose.en: The HQ status meeting of every company and department: Prima builds the status pack from the records, the preparer writes the minutes, a director (or the manager) verifies them.
purpose.ms: Mesyuarat status ibu pejabat setiap syarikat dan jabatan: Prima membina pek status daripada rekod, penyedia menulis minit, pengarah (atau pengurus) mengesahkannya.

starter.en: The company’s or department’s preparer (admin team)

does.en: Presses “Bina pek status”: each section is filled from the records and frozen; a missing record shows “tiada rekod”.
does.ms: Tekan “Bina pek status”: setiap bahagian diisi daripada rekod dan dibekukan; rekod yang tiada dipaparkan “tiada rekod”.

does.en: Updates the status lines (matter, status, owner, target), ticks each section changed or no change, pastes and checks any AI notes, then submits.
does.ms: Mengemas kini baris status (perkara, status, pemilik, sasaran), menanda setiap bahagian berubah atau tiada perubahan, menampal dan menyemak nota AI, kemudian menghantar.

who.en: Chairing director, else the Company Manager (only if no director attended), the department head or the visiting central director
who.ms: Pengarah yang mempengerusikan, jika tidak Pengurus Syarikat (hanya jika tiada pengarah hadir), ketua jabatan atau pengarah pusat yang melawat

does.en: Verifies with a comment, or returns with a reason. Never the preparer.
does.ms: Mengesahkan dengan ulasan, atau memulangkan dengan sebab. Bukan penyedia.

rules.en: The meeting counts as held only once its minutes are verified; verified minutes lock and a correction is a new version with a reason.
rules.ms: Mesyuarat dikira diadakan hanya selepas minit disahkan; minit yang disahkan dikunci dan pembetulan ialah versi baru dengan sebab.

rules.en: IC numbers are masked everywhere; bank accounts show the last 4 digits.
rules.ms: Nombor IC disembunyikan di semua tempat; akaun bank hanya menunjukkan 4 digit terakhir.

rules.en: The OM records site safety and operations talks; sites with none in 30 days show on the OM’s list.
rules.ms: OM merekod taklimat keselamatan dan operasi tapak; tapak tanpanya dalam 30 hari dipaparkan dalam senarai OM.

source.decided: Fauzan, answers X-Q1 to X-Q11, 14 Nov 2026 (rule TOOLBOX-AGENDA)

sops.words: toolbox mesyuarat toolbox status pack pek status minit minutes verify sahkan company department jabatan

title.en: Monthly JA Group meeting (Mesyuarat bulanan JA Group)

purpose.en: Unit HR sets the date with the CEO; each company and unit sends its verified monthly report 3 working days before; Unit HR writes the minutes and the Director Office or CEO verifies them.
purpose.ms: Unit HR menetapkan tarikh dengan CEO; setiap syarikat dan unit menghantar laporan bulanan yang disahkan 3 hari bekerja sebelum; Unit HR menulis minit dan Pejabat Pengarah atau CEO mengesahkannya.

starter.en: Unit HR

does.en: Sets the meeting date agreed with the CEO and records that the Outlook invites were sent and who takes the minutes.
does.ms: Menetapkan tarikh mesyuarat yang dipersetujui CEO dan merekod jemputan Outlook sudah dihantar dan siapa pencatat minit.

does.en: Prepares the 14-item monthly report from the last verified toolbox pack plus the monthly items, then sends it.
does.ms: Menyediakan laporan bulanan 14 perkara daripada pek toolbox terakhir yang disahkan serta perkara bulanan, kemudian menghantarnya.

who.en: Company Manager or a company director (unit head for a unit)
who.ms: Pengurus Syarikat atau pengarah syarikat (ketua unit bagi unit)

does.en: Verifies with a comment or returns with a reason; never the preparer.
does.ms: Mengesahkan dengan ulasan atau memulangkan dengan sebab; bukan penyedia.

who.en: Unit HR, then the Director Office or CEO
who.ms: Unit HR, kemudian Pejabat Pengarah atau CEO

does.en: Unit HR writes and submits the minutes (AI notes ticked as checked); the Director Office or CEO verifies them.
does.ms: Unit HR menulis dan menghantar minit (nota AI ditanda sudah disemak); Pejabat Pengarah atau CEO mengesahkannya.

rules.en: A report not verified 3 working days before the meeting is late and shows on Unit HR’s home; one still missing on the day is red to the Director Office.
rules.ms: Laporan yang belum disahkan 3 hari bekerja sebelum mesyuarat adalah lewat dan dipaparkan di laman utama Unit HR; yang masih tiada pada hari itu merah kepada Pejabat Pengarah.

rules.en: Each entity’s accounts report is due on the 28th of the next month; Internal Audit reviews it, never the sender.
rules.ms: Laporan akaun setiap entiti perlu dihantar sebelum 28 haribulan bulan berikutnya; Audit Dalaman menyemaknya, bukan penghantar.

rules.en: Prima sends no invites; catering stays outside Prima. Prima’s verified minutes are the record.
rules.ms: Prima tidak menghantar jemputan; katering di luar Prima. Minit Prima yang disahkan ialah rekod rasmi.

source.decided: Fauzan, answers Y-Q1 to Y-Q10, 14 Nov 2026 (rule GROUP-MONTHLY)

sops.words: mesyuarat bulanan monthly meeting ja group laporan bulanan report minutes minit unit hr accounts akaun

title.en: Sending a report to the Director Office

purpose.en: Each company and central department sends its weekly or monthly reports once, through the Director Office list; ACT reads the same submission.
purpose.ms: Setiap syarikat dan jabatan pusat menghantar laporan mingguan atau bulanan sekali sahaja, melalui senarai Pejabat Pengarah; ACT membaca penghantaran yang sama.

starter.en: Department head or company admin team
starter.ms: Ketua jabatan atau pasukan admin syarikat

does.en: Keeps the report list: who sends what, how often and when it is due (“Change the report list”).
does.ms: Menyelenggara senarai laporan: siapa menghantar apa, kekerapan dan tarikh akhir (“Change the report list”).

does.en: Under “To send” picks the period, attaches the file, ticks the sections covered and presses “Send report”.
does.ms: Di bawah “To send” pilih tempoh, lampirkan fail, tanda bahagian yang dilaporkan dan tekan “Send report”.

does.en: See who has sent on time, late or not at all; ACT checks it.
does.ms: Melihat siapa menghantar tepat masa, lewat atau tidak langsung; ACT menyemaknya.

rules.en: Monthly reports are due on the 25th of the next month.
rules.ms: Laporan bulanan perlu dihantar sebelum 25 haribulan bulan berikutnya.

rules.en: A report taken off the list keeps its history.
rules.ms: Laporan yang dibuang dari senarai mengekalkan sejarahnya.

statusNote.en: The starting list is a proposal; the Director Office Administrator changes it.
statusNote.ms: Senarai permulaan adalah cadangan; Pentadbir Pejabat Pengarah boleh mengubahnya.

sops.words: report laporan monthly bulanan weekly mingguan director office pejabat pengarah send hantar

title.en: Official memo

purpose.en: The Chief of Staff publishes memos to all staff and the COO to all guards and officers; readers tap “I have read this” and the publisher sees who has not.
purpose.ms: Ketua Staf menerbitkan memo kepada semua staf dan COO kepada semua pengawal dan pegawai; pembaca tekan “I have read this” dan penerbit melihat siapa yang belum.

starter.en: Chief of Staff (all staff), COO (all guards and officers), managers (own team)
starter.ms: Ketua Staf (semua staf), COO (semua pengawal dan pegawai), pengurus (pasukan sendiri)

does.en: Writes the memo, picks who it is for (optionally some states) and the read-by date, then publishes.
does.ms: Menulis memo, memilih siapa penerimanya (pilihan: negeri tertentu) dan tarikh perlu dibaca, kemudian menerbitkan.

does.en: Opens it and taps “I have read this” by the read-by date. Unread memos show on the reader’s home.
does.ms: Membukanya dan tekan “I have read this” sebelum tarikh perlu dibaca. Memo belum dibaca dipaparkan di laman utama pembaca.

does.en: Sees who has read it, reminds those who have not, or withdraws or replaces the memo with a reason.
does.ms: Melihat siapa sudah membaca, mengingatkan yang belum, atau menarik balik atau menggantikan memo dengan sebab.

rules.en: A memo cannot be edited after publishing.
rules.ms: Memo tidak boleh diubah selepas diterbitkan.

rules.en: Read within 3 days; the reader is reminded 3 days after publishing until read.
rules.ms: Baca dalam 3 hari; pembaca diingatkan 3 hari selepas diterbitkan sehingga dibaca.

source.decided: Fauzan, 26 Oct 2026; 3-day read-by approved 11 Nov 2026 (rule MEMO-READ)

sops.words: memo pekeliling circular notice notis read baca publish terbit chief of staff coo

title.en: Ask IT for help (help request)

purpose.en: Anyone tells IT what is wrong with their account, device, Microsoft 365, the network, Prima or a system; IT answers within the target for its urgency and the person who asked confirms the fix.
purpose.ms: Sesiapa sahaja memberitahu IT masalah akaun, peranti, Microsoft 365, rangkaian, Prima atau sistem; IT membalas dalam sasaran mengikut tahap kecemasan dan orang yang meminta mengesahkan masalah selesai.

starter.en: Any staff member. IT logs it for someone who reached IT by Teams, email, phone or in person.
starter.ms: Mana-mana staf. IT merekodkannya bagi orang yang menghubungi IT melalui Teams, e-mel, telefon atau secara bersemuka.

does.en: Chooses what it is about and the urgency (P1 to P4), says what is wrong and adds a screenshot if useful. If the same kind of problem was sent in the last 24 hours, Prima asks “Ini masalah yang sama?” so it can be added to the open request.
does.ms: Pilih perkara dan tahap kecemasan (P1 hingga P4), terangkan masalah dan lampirkan tangkapan skrin jika perlu. Jika masalah yang sama dihantar dalam 24 jam lepas, Prima bertanya “Ini masalah yang sama?” supaya ia boleh ditambah pada tiket yang masih terbuka.

does.en: Logs a request for a person who asked outside Prima (Log a request), with who asked and the channel.
does.ms: Merekod tiket bagi orang yang meminta di luar Prima (Log a request), dengan nama peminta dan saluran.

who.en: IT Manager or IT Lead (or the IT person who takes it)
who.ms: Pengurus IT atau Ketua IT (atau staf IT yang mengambilnya)

does.en: Gives the request to one IT person, or an IT person presses Take it. The first response is due within the target for its urgency.
does.ms: Memberikan tiket kepada seorang staf IT, atau staf IT menekan Take it. Respons pertama perlu dibuat dalam sasaran mengikut tahap kecemasan.

does.en: Fixes it and presses Resolve with what fixed it. For P1 and security requests the root cause is also required.
does.ms: Menyelesaikannya dan menekan Resolve dengan apa yang dibuat. Bagi tiket P1 dan keselamatan, punca utama juga wajib diisi.

does.en: Answers “Is it fixed?”: Yes, it is fixed closes it; Not fixed (with what is still wrong) sends it back to the same IT person.
does.ms: Menjawab “Is it fixed?”: Yes, it is fixed menutup tiket; Not fixed (dengan apa yang masih rosak) memulangkannya kepada staf IT yang sama.

does.en: Reminds the person on day 3 and day 5; after that the IT Manager sees it waiting for confirmation and chases. IT records a confirmation given outside Prima only with proof.
does.ms: Mengingatkan orang itu pada hari ke-3 dan ke-5; selepas itu Pengurus IT melihatnya “menunggu pengesahan” dan mengejar. IT merekod pengesahan yang diberi di luar Prima hanya dengan bukti.

rules.en: First-response targets: P1 15 minutes, P2 1 hour, P3 4 hours, P4 1 working day, in office hours (8.30 to 5.30, Monday to Friday, public holidays excluded). The time it was fixed is kept for information only.
rules.ms: Sasaran respons pertama: P1 15 minit, P2 1 jam, P3 4 jam, P4 1 hari bekerja, dalam waktu pejabat (8.30 hingga 5.30, Isnin hingga Jumaat, tidak termasuk cuti umum). Masa selesai disimpan sebagai maklumat sahaja.

rules.en: A security request starts at P1 or P2 and goes to the IT Lead; the IT Lead may lower it with a reason.
rules.ms: Tiket keselamatan bermula pada P1 atau P2 dan terus kepada Ketua IT (IT Lead); Ketua IT boleh menurunkannya dengan sebab.

rules.en: Only the person who asked closes the request. There is no automatic confirmation, and a Manager or Lead cannot confirm in their place.
rules.ms: Hanya orang yang meminta menutup tiket. Tiada pengesahan automatik, dan Pengurus atau Ketua IT tidak boleh mengesahkan bagi pihaknya.

rules.en: A request past its time limit by 24 hours goes to the COO. The IT Manager, COO and CEO see a monthly service report with numbers only, no staff ranking.
rules.ms: Tiket yang melebihi had masa sebanyak 24 jam dinaikkan kepada COO. Pengurus IT, COO dan CEO melihat laporan perkhidmatan bulanan dalam bentuk angka sahaja, tanpa ranking staf.

source.decided: Fauzan, 28 Oct 2026 (D1 to D5) and 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q1 to Q5, Q-X2); effective 18 Nov 2026

sops.words: help request tiket bantuan helpdesk ticket rosak problem masalah support sokongan p1 p2 p3 p4 confirm sahkan fixed

title.en: An IT job: given, done with proof, checked and accepted
title.ms: Tugasan IT: diberi, disiapkan dengan bukti, disemak dan diterima

purpose.en: Every piece of IT work has one named person and a due date, and is finished only when the IT Manager accepts its proof.
purpose.ms: Setiap kerja IT ada seorang penama dan tarikh siap, dan hanya selesai apabila Pengurus IT menerima buktinya.

starter.en: IT Manager or IT Lead (the CEO may also give jobs)
starter.ms: Pengurus IT atau Ketua IT (CEO juga boleh memberi tugasan)

does.en: Gives the job to one IT person with a due date and priority, from Jobs or from the week, month and year Plan.
does.ms: Memberi tugasan kepada seorang staf IT dengan tarikh siap dan keutamaan, dari Jobs atau dari Plan mingguan, bulanan dan tahunan.

does.en: Does the work and presses Submit as done with a note and proof.
does.ms: Membuat kerja itu dan menekan Submit as done dengan catatan dan bukti.

does.en: Checks a technical job first (Technical check passed). The IT Manager checks the proof of the IT Lead’s own technical jobs.
does.ms: Menyemak tugasan teknikal dahulu (Technical check passed). Pengurus IT menyemak bukti tugasan teknikal Ketua IT sendiri.

does.en: Accepts it, or returns it with a reason so the person does it again.
does.ms: Menerimanya, atau memulangkannya dengan sebab supaya staf itu membuatnya semula.

does.en: Accepts finished work while the IT Manager is away, and may accept or return any job at any time; whoever was in charge of checking it is told.
does.ms: Menerima kerja yang siap semasa Pengurus IT tiada, dan boleh menerima atau memulangkan mana-mana tugasan pada bila-bila masa; orang yang sepatutnya menyemak akan dimaklumkan.

rules.en: Nobody checks or accepts their own work.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa menyemak atau menerima kerja sendiri.

rules.en: A job 3 days late goes to the COO, and 7 days late to the CEO.
rules.ms: Tugasan lewat 3 hari dinaikkan kepada COO, dan lewat 7 hari kepada CEO.

rules.en: A job is finished only when submitted with proof and accepted; Submit alone is not the end.
rules.ms: Tugasan hanya selesai apabila dihantar dengan bukti dan diterima; Submit sahaja belum selesai.

source.decided: Fauzan, 28 Oct 2026 (D1 to D5), rule IT-JOBS

title.en: Buy IT equipment: from request to approval
title.ms: Membeli peralatan IT: dari permohonan hingga kelulusan

purpose.en: Any department asks for IT equipment; IT assesses it, gets quotes and the COO then the CEO approve the purchase.
purpose.ms: Mana-mana jabatan memohon peralatan IT; IT menilai, mendapatkan sebut harga, kemudian COO dan CEO meluluskan pembelian.

starter.en: Any staff member (Mohon peralatan IT); an IT Executive can also start one directly with Ask to buy.
starter.ms: Mana-mana staf (Mohon peralatan IT); Eksekutif IT juga boleh memulakannya terus dengan Ask to buy.

does.en: Asks for the equipment and says why it is needed.
does.ms: Memohon peralatan dan menyatakan sebab ia diperlukan.

does.en: Turns the request into an IT purchase (Jadikan pembelian IT), or declines it with a reason the person can see.
does.ms: Menjadikan permohonan itu pembelian IT (Jadikan pembelian IT), atau menolaknya dengan sebab yang boleh dilihat oleh pemohon.

does.en: Agrees the need, or rejects it with a reason (the COO decides when the IT Manager is the one asking).
does.ms: Bersetuju dengan keperluan, atau menolaknya dengan sebab (COO memutuskan jika Pengurus IT sendiri yang memohon).

does.en: Records the technical assessment (spare stock is shown; buying anyway needs a reason), then three supplier quotes and one evidenced online price, and recommends a supplier.
does.ms: Merekod penilaian teknikal (stok simpanan dipaparkan; tetap membeli perlu sebab), kemudian tiga sebut harga pembekal dan satu harga dalam talian berbukti, dan mencadangkan pembekal.

does.en: Records the budget check (a record, not an approval). A missing check is flagged.
does.ms: Merekod semakan bajet (rekod sahaja, bukan kelulusan). Semakan yang tiada akan ditanda.

does.en: Each approves or rejects with a reason. After the CEO the purchase goes to IT purchase fulfilment.
does.ms: Masing-masing meluluskan atau menolak dengan sebab. Selepas CEO, pembelian diteruskan ke IT purchase fulfilment.

rules.en: Three quotes from different suppliers plus one evidenced online comparison (rule IT-BUY). Expired quotes are flagged.
rules.ms: Tiga sebut harga daripada pembekal berbeza dan satu perbandingan dalam talian berbukti (peraturan IT-BUY). Sebut harga yang tamat tempoh ditanda.

rules.en: Stage time frames are late flags, never blocks: review 1, assessment 2, approvals with budget and PO 2 working days. The IT Manager may change them with a reason.
rules.ms: Tempoh setiap peringkat hanya tanda lewat, bukan sekatan: semakan 1, penilaian 2, kelulusan bersama bajet dan PO 2 hari bekerja. Pengurus IT boleh mengubahnya dengan sebab.

rules.en: Paying before delivery (when the chosen supplier requires it) is approved with the purchase and flagged when not delivered after the quoted lead time.
rules.ms: Bayaran sebelum penghantaran (jika pembekal yang dipilih memerlukannya) diluluskan bersama pembelian dan ditanda jika belum dihantar selepas tempoh yang disebut.

rules.en: Purchase documents are kept at least 5 years. An IT equipment claim with no approved IT PO cannot be approved.
rules.ms: Dokumen pembelian disimpan sekurang-kurangnya 5 tahun. Tuntutan peralatan IT tanpa PO IT yang diluluskan tidak boleh diluluskan.

source.decided: Fauzan, 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q6 to Q9, Q13, Q14, Q-X3, Q-X4b) and Part V V-X6
