title.en: IT purchase fulfilment: PO, delivery, invoice and payment
title.ms: Pelaksanaan pembelian IT: PO, penghantaran, invois dan bayaran

purpose.en: After the CEO approves, Finance issues the PO, IT receives and inspects what actually arrived, Finance matches the invoice and records the payment reference.
purpose.ms: Selepas CEO meluluskan, Kewangan mengeluarkan PO, IT menerima dan memeriksa barang yang benar-benar sampai, Kewangan memadankan invois dan merekod rujukan bayaran.

starter.en: The Finance team chosen to handle Merdeka IT purchases
starter.ms: Pasukan Kewangan yang dipilih untuk mengurus pembelian IT Merdeka

does.en: Checks the exact approved supplier, quantities and prices and records the PO with its actual issue date and evidence.
does.ms: Menyemak pembekal, kuantiti dan harga yang diluluskan dan merekod PO dengan tarikh keluaran sebenar dan bukti.

does.en: Records each actual delivery and where the stock is. A part delivery stays “partially received”.
does.ms: Merekod setiap penghantaran sebenar dan lokasi stok. Penghantaran separa kekal “partially received”.

does.en: Receives and inspects (GRN): packaging, specification, damage, function test, accessories. A “no” is a mismatch; failed units stay in quarantine until released with a reason.
does.ms: Menerima dan memeriksa (GRN): pembungkusan, spesifikasi, kerosakan, ujian fungsi, aksesori. Jawapan “tidak” ialah ketidakpadanan; unit yang gagal kekal dalam kuarantin sehingga dilepaskan dengan sebab.

does.en: Checks the supplier invoice against what was ordered and received. A mismatch is kept; a later delivery does not turn an old check into a match.
does.ms: Menyemak invois pembekal dengan apa yang dipesan dan diterima. Ketidakpadanan disimpan; penghantaran kemudian tidak menukar semakan lama menjadi padan.

does.en: Records the payment reference for the unpaid balance, only after full receipt and the latest exact match. The bank payment itself is made outside Prima.
does.ms: Merekod rujukan bayaran bagi baki belum dibayar, hanya selepas barang diterima penuh dan semakan terkini padan. Bayaran bank dibuat di luar Prima.

does.en: Records the register details of each new device (label, serial, purchase details, custodian, location) before handing it over.
does.ms: Merekod butiran daftar setiap peranti baharu (label, nombor siri, butiran pembelian, penjaga, lokasi) sebelum diserahkan.

label.en: IT › IT policies › Butiran daftar aset
label.ms: IT › Polisi IT › Butiran daftar aset

rules.en: For Merdeka purchases only. Without the Finance team mapping the screen shows setup required.
rules.ms: Untuk pembelian Merdeka sahaja. Tanpa pemetaan pasukan Kewangan, skrin menunjukkan setup required.

rules.en: Prima records evidence only: no bank transfer, supplier email or payment is made from Prima.
rules.ms: Prima merekod bukti sahaja: tiada pindahan bank, e-mel pembekal atau bayaran dibuat dari Prima.

rules.en: Old paid or received records stay read-only as “legacy unverified”; no PO, invoice or payment evidence is made up for them.
rules.ms: Rekod lama yang sudah dibayar atau diterima kekal baca sahaja sebagai “legacy unverified”; tiada bukti PO, invois atau bayaran direka untuknya.

rules.en: Receive and inspect by the next working day after delivery; register and label within 1 working day each (late flags).
rules.ms: Terima dan periksa pada hari bekerja berikutnya selepas penghantaran; daftar dan label dalam 1 hari bekerja setiap satu (tanda lewat).

source.decided: Fauzan, 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q10, Q11) and Part V V-X6

title.en: Advance payment to a supplier (exception)

purpose.en: When a supplier must be paid before the goods arrive, a separate advance request is decided again by the COO and the CEO.
purpose.ms: Jika pembekal perlu dibayar sebelum barang sampai, permohonan pendahuluan yang berasingan diputuskan semula oleh COO dan CEO.

starter.en: IT, or the Finance team chosen for IT purchases
starter.ms: IT, atau pasukan Kewangan yang dipilih untuk pembelian IT

does.en: Records the exact supplier, PO revision, amount, reason and terms.
does.ms: Merekod pembekal, semakan PO, jumlah, sebab dan terma yang tepat.

does.en: Each gives a fresh decision on this exact advance. The earlier purchase approval does not count.
does.ms: Masing-masing memberi keputusan baharu bagi pendahuluan ini. Kelulusan pembelian sebelum ini tidak dikira.

does.en: Records the exact approved amount once. The goods receipt and invoice check are still due afterwards.
does.ms: Merekod jumlah yang diluluskan sekali sahaja. Penerimaan barang dan semakan invois masih perlu dibuat selepas itu.

rules.en: Only one unresolved advance per purchase at a time.
rules.ms: Hanya satu pendahuluan yang belum selesai bagi setiap pembelian pada satu masa.

rules.en: No payment is made from Prima, and no supplier is contacted automatically.
rules.ms: Tiada bayaran dibuat dari Prima, dan tiada pembekal dihubungi secara automatik.

sops.words: advance pendahuluan deposit bayaran dahulu pay first supplier pembekal

title.en: Register a device and hand it to a person
title.ms: Daftar peranti dan serahkan kepada seseorang

purpose.en: Every IT device is on the register with its details before it is given to anyone; the person then sees it under their IT devices.
purpose.ms: Setiap peranti IT didaftarkan dengan butirannya sebelum diserahkan kepada sesiapa; orang itu kemudian melihatnya di bawah peranti IT mereka.

starter.en: IT Manager, IT Lead or IT staff
starter.ms: Pengurus IT, Ketua IT atau staf IT

does.en: Registers a device that is already in use or in stock, with a unique tag or serial. An unknown purchase date stays unknown and the device starts unassigned. A list can also be imported from a file.
does.ms: Mendaftar peranti yang sudah digunakan atau dalam stok, dengan tag atau nombor siri yang unik. Tarikh pembelian yang tidak diketahui kekal tidak diketahui dan peranti bermula tanpa pemegang. Senarai juga boleh diimport daripada fail.

does.en: Records the register details: item-register label, serial, purchase details (or “maklumat pembelian tiada”), custodian and location.
does.ms: Merekod butiran daftar: label daftar barang, nombor siri, butiran pembelian (atau “maklumat pembelian tiada”), penjaga dan lokasi.

label.en: IT › IT policies › Butiran daftar aset
label.ms: IT › Polisi IT › Butiran daftar aset

does.en: Opens the device and presses Assign with who has it. Prima refuses the handover while register details are missing.
does.ms: Membuka peranti dan menekan Assign dengan nama pemegang. Prima menolak penyerahan selagi butiran daftar belum lengkap.

does.en: Sees the device under “Peranti IT saya” and reports there if it is lost, stolen or damaged.
does.ms: Melihat peranti di bawah “Peranti IT saya” dan melaporkan di situ jika hilang, dicuri atau rosak.

label.en: Ask for equipment › Peranti IT saya

rules.en: Registering a device does not create a purchase, price, rental charge or ownership.
rules.ms: Mendaftar peranti tidak mewujudkan pembelian, harga, caj sewaan atau pemilikan.

rules.en: A device given to another person needs a checked data wipe first.
rules.ms: Peranti yang diserahkan kepada orang lain perlu pemadaman data yang telah disemak terlebih dahulu.

source.decided: Fauzan, 1 Nov 2026 (IT staff register existing stock) and 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q11, Q17)

sops.words: asset aset device peranti laptop register daftar assign serah handover tag serial

title.en: A device is lost, stolen or damaged

purpose.en: The holder reports it from their own devices list; this opens a help request linked to the device and IT updates the register.
purpose.ms: Pemegang melaporkannya dari senarai peranti sendiri; ini membuka tiket bantuan yang dipautkan kepada peranti dan IT mengemas kini daftar.

starter.en: The staff member holding the device

does.en: Under “Peranti IT saya” presses Lapor hilang / dicuri / rosak, chooses what happened and says where and when. For a theft the police report number and photo are optional.
does.ms: Di bawah “Peranti IT saya” tekan Lapor hilang / dicuri / rosak, pilih apa yang berlaku dan nyatakan di mana dan bila. Bagi kecurian, nombor dan gambar laporan polis adalah pilihan.

label.en: Ask for equipment › Peranti IT saya

does.en: Handles the help request it opened (a lost or stolen device is P2).
does.ms: Mengurus tiket bantuan yang dibuka (peranti hilang atau dicuri ialah P2).

does.en: Updates the device on the register (lost, stolen, in repair).
does.ms: Mengemas kini status peranti dalam daftar (hilang, dicuri, dalam pembaikan).

rules.en: The police report is optional, with no deadline and no flag.
rules.ms: Laporan polis adalah pilihan, tanpa tarikh akhir dan tanpa tanda.

source.decided: Fauzan, 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q12 and the Q-X answer on police reports)

title.en: Six-month health inspection of IT assets
title.ms: Pemeriksaan kesihatan aset IT setiap enam bulan

purpose.en: Every active IT asset has its health and condition inspected every six calendar months, recorded on an assigned IT job and checked through the normal job workflow.
purpose.ms: Setiap aset IT yang aktif diperiksa kesihatan dan keadaannya setiap enam bulan kalendar, direkod pada tugasan IT yang diberi dan disemak melalui aliran tugasan biasa.

starter.en: The IT person assigned the inspection job
starter.ms: Staf IT yang diberi tugasan pemeriksaan

does.en: Sees what is due (or needs an initial check) and gives inspection jobs from the Plan.
does.ms: Melihat apa yang perlu diperiksa (atau perlu semakan awal) dan memberi tugasan pemeriksaan dari Plan.

does.en: Chooses the asset and their own open inspection job, and records the date, condition, findings, evidence and any follow-up.
does.ms: Memilih aset dan tugasan pemeriksaan sendiri yang masih terbuka, dan merekod tarikh, keadaan, penemuan, bukti dan tindakan susulan.

does.en: Submits the linked job with proof.
does.ms: Menghantar tugasan berkaitan dengan bukti.

does.en: Check and accept the job, or return it.
does.ms: Menyemak dan menerima tugasan, atau memulangkannya.

rules.en: Six calendar months, never 180 days (31 Aug is next due at the end of February).
rules.ms: Enam bulan kalendar, bukan 180 hari (31 Ogos perlu diperiksa semula pada hujung Februari).

rules.en: Unknown history means an initial check is needed, not healthy. Service and repair do not count as an inspection. A disposed asset gets no new inspection.
rules.ms: Sejarah yang tidak diketahui bermaksud perlu semakan awal, bukan sihat. Servis dan pembaikan tidak dikira sebagai pemeriksaan. Aset yang telah dilupuskan tidak diperiksa lagi.

rules.en: An accepted job is not a separate health certificate.
rules.ms: Tugasan yang diterima bukan sijil kesihatan yang berasingan.

sops.words: inspection pemeriksaan health kesihatan condition keadaan six months enam bulan maintenance penyelenggaraan

title.en: Device rental to a company: agreement, rates and monthly bill
title.ms: Sewaan peranti kepada syarikat: perjanjian, kadar dan bil bulanan

purpose.en: Merdeka rents IT devices to group companies under a signed agreement; the IT Manager sets actual rates and IT prepares each month’s bill from the devices chosen.
purpose.ms: Merdeka menyewakan peranti IT kepada syarikat kumpulan di bawah perjanjian bertandatangan; Pengurus IT menetapkan kadar sebenar dan IT menyediakan bil bulanan daripada peranti yang dipilih.

starter.en: IT Manager

does.en: Records the rental agreement for the company (Perjanjian sewaan baharu), prints it to be signed outside Prima, then records the signed copy link.
does.ms: Merekod perjanjian sewaan bagi syarikat (Perjanjian sewaan baharu), mencetaknya untuk ditandatangani di luar Prima, kemudian merekod pautan salinan bertandatangan.

does.en: Sets a new rate version: the actual monthly amount in RM, effective from the first of a month, with evidence.
does.ms: Menetapkan versi kadar baharu: jumlah bulanan sebenar dalam RM, berkuat kuasa dari hari pertama bulan, dengan bukti.

does.en: Chooses the billing month and the company’s linked devices in use, reviews the exact snapshot and records the bill.
does.ms: Memilih bulan bil dan peranti syarikat yang sedang digunakan, menyemak salinan tepat dan merekod bil.

does.en: Records the payment reference when the company pays. Only Finance records payments; IT never marks a bill paid.
does.ms: Merekod rujukan bayaran apabila syarikat membayar. Hanya Kewangan merekod bayaran; IT tidak sekali-kali menandakan bil sebagai dibayar.

does.en: When a device comes back (Peranti dipulangkan), checks the accessories and records the condition.
does.ms: Apabila peranti dipulangkan (Peranti dipulangkan), menyemak aksesori dan merekod keadaannya.

rules.en: No rate, bill or payment is made up: an empty rate stays unconfigured and zero must be entered on purpose.
rules.ms: Tiada kadar, bil atau bayaran direka: kadar kosong kekal belum ditetapkan dan sifar mesti dimasukkan dengan sengaja.

rules.en: One bill per company per month; a later rate change never rewrites an issued bill. Recording a bill never marks it paid.
rules.ms: Satu bil bagi setiap syarikat setiap bulan; perubahan kadar kemudian tidak mengubah bil yang telah dikeluarkan. Merekod bil tidak menandakannya sebagai dibayar.

rules.en: Unlinked stock is not billed. A company using Merdeka devices with no signed agreement is shown as a warning.
rules.ms: Stok yang tidak dipautkan tidak dibil. Syarikat yang menggunakan peranti Merdeka tanpa perjanjian bertandatangan dipaparkan sebagai amaran.

sops.words: rental sewaan sewa rate kadar bill bil invoice invois agreement perjanjian company syarikat device peranti

title.en: Correct an unpaid rental bill (replacement)
title.ms: Membetulkan bil sewaan yang belum dibayar (gantian)

purpose.en: When an unpaid rental bill is wrong, IT prepares a replacement, an independent IT Manager checks the facts and the Finance Director approves issuing it.
purpose.ms: Jika bil sewaan yang belum dibayar salah, IT menyediakan gantian, Pengurus IT yang bebas menyemak fakta dan Pengarah Kewangan meluluskan pengeluarannya.

starter.en: IT staff

does.en: Prepares the replacement bill with the correct devices and rate.
does.ms: Menyediakan bil gantian dengan peranti dan kadar yang betul.

does.en: Checks the device and rate facts, or returns it with a reason.
does.ms: Menyemak fakta peranti dan kadar, atau memulangkannya dengan sebab.

does.en: Approves issuing the replacement while the Manager’s check is still current and nothing has changed.
does.ms: Meluluskan pengeluaran gantian selagi semakan Pengurus masih terkini dan tiada perubahan.

does.en: Records the payment reference against the replacement bill.
does.ms: Merekod rujukan bayaran pada bil gantian.

rules.en: The original bill is never overwritten or deleted; its history stays.
rules.ms: Bil asal tidak sekali-kali ditulis ganti atau dipadam; sejarahnya kekal.

rules.en: Paid bills, old (legacy) bills and a replacement of a replacement cannot be corrected here.
rules.ms: Bil yang sudah dibayar, bil lama (legacy) dan gantian kepada gantian tidak boleh dibetulkan di sini.

rules.en: The IT Manager cannot check a request they prepared.
rules.ms: Pengurus IT tidak boleh menyemak permohonan yang disediakannya sendiri.

sops.words: rental sewaan bill bil correction pembetulan replacement gantian wrong salah

title.en: Dispose of an IT device (with data wipe)

purpose.en: A device beyond repair or at end of life is inspected, approved by three different people, wiped and disposed of with a certificate.
purpose.ms: Peranti yang tidak boleh dibaiki atau sampai akhir hayat diperiksa, diluluskan oleh tiga orang berbeza, dipadam datanya dan dilupuskan dengan sijil.

starter.en: IT staff

does.en: Asks for the disposal with the reason and the condition found.
does.ms: Memohon pelupusan dengan sebab dan keadaan yang ditemui.

does.en: Records the inspection with photos. A repairable device stays active.
does.ms: Merekod pemeriksaan dengan gambar. Peranti yang boleh dibaiki kekal aktif.

who.en: IT Manager, then the head of the company or department using it (CoS or DCoS for a central device), then the COO as HQ
who.ms: Pengurus IT, kemudian ketua syarikat atau jabatan pengguna (CoS atau DCoS bagi peranti pusat), kemudian COO sebagai HQ

does.en: Each approves or rejects with a reason.
does.ms: Masing-masing meluluskan atau menolak dengan sebab.

does.en: The user ticks that their business data was backed up; IT logs the data wipe (method, disk serial, wipe report or photo).
does.ms: Pengguna menanda bahawa data perniagaan telah disandarkan; IT merekod pemadaman data (kaedah, nombor siri cakera, laporan atau gambar).

label.en: IT › IT policies › Log pemadaman data
label.ms: IT › Polisi IT › Log pemadaman data

who.en: A different IT person (the IT Manager when the Lead did the wipe)
who.ms: Staf IT lain (Pengurus IT jika Ketua IT yang memadam)

does.en: Checks the wipe.
does.ms: Menyemak pemadaman data.

does.en: Records the disposal as done: method, vendor, certificate number and photos. Finance records the write-off.
does.ms: Merekod pelupusan sebagai selesai: kaedah, vendor, nombor sijil dan gambar. Kewangan merekod hapus kira.

rules.en: Three different people approve, never whoever asked or inspected.
rules.ms: Tiga orang berbeza meluluskan, tidak sekali-kali orang yang memohon atau memeriksa.

rules.en: Done only with the certificate, photos and a checked wipe. Targets: inspection 3, approvals 2, wipe and certificate 2, the whole 7 working days to ready for the contractor.
rules.ms: Selesai hanya dengan sijil, gambar dan pemadaman yang telah disemak. Sasaran: pemeriksaan 3, kelulusan 2, pemadaman dan sijil 2, keseluruhan 7 hari bekerja sehingga sedia untuk kontraktor.

rules.en: The PDPA officer reads the wipe log only. Disposal records are kept at least 5 years.
rules.ms: Pegawai PDPA hanya membaca log pemadaman data. Rekod pelupusan disimpan sekurang-kurangnya 5 tahun.

source.decided: Fauzan, 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q16, Q17, Q-X5; "3., yes" for central devices) and Part V V-X6

sops.words: disposal pelupusan lupus dispose wipe padam data e-waste sijil certificate write-off hapus kira

title.en: Regular device work: maintenance, refurbishment and end of life
title.ms: Kerja berkala peranti: penyelenggaraan, baik pulih dan akhir hayat

purpose.en: Prima lists the devices due for maintenance, refurbishment or an end-of-life review, and IT records each one.
purpose.ms: Prima menyenaraikan peranti yang perlu diselenggara, dibaik pulih atau dinilai akhir hayat, dan IT merekod setiap satu.

starter.en: IT staff

does.en: Opens the list of regular work that is due.
does.ms: Membuka senarai kerja berkala yang perlu dibuat.

label.en: IT › IT policies › Kerja berkala aset
label.ms: IT › Polisi IT › Kerja berkala aset

does.en: For a refurbishment, ticks the checklist (hardware, battery, disk, operating system, accounts removed, data wiped, function test).
does.ms: Bagi baik pulih, menanda senarai semak (perkakasan, bateri, cakera, sistem pengendalian, akaun dibuang, data dipadam, ujian fungsi).

does.en: For an end-of-life review, records the outcome: keep, refurbish, reassign or retire with a reason. A retired device then follows the disposal flow.
does.ms: Bagi penilaian akhir hayat, merekod keputusan: kekal, baik pulih, agih semula atau bersara dengan sebab. Peranti yang bersara kemudian mengikut aliran pelupusan.

label.en: IT › IT policies › Penilaian akhir hayat
label.ms: IT › Polisi IT › Penilaian akhir hayat

rules.en: Refurbishment every 36 months, end-of-life review at 48 months (phones and tablets 36), maintenance every 6 months.
rules.ms: Baik pulih setiap 36 bulan, penilaian akhir hayat pada 48 bulan (telefon dan tablet 36), penyelenggaraan setiap 6 bulan.

sops.words: refurbish baik pulih end of life akhir hayat maintenance penyelenggaraan servis service

title.en: Ask for a Microsoft 365 account

purpose.en: A new Microsoft 365 account is supported by the line manager, verified by IT and approved by the CoS or DCoS, then put on the account register.
purpose.ms: Akaun Microsoft 365 baharu disokong oleh pengurus barisan, disahkan oleh IT dan diluluskan oleh CoS atau DCoS, kemudian dimasukkan ke dalam daftar akaun.

starter.en: Any staff member, for themselves or their team
starter.ms: Mana-mana staf, untuk diri sendiri atau pasukan

does.en: Asks with the job title, the email address wanted, the reason, the apps needed and the access level.
does.ms: Memohon dengan jawatan, alamat e-mel yang dikehendaki, sebab, aplikasi yang diperlukan dan tahap akses.

does.en: Supports it or not, with a reason.
does.ms: Menyokong atau tidak, dengan sebab.

does.en: Verifies: existing user, duplicate account, licence available, correct domain.
does.ms: Mengesahkan: pengguna sedia ada, akaun berganda, lesen tersedia, domain betul.

does.en: Approves or rejects with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan sebab.

does.en: Creates the account in Microsoft 365 (outside Prima), then adds it to the account register (Akaun M365) with its owner, licence and MFA.
does.ms: Mencipta akaun dalam Microsoft 365 (di luar Prima), kemudian menambahnya ke daftar akaun (Akaun M365) dengan pemilik, lesen dan MFA.

rules.en: Every account has an owner; a guest account needs an expiry date; a joiner’s account step needs MFA “yes”.
rules.ms: Setiap akaun ada pemilik; akaun tetamu perlu tarikh tamat; langkah akaun bagi staf baharu perlu MFA “ya”.

rules.en: Ready within 2 working days of the CoS approval (a late flag, never a block). The quarterly review shows problems first.
rules.ms: Siap dalam 2 hari bekerja selepas kelulusan CoS (tanda lewat, bukan sekatan). Semakan suku tahunan memaparkan masalah dahulu.

rules.en: A joiner already reviewed in the HR / IT coordination is not asked twice. Admin access stays with the CEO.
rules.ms: Staf baharu yang sudah disemak dalam koordinasi HR / IT tidak ditanya dua kali. Akses pentadbir kekal dengan CEO.

source.decided: Fauzan, 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q20, Q21) and Part V V9

title.en: Ask for a new domain

purpose.en: A new domain is approved by the CEO, bought in the company’s name from an approved registrar and becomes active only with the Microsoft 365 verification proof.
purpose.ms: Domain baharu diluluskan oleh CEO, dibeli atas nama syarikat daripada pendaftar yang diluluskan dan hanya aktif dengan bukti pengesahan Microsoft 365.

starter.en: Any staff member

does.en: Proposes the domain with its purpose, business justification and expected users.
does.ms: Mencadangkan domain dengan tujuan, justifikasi perniagaan dan jangkaan bilangan pengguna.

does.en: Approves or rejects with a reason.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak dengan sebab.

does.en: Records the purchase: registrar from the approved list, registrant (the company), auto-renew, registrar lock, 2FA, DNS.
does.ms: Merekod pembelian: pendaftar daripada senarai diluluskan, pendaftar nama (syarikat), pembaharuan automatik, kunci pendaftar, 2FA, DNS.

does.en: Activates it with the Microsoft 365 domain verification screenshot, then adds it to the IP register.
does.ms: Mengaktifkannya dengan tangkapan skrin pengesahan domain Microsoft 365, kemudian menambahnya ke daftar harta intelek.

rules.en: A registrant that looks like a person is flagged. Unknown registrar lock or 2FA shows amber, never green.
rules.ms: Pendaftar nama yang kelihatan seperti individu akan ditanda. Kunci pendaftar atau 2FA yang tidak diketahui dipaparkan kuning, bukan hijau.

rules.en: A new active domain with no IP register row shows late after 3 working days (a flag, never a block).
rules.ms: Domain aktif baharu tanpa baris daftar harta intelek ditanda lewat selepas 3 hari bekerja (tanda sahaja, bukan sekatan).

source.decided: Fauzan, 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q22) and Part V V9

title.en: A new company website or a big change
title.ms: Laman web syarikat baharu atau perubahan besar

purpose.en: The company head asks; IT scopes and costs it; the CEO approves; the content owner confirms and tests; the content approver approves publishing.
purpose.ms: Ketua syarikat memohon; IT menetapkan skop dan kos; CEO meluluskan; pemilik kandungan mengesahkan dan menguji; pelulus kandungan meluluskan penerbitan.

starter.en: The head of the company

does.en: Asks, naming a content owner and a different content approver, with the logo, profile and photos.
does.ms: Memohon dengan menamakan pemilik kandungan dan pelulus kandungan yang berbeza, bersama logo, profil dan gambar.

does.en: Checks it within 1 working day, then gives the scope, estimated cost and build days.
does.ms: Menyemaknya dalam 1 hari bekerja, kemudian memberi skop, anggaran kos dan tempoh pembinaan.

does.en: Approves the cost and scope, never their own request.
does.ms: Meluluskan kos dan skop, tidak sekali-kali permohonan sendiri.

does.en: The content owner confirms the design and content; IT records the build, preview address and internal test.
does.ms: Pemilik kandungan mengesahkan reka bentuk dan kandungan; IT merekod pembinaan, alamat pratonton dan ujian dalaman.

does.en: Tests it before publishing (UAT).
does.ms: Menguji sebelum terbit (UAT).

does.en: Approves publishing with HTTPS on and the live address.
does.ms: Meluluskan penerbitan dengan HTTPS dihidupkan dan alamat langsung.

rules.en: The content owner and the content approver are different people.
rules.ms: Pemilik kandungan dan pelulus kandungan adalah orang yang berbeza.

rules.en: The IP register is updated within 3 working days of a website change.
rules.ms: Daftar harta intelek dikemas kini dalam 3 hari bekerja selepas perubahan laman web.

sops.words: website laman web new baharu publish terbit uat content kandungan

title.en: A website, social media or company email issue
title.ms: Isu laman web, media sosial atau e-mel syarikat

purpose.en: An urgent website, social account or email problem is reported, fixed by the IT person the IT Manager names, and confirmed by the person who asked.
purpose.ms: Masalah segera pada laman web, akaun media sosial atau e-mel dilaporkan, diselesaikan oleh staf IT yang dinamakan Pengurus IT, dan disahkan oleh orang yang melapor.

starter.en: Anyone who works on the company’s websites: IT, the head of company, the content owner or approver, group management
starter.ms: Sesiapa yang menguruskan laman web syarikat: IT, ketua syarikat, pemilik atau pelulus kandungan, pengurusan kumpulan

does.en: Reports the issue with the site or account and what is wrong.
does.ms: Melaporkan isu dengan laman atau akaun dan apa masalahnya.

does.en: Gives it to one active IT person.
does.ms: Memberikannya kepada seorang staf IT yang aktif.

does.en: Fixes it and resolves it with evidence.
does.ms: Menyelesaikannya dan merekod penyelesaian dengan bukti.

who.en: The requester (outside IT); for IT’s own issues the IT Manager, or the IT Lead when the Manager fixed it
who.ms: Pemohon (di luar IT); bagi isu IT sendiri Pengurus IT, atau Ketua IT jika Pengurus yang menyelesaikannya

does.en: Confirms it is fixed or returns it, with a comment of 3 to 500 characters.
does.ms: Mengesahkan ia selesai atau memulangkannya, dengan ulasan 3 hingga 500 aksara.

rules.en: Nobody confirms or returns their own fix.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa mengesahkan atau memulangkan penyelesaian sendiri.

rules.en: Reopening needs a reason; it clears the current acceptance but keeps the history.
rules.ms: Membuka semula perlu sebab; ia membatalkan penerimaan semasa tetapi sejarah dikekalkan.

rules.en: Website notices stay inside Prima: no email or Teams message is sent. An active social account with no post for 180 days (known date) notifies the company manager.
rules.ms: Notis laman web kekal dalam Prima: tiada e-mel atau mesej Teams dihantar. Akaun sosial aktif tanpa hantaran selama 180 hari (tarikh diketahui) memaklumkan pengurus syarikat.

source.decided: Owner confirmed: IT resolves, the requester confirms

title.en: Intellectual property register

purpose.en: IT keeps each company’s logos, profiles, templates, domains, source code and other digital assets on a register; only the CEO approves taking one out of use.
purpose.ms: IT menyimpan logo, profil, templat, domain, kod sumber dan aset digital lain setiap syarikat dalam daftar; hanya CEO meluluskan untuk menamatkan penggunaannya.

starter.en: IT staff

does.en: Records the asset: type, owner company, custodian, provider, dates, SharePoint link and where access is kept (never the password).
does.ms: Merekod aset: jenis, syarikat pemilik, penjaga, pembekal, tarikh, pautan SharePoint dan tempat akses disimpan (bukan kata laluan).

does.en: Asks to decommission an asset, with a reason.
does.ms: Memohon untuk menamatkan aset, dengan sebab.

does.en: Approves the decommission.
does.ms: Meluluskan penamatan.

rules.en: Trademark and copyright filings stay with the Company Secretary / Legal, outside this register.
rules.ms: Pemfailan cap dagangan dan hak cipta kekal dengan Setiausaha Syarikat / Undang-undang, di luar daftar ini.

rules.en: Updated within 3 working days of a website, domain or system change.
rules.ms: Dikemas kini dalam 3 hari bekerja selepas perubahan laman web, domain atau sistem.

source.decided: Fauzan, 13-14 Nov 2026 (Q23) and Part V V9

title.en: IT steps when staff join or leave
title.ms: Langkah IT apabila staf masuk atau keluar

purpose.en: A checklist of IT work for each joiner and leaver, given to one IT person and ticked with evidence.
purpose.ms: Senarai semak kerja IT bagi setiap staf yang masuk dan keluar, diberikan kepada seorang staf IT dan ditanda dengan bukti.

starter.en: IT staff (with HR)

does.en: Records the joiner or leaver against their staff record (or as an unlinked person, labelled so), with the date and job title.
does.ms: Merekod staf yang masuk atau keluar pada rekod staf mereka (atau sebagai orang yang belum dipautkan, dilabel begitu), dengan tarikh dan jawatan.

does.en: Gives the checklist an owner.
does.ms: Menetapkan pemilik bagi senarai semak.

does.en: Ticks each step with evidence. For a joiner, the Microsoft 365 step needs the account on the register with MFA “yes”.
does.ms: Menanda setiap langkah dengan bukti. Bagi staf baharu, langkah Microsoft 365 memerlukan akaun dalam daftar dengan MFA “ya”.

does.en: Closes a leaver’s Prima access in HR’s own leaving steps; urgent closure is never held up by this checklist.
does.ms: Menutup akses Prima staf yang keluar dalam langkah keluar HR sendiri; penutupan segera tidak sekali-kali ditangguhkan oleh senarai semak ini.

rules.en: Ticking a step records what staff reported. It does not create or remove an account and is not a certificate.
rules.ms: Menanda langkah hanya merekod apa yang dilaporkan staf. Ia tidak mencipta atau membuang akaun dan bukan sijil.

rules.en: Never enter passwords, tokens or recovery codes.
rules.ms: Jangan sekali-kali masukkan kata laluan, token atau kod pemulihan.

sops.words: joiner leaver onboarding offboarding staf baharu masuk keluar berhenti checklist senarai semak

title.en: HR / IT coordination for a joiner’s or leaver’s sign-in
title.ms: Koordinasi HR / IT bagi log masuk staf yang masuk atau keluar

purpose.en: HR proposes a person’s role and one company; the CoS and the Company Head approve the same version; the HR Administrator reviews the handoff. Nothing is applied in Microsoft or Prima.
purpose.ms: HR mencadangkan peranan dan satu syarikat bagi seseorang; CoS dan Ketua Syarikat meluluskan versi yang sama; Pentadbir HR menyemak serahan. Tiada apa yang dilaksanakan dalam Microsoft atau Prima.

starter.en: HR, for its own companies

does.en: Picks the existing staff record, one company, the ordinary role, the effective date and the reason.
does.ms: Memilih rekod staf sedia ada, satu syarikat, peranan biasa, tarikh berkuat kuasa dan sebab.

who.en: IT Lead (or an IT Executive with an IT Manager-approved delegation)
who.ms: Ketua IT (atau Eksekutif IT dengan delegasi yang diluluskan Pengurus IT)

does.en: Adds the Microsoft sign-in details, marked unverified. A delegation is for one task and lasts at most 7 days.
does.ms: Menambah butiran log masuk Microsoft, ditanda belum disahkan. Delegasi adalah untuk satu tugas dan paling lama 7 hari.

who.en: CoS and the Company Head (two different people)
who.ms: CoS dan Ketua Syarikat (dua orang berbeza)

does.en: Each reviews the same exact version.
does.ms: Masing-masing menyemak versi yang sama.

does.en: Reviews the handoff after both approvals. The request then waits for directory verification.
does.ms: Menyemak serahan selepas kedua-dua kelulusan. Permohonan kemudian menunggu pengesahan direktori.

rules.en: The person concerned and the author cannot approve. Any change after an approval cancels the earlier approvals.
rules.ms: Orang yang terlibat dan penyedia tidak boleh meluluskan. Sebarang perubahan selepas kelulusan membatalkan kelulusan sebelumnya.

rules.en: No account is linked, created or removed here. A leaver’s urgent access closure follows its own procedure.
rules.ms: Tiada akaun dipautkan, dicipta atau dibuang di sini. Penutupan akses segera bagi staf yang keluar mengikut prosedurnya sendiri.

statusNote.en: Built. Until the trusted tenant and the CoS, Company Head and HR Administrator mappings are set up by a separate reviewed process, requests show “pending setup”.
statusNote.ms: Sudah dibina. Sehingga tenant dipercayai dan pemetaan CoS, Ketua Syarikat dan Pentadbir HR disediakan melalui proses semakan berasingan, permohonan memaparkan “pending setup”.

sops.words: hr it intake onboarding offboarding sign-in log masuk microsoft entra coordination koordinasi

title.en: Add a Prima sign-in or change company access
title.ms: Tambah log masuk Prima atau ubah akses syarikat

purpose.en: IT or central HR prepares new accounts, real names and company access as one request; the HR Director or the CEO approves it and every line goes in together.
purpose.ms: IT atau HR pusat menyediakan akaun baharu, nama sebenar dan akses syarikat dalam satu permohonan; Pengarah HR atau CEO meluluskannya dan semua baris dimasukkan serentak.

starter.en: IT Manager, IT Lead, IT Executive or central HR
starter.ms: Pengurus IT, Ketua IT, Eksekutif IT atau HR pusat

does.en: Adds lines (a new account, a change to an account, or company office staff from the staff directory) and sends the request. Not for your own account.
does.ms: Menambah baris (akaun baharu, perubahan akaun, atau staf pejabat syarikat dari direktori staf) dan menghantar permohonan. Bukan untuk akaun sendiri.

who.en: HR Director (CoS or DCoS) or the CEO; the CEO for a leader’s account
who.ms: Pengarah HR (CoS atau DCoS) atau CEO; CEO bagi akaun pemimpin

does.en: Approves or returns it with a comment of at least 3 characters. Once approved, every line goes in together or none does.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau memulangkannya dengan ulasan sekurang-kurangnya 3 aksara. Setelah diluluskan, semua baris dimasukkan serentak atau tiada langsung.

rules.en: Never your own request, and never a request that touches your own account.
rules.ms: Tidak sekali-kali permohonan sendiri, dan tidak sekali-kali permohonan yang melibatkan akaun sendiri.

rules.en: Company access lasts one year by default, or to a chosen date at most 3 years ahead, then must be renewed. Ended access stops the day before the approval day.
rules.ms: Akses syarikat berlaku setahun secara lalai, atau hingga tarikh dipilih paling lama 3 tahun, kemudian perlu diperbaharui. Akses yang ditamatkan berhenti sehari sebelum hari kelulusan.

rules.en: Closing a leaver’s access stays in HR’s leaving steps. The CEO’s own account, system feeds, site devices and guards are never changed here.
rules.ms: Menutup akses staf yang keluar kekal dalam langkah keluar HR. Akaun CEO sendiri, suapan sistem, peranti tapak dan pengawal tidak diubah di sini.

statusNote.en: Its database module (accounts-access-v1) is not installed on the live system yet.
statusNote.ms: Modul pangkalan datanya (accounts-access-v1) belum dipasang pada sistem langsung.

sops.words: account akaun sign-in log masuk access akses company syarikat login user pengguna

title.en: Who may use a system: access requests and reviews
title.ms: Siapa boleh menggunakan sistem: permohonan dan semakan akses

purpose.en: The CEO owns every system and decides who may sign in; IT records the systems, the access requests and the CEO’s decisions and carries them out.
purpose.ms: CEO memiliki setiap sistem dan memutuskan siapa boleh log masuk; IT merekod sistem, permohonan akses dan keputusan CEO serta melaksanakannya.

starter.en: IT staff

does.en: Registers an existing system with its people; MFA and access review start as unknown until recorded.
does.ms: Mendaftar sistem sedia ada dengan orang yang terlibat; MFA dan semakan akses bermula sebagai tidak diketahui sehingga direkod.

does.en: Asks the CEO to change access for a person, with a reason.
does.ms: Meminta CEO menukar akses seseorang, dengan sebab.

does.en: Approves or refuses the access request.
does.ms: Meluluskan atau menolak permohonan akses.

does.en: Makes the change in the system itself (outside Prima) and keeps the evidence separate from the approval.
does.ms: Membuat perubahan dalam sistem itu sendiri (di luar Prima) dan menyimpan bukti berasingan daripada kelulusan.

does.en: Confirms each system’s access list every 90 days.
does.ms: Mengesahkan senarai akses setiap sistem setiap 90 hari.

rules.en: Recording an access decision does not give or remove access in the system.
rules.ms: Merekod keputusan akses tidak memberi atau membuang akses dalam sistem.

rules.en: Never enter passwords, tokens or recovery codes.
rules.ms: Jangan sekali-kali masukkan kata laluan, token atau kod pemulihan.

source.decided: Fauzan, 28 Oct 2026: the CEO owns every system; access review every 90 days (rule IT-JOBS)

sops.words: system sistem access akses permission kebenaran ceo review semakan mfa

title.en: A SharePoint site or library for your team
title.ms: Laman atau pustaka SharePoint untuk pasukan anda

purpose.en: Staff ask IT for a SharePoint site or library; IT records the guidance with its owner and next review, and the IT Manager checks it independently.
purpose.ms: Staf meminta IT untuk laman atau pustaka SharePoint; IT merekod panduan dengan pemilik dan tarikh semakan seterusnya, dan Pengurus IT menyemaknya secara bebas.

starter.en: Any staff member

does.en: Asks IT with a help request about Microsoft 365, giving the site or library address if there is one.
does.ms: Meminta IT melalui tiket bantuan berkenaan Microsoft 365, dengan alamat laman atau pustaka jika ada.

does.en: Records SharePoint guidance: the site owner, the IT person responsible, the address (or pending), the next review and the evidence.
does.ms: Merekod panduan SharePoint: pemilik laman, staf IT yang bertanggungjawab, alamat (atau belum ada), semakan seterusnya dan bukti.

who.en: IT Manager (not the author or the responsible person)
who.ms: Pengurus IT (bukan penulis atau orang yang bertanggungjawab)

does.en: Independently checks the evidence.
does.ms: Menyemak bukti secara bebas.

does.en: Confirms the help request is fixed.
does.ms: Mengesahkan tiket bantuan telah selesai.

rules.en: The guidance record says “not connected”: it does not create a site, give permissions or prove a connection works.
rules.ms: Rekod panduan menyatakan “not connected”: ia tidak mencipta laman, memberi kebenaran atau membuktikan sambungan berfungsi.

rules.en: Prima’s own SharePoint connection stays off until the CEO approves the Microsoft consent and site grants.
rules.ms: Sambungan SharePoint Prima sendiri kekal dimatikan sehingga CEO meluluskan kebenaran Microsoft dan pemberian akses laman.

statusNote.en: The manual guidance is in use. Checking SharePoint access from Prima (Connections) is switched off.
statusNote.ms: Panduan manual sedang digunakan. Semakan akses SharePoint dari Prima (Sambungan) dimatikan.

sops.words: sharepoint site laman library pustaka folder teams microsoft 365 connection sambungan

title.en: Move a person’s sign-in after a transfer

purpose.en: When a transfer to another company is applied, IT moves the person’s accounts to the new company once the HR Director has authorised it, and Prima checks the result.
purpose.ms: Apabila pertukaran ke syarikat lain dilaksanakan, IT memindahkan akaun orang itu ke syarikat baharu setelah Pengarah HR membenarkannya, dan Prima menyemak hasilnya.

label.en: IT › Login handovers after a transfer
label.ms: IT › Serahan log masuk selepas pertukaran

starter.en: Prima, when HR applies a transfer

does.en: Authorises the login move with a reason; not the preparer, the applier or the person moved.
does.ms: Membenarkan pemindahan log masuk dengan sebab; bukan penyedia, pelaksana atau orang yang dipindahkan.

does.en: Moves each account through the approved account process (outside this panel).
does.ms: Memindahkan setiap akaun melalui proses akaun yang diluluskan (di luar panel ini).

does.en: Presses Confirm login moved with what was changed. Prima refuses unless every account points to the new record, reaches the new company and no longer reaches the old one.
does.ms: Menekan Confirm login moved dengan apa yang diubah. Prima menolak kecuali setiap akaun menuju rekod baharu, boleh mencapai syarikat baharu dan tidak lagi mencapai syarikat lama.

label.en: IT › Login handovers after a transfer
label.ms: IT › Serahan log masuk selepas pertukaran

rules.en: Nobody confirms their own move.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa mengesahkan pemindahan sendiri.

rules.en: Until the move is confirmed, self-service on the old record refuses leave with a plain explanation.
rules.ms: Sehingga pemindahan disahkan, layan diri pada rekod lama menolak cuti dengan penjelasan yang jelas.

sops.words: transfer pertukaran login log masuk handover serahan account akaun move pindah company syarikat

title.en: Attach an Outlook email to an IT job
title.ms: Lampirkan e-mel Outlook pada tugasan IT

purpose.en: A person working on an IT job copies one chosen Outlook email onto the job as evidence. Sending and replying stay in Outlook.
purpose.ms: Orang yang menguruskan tugasan IT menyalin satu e-mel Outlook yang dipilih ke tugasan sebagai bukti. Menghantar dan membalas kekal dalam Outlook.

label.en: IT › Jobs › Outlook emails on this job
label.ms: IT › Tugasan › E-mel Outlook pada tugasan ini

starter.en: The job’s assignee, the person who gave the job, the IT Manager, the IT Lead or the COO
starter.ms: Penama tugasan, orang yang memberi tugasan, Pengurus IT, Ketua IT atau COO

does.en: Opens the email in Outlook on the web and copies its link.
does.ms: Membuka e-mel dalam Outlook di web dan menyalin pautannya.

does.en: Pastes the link on the job, presses Preview this email, then Attach to this job. The copy is kept 30 days.
does.ms: Menampal pautan pada tugasan, menekan Preview this email, kemudian Attach to this job. Salinan disimpan 30 hari.

rules.en: Prima reads only the one email you choose, from your own mailbox. No inbox reading, no AI reading, no file attachments.
rules.ms: Prima hanya membaca satu e-mel yang anda pilih, dari peti mel anda sendiri. Tiada bacaan peti masuk, tiada bacaan AI, tiada lampiran fail.

rules.en: Staff send and reply in Outlook; Prima has no Send.
rules.ms: Staf menghantar dan membalas dalam Outlook; Prima tiada fungsi Hantar.

statusNote.en: Built. Waits for the CEO to approve the Microsoft mail permission and switch it on.
statusNote.ms: Sudah dibina. Menunggu CEO meluluskan kebenaran mel Microsoft dan menghidupkannya.

source.decided: Fauzan, 31 Oct 2026 (send stays in Outlook; only emails attached to a job; 30 days)

sops.words: outlook email e-mel attach lampir job tugasan evidence bukti mail

title.en: Import open IT work from a sheet (CEO)
title.ms: Import kerja IT terbuka dari helaian (CEO)

purpose.en: The CEO pastes or chooses a sheet of open help requests or IT jobs, reviews the preview and approves the batch once.
purpose.ms: CEO menampal atau memilih helaian tiket bantuan atau tugasan IT yang terbuka, menyemak pratonton dan meluluskan kumpulan itu sekali.

starter.en: The CEO only

does.en: Pastes rows from Excel or chooses a CSV file, and says where they came from.
does.ms: Menampal baris dari Excel atau memilih fail CSV, dan menyatakan sumbernya.

does.en: Shows a preview: errors per row, repeats of earlier rows or of open items, and which heading was read as which field. Nothing is written yet.
does.ms: Memaparkan pratonton: ralat setiap baris, ulangan baris atau item terbuka sedia ada, dan tajuk yang dibaca sebagai medan mana. Tiada apa ditulis lagi.

does.en: Leaves out any rows and approves. Only new items are created; nothing is updated, merged or deleted.
does.ms: Mengecualikan baris jika perlu dan meluluskan. Hanya item baharu dicipta; tiada apa dikemas kini, digabung atau dipadam.

rules.en: At most 200 rows per batch.
rules.ms: Paling banyak 200 baris bagi setiap kumpulan.

rules.en: Approving the same batch again returns the first result instead of importing twice.
rules.ms: Meluluskan kumpulan yang sama sekali lagi memulangkan hasil pertama, bukan mengimport dua kali.

title.en: Correct or archive a manual IT record
title.ms: Membetulkan atau mengarkib rekod IT manual

purpose.en: IT corrects the descriptive details of a device, system or joining/leaving record with a reason, and a separate IT Lead review decides whether a suspected test record may be archived.
purpose.ms: IT membetulkan butiran deskriptif peranti, sistem atau rekod masuk/keluar dengan sebab, dan semakan Ketua IT yang berasingan memutuskan sama ada rekod yang disyaki ujian boleh diarkib.

starter.en: The IT person responsible for the record, or the IT Manager or IT Lead
starter.ms: Staf IT yang bertanggungjawab atas rekod, atau Pengurus IT atau Ketua IT

does.en: Corrects serial, model, location or warranty (or a system’s note, or a joiner’s date and title) with a reason.
does.ms: Membetulkan nombor siri, model, lokasi atau waranti (atau catatan sistem, atau tarikh dan jawatan staf baharu) dengan sebab.

does.en: Nominates a record they believe is test data, with a documentary origin summary and reference.
does.ms: Mencalonkan rekod yang dipercayai data ujian, dengan ringkasan asal-usul dan rujukan dokumen.

who.en: A different IT Lead (not the creator or nominator)
who.ms: Ketua IT lain (bukan pencipta atau pencalon)

does.en: Records a hold, or archives the exact record when its demo origin is verified and nothing depends on it. An archived record can be restored.
does.ms: Merekod penahanan, atau mengarkib rekod tersebut apabila asal-usul demonya disahkan dan tiada yang bergantung padanya. Rekod yang diarkib boleh dipulihkan.

rules.en: A correction never changes identity, company, access, payments or inspection history.
rules.ms: Pembetulan tidak sekali-kali mengubah identiti, syarikat, akses, bayaran atau sejarah pemeriksaan.

rules.en: Nothing is ever deleted. A record linked to a purchase, bill, inspection or access stays protected.
rules.ms: Tiada apa dipadam. Rekod yang dipautkan kepada pembelian, bil, pemeriksaan atau akses kekal dilindungi.

sops.words: correction pembetulan cleanup pembersihan archive arkib demo test ujian wrong salah

title.en: Record how long IT work takes

purpose.en: Staff record their own work, waiting and handoff time on an assigned IT job or help request, to see how long work takes and how well it is done.
purpose.ms: Staf merekod masa kerja, menunggu dan serahan mereka sendiri pada tugasan IT atau tiket bantuan yang diberi, untuk melihat tempoh dan kualiti kerja.

starter.en: The person assigned the stage of work
starter.ms: Orang yang diberi peringkat kerja itu

does.en: Opens timing on their job or request, then starts, pauses, records an outside wait (with who follows up, why and the next review time) and marks it ready for handoff.
does.ms: Membuka rekod masa pada tugasan atau tiket sendiri, kemudian mula, jeda, merekod menunggu pihak luar (dengan siapa menyusul, sebab dan masa semakan seterusnya) dan menandanya sedia untuk diserahkan.

does.en: Submits, checks or confirms the work itself in the normal IT screens; timing only syncs the recorded result.
does.ms: Menghantar, menyemak atau mengesahkan kerja itu sendiri dalam skrin IT biasa; rekod masa hanya menyelaraskan hasil yang direkod.

does.en: Records provisional time targets.
does.ms: Merekod sasaran masa sementara.

rules.en: Staff-recorded intervals, not attendance, screen watching or a staff ranking. Total elapsed time never pauses.
rules.ms: Tempoh yang direkod staf, bukan kehadiran, pemantauan skrin atau ranking staf. Jumlah masa berlalu tidak pernah berhenti.

rules.en: Earlier time and missing quality evidence stay unknown, never zero or a pass.
rules.ms: Masa lebih awal dan bukti kualiti yang tiada kekal tidak diketahui, bukan sifar atau lulus.

statusNote.en: Covers IT jobs and help requests (including linked website requests). The HR review of these numbers is not built yet.
statusNote.ms: Meliputi tugasan IT dan tiket bantuan (termasuk tiket laman web berkaitan). Semakan HR bagi angka ini belum dibina.

sops.words: timing masa time metrics kualiti quality kpi tempoh

title.en: Backups, restore tests and continuity drills
title.ms: Sandaran, ujian pemulihan dan latihan kesinambungan

purpose.en: Every system keeps copies in the cloud, on our own server and on an emergency server; IT records each backup, restore test and drill.
purpose.ms: Setiap sistem menyimpan salinan di awan, pelayan sendiri dan pelayan kecemasan; IT merekod setiap sandaran, ujian pemulihan dan latihan.

starter.en: IT

does.en: Adds each system and its copies.
does.ms: Menambah setiap sistem dan salinannya.

does.en: Records each backup and each restore test (date, result, hours to restore, minutes of data lost).
does.ms: Merekod setiap sandaran dan ujian pemulihan (tarikh, keputusan, jam untuk pulih, minit data hilang).

does.en: Records each playbook drill (for example “Prima is down”).
does.ms: Merekod setiap latihan buku panduan (contohnya “Prima is down”).

rules.en: A copy counts only when backed up within its target and restored in a test in the last 6 months. No record means unknown.
rules.ms: Salinan hanya dikira jika disandarkan dalam sasaran dan dipulihkan dalam ujian dalam 6 bulan terakhir. Tiada rekod bermaksud tidak diketahui.

rules.en: Every playbook is drilled at least every 12 months.
rules.ms: Setiap buku panduan dilatih sekurang-kurangnya setiap 12 bulan.

statusNote.en: The screen works; the recovery targets are proposals for IT and Fauzan to confirm.
statusNote.ms: Skrin berfungsi; sasaran pemulihan masih cadangan untuk disahkan oleh IT dan Fauzan.

sops.words: backup sandaran restore pulih continuity kesinambungan disaster bencana drill latihan server pelayan

title.en: Switch an area from the JA Group app to Prima
title.ms: Menukar satu bidang dari aplikasi JA Group ke Prima

purpose.en: One company and one area at a time: Prima and JA run side by side, every difference is explained, ACT checks the report and the CEO switches.
purpose.ms: Satu syarikat dan satu bidang pada satu masa: Prima dan JA berjalan serentak, setiap perbezaan dijelaskan, ACT menyemak laporan dan CEO menukar.

starter.en: CEO or COO

who.en: ACT staff, then the ACT Lead or Deputy (a different person)
who.ms: Staf ACT, kemudian Ketua atau Timbalan ACT (orang berbeza)

does.en: ACT stages a JA export file for one company; Prima lists bad rows and unknown staff numbers; the ACT Lead or Deputy approves the exact file.
does.ms: ACT memuat naik fail eksport JA bagi satu syarikat; Prima menyenaraikan baris salah dan nombor staf yang tidak dikenali; Ketua atau Timbalan ACT meluluskan fail tersebut.

does.en: Starts a side-by-side run for one company and one area (incidents, attendance, patrol, guard pay, hostels).
does.ms: Memulakan larian serentak bagi satu syarikat dan satu bidang (insiden, kehadiran, rondaan, gaji pengawal, asrama).

who.en: The people who run the area (Operations, HR, FWM, company manager)
who.ms: Orang yang menjalankan bidang itu (Operasi, HR, FWM, pengurus syarikat)

does.en: Explain or fix each difference, with a note.
does.ms: Menjelaskan atau membetulkan setiap perbezaan, dengan catatan.

does.en: Checks the report after the run, never one where they explained a difference. A data change afterwards cancels the check.
does.ms: Menyemak laporan selepas larian, tidak sekali-kali laporan yang mereka jelaskan perbezaannya. Perubahan data selepas itu membatalkan semakan.

does.en: Switches the area for that company with a reason; JA stays read-only for the set number of days. Only the CEO can undo it.
does.ms: Menukar bidang itu bagi syarikat tersebut dengan sebab; JA kekal baca sahaja untuk bilangan hari yang ditetapkan. Hanya CEO boleh membatalkannya.

rules.en: The ACT Director sets the numbers (days side by side, tolerances, read-only days) with a reason; a run keeps the numbers it started with.
rules.ms: Pengarah ACT menetapkan angka (hari serentak, toleransi, hari baca sahaja) dengan sebab; setiap larian mengekalkan angka semasa ia bermula.

rules.en: A day with no approved JA data is unknown, never matching. A value that looks like a full IC number is refused.
rules.ms: Hari tanpa data JA yang diluluskan adalah tidak diketahui, bukan sepadan. Nilai yang kelihatan seperti nombor IC penuh ditolak.

statusNote.en: Test data only. Switching records the decision; it does not yet turn screens on or off, and the JA date is a switch Fauzan holds.
statusNote.ms: Data ujian sahaja. Pertukaran merekod keputusan; ia belum menghidupkan atau mematikan skrin, dan tarikh JA ialah suis yang dipegang Fauzan.

source.decided: Fauzan, 5 Nov 2026 (one month side by side, then switch by area)

sops.words: ja group app switch tukar side by side serentak act report laporan import history sejarah

title.en: Guard data from the JA Group app
title.ms: Data pengawal dari aplikasi JA Group

purpose.en: Guards are keyed in once, in JA; Prima files each guard read-only for HR, the guard’s company and Operations, and shows a late feed as unknown.
purpose.ms: Pengawal dimasukkan sekali sahaja, dalam JA; Prima memfailkan setiap pengawal secara baca sahaja untuk HR, syarikat pengawal dan Operasi, dan memaparkan suapan lewat sebagai tidak diketahui.

starter.en: The JA feed’s own system account

does.en: Sends guard records in batches of up to 1,000; Prima lists every rejected record with its reason.
does.ms: Menghantar rekod pengawal dalam kumpulan hingga 1,000; Prima menyenaraikan setiap rekod yang ditolak dengan sebabnya.

does.en: Read the deliveries, guards, papers due, payroll and incidents they are allowed to see. A company with no delivery past the stale limit shows as unknown.
does.ms: Membaca penghantaran, pengawal, dokumen yang hampir tamat, gaji dan insiden yang dibenarkan. Syarikat tanpa penghantaran melebihi had lewat dipaparkan sebagai tidak diketahui.

rules.en: Nobody types a guard in again: HR adds people in Prima only where JA does not cover them.
rules.ms: Tiada sesiapa memasukkan semula pengawal: HR menambah orang dalam Prima hanya jika JA tidak meliputinya.

rules.en: Full IC and salary account numbers stay behind the HR wall; others see the masked form.
rules.ms: Nombor IC penuh dan akaun gaji kekal di sebalik dinding HR; orang lain melihat bentuk bertopeng.

statusNote.en: Preview with test data. The feed is not live: its sign-in and company grants are created by the CEO when it goes live.
statusNote.ms: Pratonton dengan data ujian. Suapan belum aktif: log masuk dan akses syarikatnya dicipta oleh CEO apabila ia diaktifkan.

sops.words: ja feed suapan guard pengawal sync data jagroup
